rows.title: Data Analyst - Participant Support Operations & Clinical Operations
rows.descriptionText:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Analytics team, using data and operational insight to help improve both the participant experience and the journey of biosamples through our study.You'll work closely with operational and technical teams to understand performance, investigate complex problems and turn data into practical recommendations. From understanding participant contact volumes and service demand to identifying bottlenecks across biosample logistics, your analysis will help teams make better decisions, improve processes and deliver more efficient and reliable operations.Despite big improvements in healthcare in our lifetimes, today millions of people in the UK still live in poor health as they get older. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.Our Future Health will be the UK's largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. We are a charity, supported by the UK Government, in partnership with charities and industry. We work closely with the NHS and with public authorities across all nations and regions of the UK.What you'll be doing:In this role, you'll partner with teams across Participant Support Operations, Clinical Operations and Analytics to solve operational problems using data and evidence. You'll develop trusted reporting and metrics, investigate issues across multiple systems and help teams move towards more proactive, data-informed performance management.Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:Analyse participant contact volumes, service performance, complaints and backlogs, using forecasting and capacity planning to help teams understand and manage demandIdentify trends and drivers within participant enquiries and complaints, turning your findings into actionable recommendations to improve participant experience and operational efficiencyAnalyse the end-to-end biosample journey across operational, logistics and laboratory systems, identifying delays, discrepancies, anomalies and quality issuesUse SQL and exploratory analysis to investigate data across multiple systems, reconstruct operational workflows and identify the root causes of issuesDevelop and maintain operational reporting, performance metrics and monitoring across participant support and biosample operationsWork with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and operational teams to improve data quality, traceability and reporting capabilityTranslate operational questions into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholdersHelp teams move from manual and reactive reporting towards proactive performance management and data-informed decision-makingYou'll be part of a wider Analytics function made up of analysts, data scientists and data engineers. The team works remotely, coming together in person twice a month for collaboration and co-working, as well as quarterly strategy days focused on planning, problem-solving and longer-term thinking. We also have a regular book club and team demos, which give us space to learn together and celebrate what we're building. 
Hiring Process We feel hiring should be transparent and give you a real sense for what Our Future Health is like. Here's what you can expect: Initial chat with our Talent team (30 min) to get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have1st interview with our Analytics Manager (25 min) - this is an opportunity to meet your potential line manager and for you both to align on role expectationsTechnical interview with 2-3 members from our Analytics team (60 min). This will include a short task you'll need to prepare in advance of the interview and is designed to get a sense for how you'd approach the real-world responsibilities of this roleFinal stage competency interview (60 min) with a small cross-functional panel of your potential new stakeholders. This will focus on how you collaborate, work with stakeholders, and navigate ambiguity and challenges in real-world projects

Requirements

We recognise that candidates may have developed relevant experience through different career paths and welcome applications from those who can demonstrate many, though not necessarily all, of the skills and experience listed below:Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and cloud data platforms such as SnowflakeExperience analysing complex operational data from multiple systems and investigating data quality issues, discrepancies and operational risksExperience developing and maintaining reporting, dashboards, datasets or other analytical products used by operational teamsAn understanding of operational performance analysis, which could have been developed within areas such as healthcare, logistics, customer operations, participant services, research or another complex operational environmentFamiliarity with data modelling concepts and experience collaborating with Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering teamsStrong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate root causes and turn analysis into practical recommendationsThe ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and build effective relationships with both operational and technical stakeholdersAn organised and adaptable approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to data qualityKnowledge of forecasting, capacity planning, performance measurement or operational analytics methodologies would be advantageousAn understanding of statistical concepts and performance monitoring techniques, such as variation analysis or statistical process control, would be beneficialExperience using Python or R for data manipulation, analysis, automation or exploratory investigation would also be beneficial. 

Benefits

From £53,000 annum basic salary.Generous Pension Scheme - We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12%30 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays - Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits youEnhanced Parental Leave - Supporting you during life's biggest momentsCycle to Work Scheme - Save 25-39% on a new bike and accessories through salary sacrificeHome & Tech Savings - Get up to 8% off on IKEA and Currys products, spreading the cost over 12 months through salary sacrifice£1,000 Employee Referral Bonus - Know someone amazing? Get rewarded for bringing them on board!Wellbeing Support - Access to Mental Health First Aiders, plus 24/7 online GP services and an Employee Assistance Programme for you and your familyA Great Place to Work - We have a lovely Central London office in Holborn, and offer flexible and remote working arrangementsJoin us - let's prevent disease together.Closing date: 12 October 2026 at 5:00 pmWe may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.At Our Future Health, we recognise the importance of having a diverse workforce and ensuring that all candidates, regardless of their background, have equitable access to our application process. We proactively encourage applicants who identify as having a disability, neurodiversity, or long-term health conditions to let us know if they require any reasonable adjustments as part of their application process.If you do require any reasonable adjustments, please email us at talent@ourfuturehealth.org.uk.

rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Dynamo AI
Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.
The RoleOur PMs each own a set of business problems, such as getting AI agents approved for production, reducing the effort legal and compliance teams spend on guardrails, or lowering the cost of running guardrails at scale. Almost every one of these problems depends on evidence: whether an approach works, how well, and at what cost. Product Analysts produce that evidence.Working with the PM who owns a problem, you take a specific question within it and own the answer. You scope the question, design the experiment or prototype, define how success is measured, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation the PM can act on. When building is faster than waiting, that includes standing up a quick tool with AI to test an idea. You may support several PMs as priorities shift.Training and infrastructure code is handled by our engineering and research teams. Your contribution is experimental design, prototyping and analytical rigor.
What You Might Work OnGuardrail creation and upkeep: design and curate the data used to train and accept custom guardrails, keep labeling consistent as datasets grow, and measure whether updates made from production errors improve performance without regressions.Control coverage: benchmark detection against new attack techniques, languages and modalities, and scope what closing each gap would take.Evaluation evidence: assess whether synthetic evaluation and red-teaming data is faithful and diverse enough for customers' approvers to trust, and research new ways to evaluate AI applications and agents.Cost and performance: compare guardrail and orchestration configurations on accuracy, latency and inference cost.Alerting: prototype ways to aggregate and prioritize guardrail alerts, and measure their effect on the workload of security analysts.Workflow prototypes: build and test prototypes of new workflows, such as how legal and compliance reviewers contribute to guardrail policies or how customers onboard an application on their own, and measure the time and effort they take.Rapid tooling: build small custom tools with AI to validate a hypothesis or unblock the team.Benchmarking and reporting: measure performance with standard classification metrics (FNR, FPR, precision, recall) and report what is working and what is not.
Growth PathYou will start on well-scoped questions and move to harder, more ambiguous ones. Over time you will build intuition for SLM training, guardrail orchestration, agent security and how controls fit into a full AI application, along with an understanding of how our customers make approval decisions. This is a track toward a Product Manager or senior technical product role.
RequirementsA degree with strong quantitative or analytical content. We are especially interested in less common backgrounds, such as physics, information or data theory, and business, alongside solid data analysis experience.A clear, demonstrated framework for thinking through problems.Good instincts for data, ML concepts, and what makes an experiment or metric trustworthy.Python and pandas for working with data.Interest in AI security or safety, and in adversarial thinking.Attention to detail and clear writing, including the ability to turn results into a recommendation a PM can act on.
Nice to HaveML coursework, or coursework or projects in statistics or NLP.Reading or working proficiency in Japanese, Chinese or a European language.SQL.A habit of building small tools or scripts, including with AI assistants, to answer your own questions.Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, security tooling, experimental design or annotation work.
Why Join UsProduce the evidence behind product decisions across every Dynamo product.Work on AI security and governance problems that enterprises are facing for the first time.Grow toward a product role at a founder-led startup.Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.

What's the role about?
We’re looking for a Business Applications Support Analyst to support and improve the business-critical applications, integrations, automations and reporting processes used across Reiss. Working closely with colleagues across IT and the wider business, you’ll monitor daily processes, investigate issues, maintain accurate documentation and help ensure our systems and data flows remain reliable and effective.
With a focus on proactive and reactive application support, you’ll take ownership of incidents through to resolution, collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners, and contribute to small changes that improve efficiency and productivity.
This role requires flexibility to work in a varied shift pattern, with earlier starts, later finishes, and weekend work as agreed by a rota within the team. 
Who you are
Strong, current experience supporting retail IT business systems, with a good understanding of the needs of a highly integrated, multi-channel retail environment.Practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Query and Power Automate, alongside proven experience developing, maintaining and supporting automated business workflows and processes.Confidence working with datasets of different sizes, including data handling, manipulation and correction.A strong understanding of workflow automation, system integrations and process improvement, with the ability to support and monitor API integrations, plus experience working with SaaS solutions, user access and data pipelines. Exposure to Google BigQuery, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or retail, merchandising, finance and warehouse systems would be advantageous.Experience using Microsoft Copilot, PowerShell, Postman or similar tools to support productivity, solution development and automated tasks would be desirable.Highly organised and detail-oriented, with strong written and verbal communication skills and a customer-focused approach to supporting both technical and non-technical users.A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to learn independently, take ownership, meet deadlines and know when to escalate an issue.
What you'll be doing
Monitoring business applications, integrations, automations, scheduled tasks and data integrity, completing daily checks in line with agreed timelines and service levels.Investigating and resolving incidents, owning assigned issues through to completion and escalating or handing them over to the appropriate internal or external party when required.Building strong working knowledge of Reiss business applications and systems, including Microsoft Business Central, Board, JSCAPE MFT, Alteryx, Power Platform, Teamwork Commerce POS, Google BigQuery, PLM and PIM solutions.Managing issues and resolutions through ITIL-aligned processes while keeping stakeholders informed and delivering courteous, professional support.Working with internal stakeholders, suppliers and solution partners to investigate issues, resolve root causes and help prevent recurrence.Maintaining clear, accurate and accessible documentation for applications, integrations, support processes, data flows, automations and scripts, while contributing to knowledge sharing and cross-training.Delivering small system and process improvements that support business growth, team efficiency and productivity, including solutions created through PowerShell and Microsoft Power Platform.Following Business Applications Support standards and wider IT policies, including change management, environmental and security controls, testing strategies, and responsible use of AI.
What we’ll do for you
Competitive salary and company bonus.Up to 65% employee discount.Access to exclusive sample sales.Health and wellbeing services.Medicash health support plan.Workplace pension contributions.Enhanced parental leave policies.Electric Vehicle scheme via Octopus Energy.Cycle to Work programme.Season ticket travel loan.Plus further workplace benefits.

Ambition | Accountability | Courage | Commitment | Focus | Resilience

rows.title: Content Research & Activation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Location

London

Business Area

Marketing and Public Relations

Ref #

10054040

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Marketing partners with forward-looking business leaders to seize and create opportunities and to drive difference. We use data to understand markets and audiences, and creative ideas to build stories and brands. We create campaigns that capture attention and drive a reaction. We move fast, and our core approach is integrated and pioneering.

The Content Marketing Strategy team transforms Bloomberg’s market insights and research into compelling content that resonates with customers and prospects. We drive engagement at scale by connecting Bloomberg’s unmatched expertise to client priorities and broader business goals. Sitting within Business Marketing, our team focuses on turning market intelligence into meaningful impact. Our ambition is to redefine how we approach marketing—moving beyond promotion to find new ways to surface, package, and distribute Bloomberg’s research to the audiences who value it most.

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a Content Research & Activation Analyst to help Bloomberg maximize the reach and impact of our in-house research. In this role, you will combine content activation, audience analysis, and experimentation to connect the right research with the right audiences, channels, and moments.

You will help us better understand how clients consume Bloomberg research, what they use it for, and how content discovery is evolving in the age of AI, search, and ASKB. Success requires curiosity about markets and client behavior, strong content instincts, and the ability to turn insights into action—testing new approaches, identifying what works, and helping scale those ideas across Bloomberg experiences.

We’ll Trust You To

Turn Bloomberg research into timely, relevant content around earnings, macro events, sectors, and market themes across written, video, digital, and emerging formats. Analyze audience behavior and engagement signals to understand who is consuming our research, which topics and analysts resonate, and what drives deeper engagement. Explore how AI, search, ASKB, and evolving Bloomberg experiences can transform the way research is surfaced, packaged, promoted, and consumed. Partner directly with Bloomberg Intelligence analysts to identify compelling ideas and translate complex research into clear, engaging content for professional audiences. Contribute to new content and product development initiatives, bringing together research, client behavior, and emerging distribution opportunities. Manage content priorities and execution across teams, balancing speed and relevance with a focus on measurable impact. 

You’ll Need To Have

A strong understanding of and interest in financial markets, research, content, technology, and the evolving role of AI. An analytical mindset and curiosity about audience behavior, content discovery, and consumption patterns. The ability to understand complex research and translate it into clear, compelling ideas for professional audiences. Comfort working with data and engagement signals to identify opportunities and inform content decisions. Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities across multiple teams and initiatives. A hands-on, collaborative approach, with the curiosity and agility to experiment with new formats, technologies, and ways of reaching clients. 

We’d Love To See

Familiarity with Bloomberg Terminal workflows and how financial professionals discover and consume research. Experience working with financial research, content strategy, audience development, or digital distribution. Experience experimenting with AI, search, or emerging content discovery technologies. Examples of work that demonstrate creative thinking, experimentation, and measurable audience impact. 

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

The Email Loyalty & Enablement team sits at the heart of how we communicate with our customers through email. We bring together channel expertise, product management, new product development and marketing enablement to help deliver effective, trusted and engaging email experiences. Our responsibilities span the full email ecosystem - from protecting email deliverability and sender reputation, to developing new products and capabilities, enabling our internal users, and ensuring marketing and servicing communications meet our brand, accessibility, compliance and governance standards.

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Marketing partners with forward-looking business leaders to seize and create opportunities and to drive difference. We use data to understand markets and audiences, and creative ideas to build stories and brands. We create campaigns that capture attention and drive a reaction. We move fast, and our core approach is integrated and pioneering.

The Content Marketing Strategy team transforms Bloomberg’s market insights and research into compelling content that resonates with customers and prospects. We drive engagement at scale by connecting Bloomberg’s unmatched expertise to client priorities and broader business goals. Sitting within Business Marketing, our team focuses on turning market intelligence into meaningful impact. Our ambition is to redefine how we approach marketing—moving beyond promotion to find new ways to surface, package, and distribute Bloomberg’s research to the audiences who value it most.

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a Content Research & Activation Analyst to help Bloomberg maximize the reach and impact of our in-house research. In this role, you will combine content activation, audience analysis, and experimentation to connect the right research with the right audiences, channels, and moments.

You will help us better understand how clients consume Bloomberg research, what they use it for, and how content discovery is evolving in the age of AI, search, and ASKB. Success requires curiosity about markets and client behavior, strong content instincts, and the ability to turn insights into action—testing new approaches, identifying what works, and helping scale those ideas across Bloomberg experiences.

We’ll Trust You To

Turn Bloomberg research into timely, relevant content around earnings, macro events, sectors, and market themes across written, video, digital, and emerging formats. Analyze audience behavior and engagement signals to understand who is consuming our research, which topics and analysts resonate, and what drives deeper engagement. Explore how AI, search, ASKB, and evolving Bloomberg experiences can transform the way research is surfaced, packaged, promoted, and consumed. Partner directly with Bloomberg Intelligence analysts to identify compelling ideas and translate complex research into clear, engaging content for professional audiences. Contribute to new content and product development initiatives, bringing together research, client behavior, and emerging distribution opportunities. Manage content priorities and execution across teams, balancing speed and relevance with a focus on measurable impact. 

You’ll Need To Have

A strong understanding of and interest in financial markets, research, content, technology, and the evolving role of AI. An analytical mindset and curiosity about audience behavior, content discovery, and consumption patterns. The ability to understand complex research and translate it into clear, compelling ideas for professional audiences. Comfort working with data and engagement signals to identify opportunities and inform content decisions. Strong writing, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities across multiple teams and initiatives. A hands-on, collaborative approach, with the curiosity and agility to experiment with new formats, technologies, and ways of reaching clients. 

We’d Love To See

Familiarity with Bloomberg Terminal workflows and how financial professionals discover and consume research. Experience working with financial research, content strategy, audience development, or digital distribution. Experience experimenting with AI, search, or emerging content discovery technologies. Examples of work that demonstrate creative thinking, experimentation, and measurable audience impact. 

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

rows.title: Commercial Finance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The Role..

The Commercial Finance Analyst will support the Group Commercial Finance Director in delivering high-quality commercial finance support across Soho House’s capital planning, new site feasibility, property, leases, insurance, commercial agreements and business partnering activities.

This role will provide analytical, modelling and commercial insight across a broad range of strategic and operational finance areas, supporting decision-making for senior stakeholders across Development, Legal, Operations, Soho Works, IHDB, Partnerships, Residences and other business areas. The role will also help strengthen governance, reporting and data-led decision-making across capex, feasibility and commercial finance workstreams.

The successful candidate will be commercially focused, technically strong, highly analytical and comfortable working across multiple priorities in a fast-moving, multi-site international business.

Key Responsibilities..

Capital Planning and Governance

Support the Group Commercial Finance Director in the day-to-day management, review and reporting of Group capital planning.Review capex submissions and business cases to ensure they are complete, appropriately supported and aligned with Group policy and approval requirements.Prepare analysis on committed, approved and forecast capex spend, highlighting risks, variances and areas requiring management attention.Support the development and maintenance of capital planning reporting, governance trackers and approval materials.Work with Finance, Development and Operations teams to ensure capex decisions are supported by clear financial analysis and appropriate challenge.

New Site Feasibility and Investment Appraisal

Prepare and review financial models for new site opportunities, refurbishments and development projects.Support the review of key assumptions, including revenue, cost, payroll, rent, capex, working capital and return metrics.Prepare concise summaries of feasibility outputs, sensitivities and key risks for senior stakeholder review.Work with Development, Operations and Finance teams to ensure feasibility models are robust, consistent and clearly documented.Support the assessment of accounting implications linked to new site decisions, including leases, capitalisation and impairment considerations, working with technical accounting teams where required.

Property, Leases and Commercial Agreements

Support financial analysis relating to leases, property costs, rent reviews, lease amendments and other property-related commercial arrangements.Assist in the financial review of JV, HMA and key commercial agreements, ensuring key terms are understood, summarised and reflected in management reporting where relevant.Prepare analysis to support negotiation, renewal or restructuring of commercial agreements.Maintain clear summaries of key obligations, financial commitments and commercial risks across relevant agreements.Work closely with Legal, Property and Finance colleagues to provide timely financial input into commercial decision-making.

Insurance and Claims Support

Support the Group Commercial Finance Director with analysis and reporting relating to insurance programmes, claims and coverage matters.Assist with the preparation and financial support of Business Interruption and Contingent Business Interruption claims.Gather, reconcile and analyse financial information required to support claims preparation and recovery.Work with Operations, Finance and external advisors to ensure claims data is accurate, well evidenced and clearly presented.Help maintain reporting on open claims, recoveries, insurance costs and key risk areas.

Business Partnering

Provide analytical support to the Group Commercial Finance Director in business partnering Soho Works, Residences and other business lines.Prepare monthly performance analysis, commercial insight and decision-support materials for relevant business areas.Support the review of revenue, cost, margin and profitability trends, identifying opportunities to improve performance.Build strong working relationships with operational and functional teams, providing clear, practical and commercially focused finance support.Translate financial analysis into clear commentary and recommendations for non-finance stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Analytics and Process Improvement

Support the use of AI-enabled tools, ERP data and automation to improve the quality, speed and consistency of commercial finance analysis.Help develop repeatable reporting templates, dashboards and analytical outputs across capital planning, feasibility and commercial agreements.Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and strengthen decision-making through better use of systems and automation.Support process improvements across commercial finance workstreams, ensuring outputs are efficient, controlled and scalable.Maintain strong documentation and version control for key models, reports and governance materials.

Key Skills And Experience

Strong commercial finance, FP&A, investment appraisal or corporate finance experience, ideally gained in a multi-site, hospitality, property, leisure, retail or consumer-facing business.Excellent financial modelling and analytical skills, with experience preparing or reviewing business cases, feasibility models or investment appraisals.Good understanding of capex, leases, property costs and commercial agreements.Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear, concise outputs for senior stakeholders.Experience working with ERP, BI or reporting tools, with an interest in AI-enabled analytics and automation.Strong attention to detail, with the ability to challenge assumptions and identify risks or inconsistencies.Good technical accounting awareness, particularly around leases, capex and capitalisation, with willingness to work closely with technical accounting specialists.Qualified accountant or studying towards ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent would be preferred.Experience in hospitality, property, leisure, retail, membership or multi-site businesses would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

Commercial judgement: Able to interpret financial information in a practical, commercially relevant way and support better business decisions.Analytical rigour: Strong ability to review models, challenge assumptions and produce accurate, well-supported analysis.Stakeholder management: Confident working with Finance, Development, Legal, Operations and other senior stakeholders.Communication: Able to summarise complex financial information clearly and concisely for both finance and non-finance audiences.Ownership: Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple workstreams with limited supervision.Governance and control: Strong focus on accuracy, documentation, process discipline and approval requirements.Change mindset: Comfortable working in a transforming finance function, with interest in improving processes through better data, systems and automation.Team contribution: Collaborative, flexible and willing to support a broad commercial finance agenda as the team evolves.

Desired Profile

The ideal candidate will be a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys working close to the business, reviewing investment decisions, supporting strategic projects and improving the quality of financial insight. They will be comfortable working with detailed models and data, but equally able to step back and explain the key commercial message clearly.

They will need to be hands-on, pragmatic and confident operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. This role would suit someone looking to build broader commercial finance experience across capital planning, property, new site feasibility, insurance, commercial agreements and business partnering within a growing international group.

Benefits…

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.

Annual Every House Membership50% off Food & Drink, 7 days a weekStaff Room RatesPrivate Health and Dental CareWeekly PayLife AssuranceUp to 50% Staff Discount on Cowshed & Soho HomeIn Office Dog Policy on FridaysSeason Ticket LoanChristmas Office ClosureIn conjunction with Soho Impact, take 2 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.Free Counselling SessionsCookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionallyExclusive access to our benefits platform with hundreds of discounts on shopping, gym memberships, holidays, insurance and much moreTeam Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Position Statement

The Analyst is a key member of Hilton’s EMEA Real Estate & Asset Management (REAM) team responsible for all hotel real estate activities of Hilton. The role supports strategic planning, capital investment reporting, asset management initiatives, and underwriting for hotel real estate transactions. It also involves evaluating asset enhancement opportunities, maximises long-term portfolio value, and provides insight for investment and operational decision-making.

What will I be doing?

As the REAM Analyst, you will support hotel real estate activity across the region, with a focus on long-term asset enhancement, capital investment programmes, return on investment (ROI) analysis, and underwriting for transactions.

Based at Hilton’s EMEA Headquarters in Watford, Hertfordshire, the role involves regular collaboration with regional and corporate stakeholders across Hilton’s internal teams, depending on portfolio, project, and transaction requirements.

Working within a high-performing team, the Analyst will bring strong attention to detail, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment. The role requires the ability to test assumptions, prepare robust financial analysis, contribute to clear written recommendations, and support decision-making for senior stakeholders.

The Analyst will work closely with Asset Managers and internal stakeholders such as Operations, Architecture & Design, Accounting/Finance, Tax, Feasibility, and Legal. The role also supports discussions with landlords and other external parties in connection with rent reviews, lease negotiations, and transaction activity.

The role requires, and will further develop, knowledge of hospitality finance, hotel performance metrics, capital investment planning, real estate underwriting, lease structures, and asset management principles. The Analyst will apply this knowledge to portfolio reporting, ROI analysis, Investment Committee materials, and strategic assessments of hotel performance.

The Analyst will support team priorities by preparing analysis, contributing to recurring reporting processes, coordinating stakeholder input, and identifying opportunities to improve asset performance and investment outcomes across the portfolio.

Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, clear communication, effective stakeholder coordination, and a genuine interest in hospitality, real estate, asset management, and finance.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

 Analytical Activities Analyse and underwrite ROI capex projects by testing assumptions, building and updating return on investment models, and preparing supporting memos where required. Provide analytical support for real estate deals, including scenario modelling, performance projections, and investment return analysis. Support Asset Managers with rent reviews, lease negotiations, and related deal/transaction activity. Reporting Activities – Hotel Capex Programme Support capex reporting, monitoring, and presenting for approval to senior leadership. Coordinate the monthly Project Expenditure Report (PER) process, incorporating input from Operations, Architecture & Design, Accounting/Finance, and other internal teams. Track forecast accuracy and highlight major project variances and deviations as part of REAM’s capex oversight role. Present to findings to leadership teams. Portfolio Performance Activities Prepare monthly portfolio performance updates, including property-level snapshots, benchmark comparisons, KPI metrics, and actionable insights for Asset Managers. Support operational asset management initiatives that monitor, assess, and improve EBITDA performance across the portfolio. Other Tasks Support the drafting of Investment Committee memos for major projects. Assist with strategic annual Capex planning, including consolidating and analysing hotel capital expenditure requests, supporting budget reviews with Operations, and preparing materials for Executive Committee review. Liaise with internal stakeholders on corporate finance, underwriting, investment analysis, legal, tax, and operational matters. Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting, modelling, and portfolio analysis processes.

Supervision & Management

The role has no direct reports.

Internal & External Client Relationship Development & Management

The Analyst will build effective working relationships with REAM Asset Managers and internal client groups, including Operations, Architecture & Design, Accounting/Finance, Tax, Feasibility, and Legal. The role requires clear communication, reliable follow-through, and the ability to gather, challenge, and synthesise stakeholder input to support portfolio, capex, and transaction decisions.

Supporting Activities

In addition to core responsibilities, the Analyst may support broader REAM priorities and ad hoc analysis relating to capital investment, asset management, and real estate transaction activity.

Organisational Relationships

The Analyst reports to the Sr. Manager, Real Estate & Asset Management and sits within the EMEA REAM team, supporting Asset Managers and senior stakeholders on portfolio performance, capex reporting, investment analysis, and transaction-related activity.

Qualifications

 QUALIFICATIONS 

Specific Job Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

The role requires the following job-specific knowledge, skills, abilities, and behaviours:

 Strong analytical, financial, communication, and coordination skills. Advanced data analysis, financial modelling, and interpretation skills, including strong Microsoft Excel capability. Knowledge of hospitality finance and the ability to analyse hotel operating metrics and reports, including P&L statements and STR data. Ability to test assumptions, challenge inputs, and prepare clear analysis and written materials to support decision-making. Self-motivated, curious, and able to perform effectively in a dynamic team environment.

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a hotel administration or business school; coursework in finance, economics, or related fields is essential. Fluency in English, including speaking, reading, and writing. Strong interest in hospitality, real estate, asset management, finance, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

 Internship or early-career experience in hospitality, real estate, asset management, finance, or a related field. Additional European language capability. Ability to interpret hotel performance information and translate findings into practical recommendations.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

About L.E.K. Consulting

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

The Team 

L.E.K.’s Digital Data and AI team work alongside and support case teams in solving a range of digital and analytical problems, enabling L.E.K. to provide clients with the best possible advice.

The team’s collaborative approach is unique: our consulting teams leverage a high-powered self-service toolkit and domain expertise to build the analysis that underpins our commercial recommendations. As part of our team, you will be working alongside experienced project teams to develop cutting edge solutions to our clients’ toughest commercial problems.

The opportunity

As an Associate Consultant (Data Scientist) in L.E.K.’s Digital Data & AI team (DDA), you will help redefine how our case teams and clients leverage analytics and technology to solve their most complex challenges and transformations. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend L.E.K.’s hallmark analytical rigor with emerging Digital and AI capabilities to drive smarter, faster, and more scalable insights. You will start to lead analytical modules, begin to determine the approach to data science problems and turn findings into client recommendations. You will also contribute to proposals, help define good analytical practices and develop junior colleagues, with guidance from experienced project leaders.

Day-to-day Responsibilities And Required Skills Include

Starting to lead fast-paced project modulesthat apply digital and data science techniques including planning the work, directing junior colleagues, reviewing outputs and managing deliverySupporting case teamsin selecting the appropriate data, digital and AI-enabled approaches, and helping them tie the insights to the commercial deliverableApplying knowledge of digital, data science and AI practices, and starting to help define team standards for model validation, reproducible code, documentation, code review, data governance and responsible AI useSupporting the DDA team, contributing to data science capability building, internal training materials, awareness initiatives Coaching junior data scientists, review their work, give actionable feedback and contribute to their training and developmentStarting to contribute to proposals by shaping analytical approaches, assessing feasibility, estimating the work involved and preparing proposal materialsWhen not on project ideating, helping develop and deploying internal toolsInvesting in your own development, supported by strong senior sponsorship and dedicated time and resources to pursue personal growth goals 

What we are looking for

The Associate Consultant (Data Scientist) role suits anyone with a passion to crack commercial and analytical problems and help enable others to do the same.

In addition to technical skills, we are looking for bright and driven people who want to deploy their knowledge and skills within high-impact commercial contexts and help others do the same.

You should have a sense of intellectual curiosity that inspires you to develop and generate innovative answers to complex questions.

We work together in teams, so we look for people who can collaborate and communicate well. We look for those who will make an impact by being proactive and taking ownership of their work with energy and enthusiasm.

Because you will begin leading analytical modules, guiding junior colleagues and shaping new approaches, you will need to be a self-starter who works independently.

Required

Understanding of structured problem-solving and analytical approaches Experience turning an ambiguous commercial question into a deliverable analytical planFamiliarity with data analysis and data exploration, ML techniques and statistical approachesLeading and coaching more junior people through analysis and reviewing their work Proficiency in Python, experience of SQLUnderstanding of how digital and analytical methods support consulting work Ability to communicate analytical results to stakeholders with varied backgrounds and connect findings to a commercial question, starting to own client relationshipsKnowledge of cloud environment like Azure, AWSFamiliarity with Git and software development practicesExperience with Generative AI, AI agents

Nice To Have

Experience with model deploymentManagement or strategy consulting experience

Reasons to join L.E.K.

Global firm spanning multiple sectors Opportunity to apply analytics to key commercial problems, usually working with C-suites, Private Equity, investment funds and boards Energetic, intelligent and enthusiastic colleagues Dedicated time and support for development through both a firm-wide Professional Development programme and a personalised development plan Automatic enrolment into valuable profit-sharing scheme Range of office and team social events and activities

rows.descriptionText:
Welcome to Transport for London Careers

Take a look at job opportunities with us and you may be surprised at what you discover: a rich heritage, a commercial outlook, an iconic brand, a unique public service. It all adds up to make Transport for London a great place to develop your career. Here you can start your journey!

Key Information

Job title: Reporting Analyst

Salary: Circa £37,000

Grade: Band 2

Contract type: TfL Permanent

Reference: 2427

Team: Contact Centre Operations

Directorate: Customer

Contract details: Permanent

Location*: Endeavour Square, Hybrid Working*

Application closing date: 08/10/2026 at 23:59pm

We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.   

Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a 4-week period. Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements.

All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

Overview Of Project/role

Do you have a passion for turning data into actionable insights? Can you help support a team’s transition to automated BI reporting solutions? Are you curious, innovative, and committed to improving customer experience?

If you’ve answered ‘yes’, then we’re looking for someone just like you to join Contact Centre Operations (CCO) as a Reporting Analyst!

With over three million customer contacts every year, CCO exists to care for our customers. We play a vital role in delivering the Mayor’s Transport Strategy by ensuring a ‘Good Public Transport Experience’ - we resolve queries, reunite lost property, provide face-to-face support in our Visitor Centres, and ensure safety issues are addressed promptly. Behind the scenes, we rely on accurate, timely, and insightful data to make this happen - and that’s where you come in.

As a Reporting Analyst you’ll work within a team of up to 6 other analysts and administrators to deliver strategic insight and performance intelligence that informs decision-making at the highest levels. Your work will contribute to developing CCO operations, embed the voice of the customer across TfL, and drive continuous improvement in our operations.

What You’ll Be Doing

Working within the Reporting & Insights team to produce high‑quality dashboards, Management Information, and performance reports that support effective decision‑making.Producing clear, accurate interpretation, commentary, and insights on operational and customer trends.Working with the Reporting and Insights Manager to embed Business Intelligence tools and improved reporting processes, helping reduce reliance on manual Excel reporting and contributing to automated, innovative solutions.Providing proactive, customer‑focused insights from queries, complaints, and feedback to inform both short and long‑term strategic planning across TfL.Championing good data governance and ethical data use while ensuring all reporting activity complies with GDPR requirements.Collaborating with colleagues to enhance reporting practices and contribute to ongoing improvements in data quality, processes, and outputs.

A Day in the Life of the Reporting Analyst

Working in the Reporting and Insights team means every day brings something different. One morning, you might be reviewing dashboards and preparing performance updates for senior leaders, making sure the data clearly reflects trends in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Later, you could be meeting with stakeholders to walk through insights from complaint patterns and discuss how these findings can support service improvements.

You may spend part of your day contributing to transformation work - helping to structure data for new reporting tools, refining ETL pipelines, or supporting automation that reduces manual effort and risk. In the afternoon, you might be collaborating with TfL’s wider data community to explore new analytical techniques or preparing analysis that feeds into strategic discussions at senior levels. Throughout it all, you’ll be managing your workload effectively, ensuring outputs are accurate, well‑structured, and impactful.

What We’re Looking For (Essential)

Experience producing accurate performance reports and dashboards within operational, customer‑focused environments. (E)Proficiency in business intelligence tools, particularly Power BI and advanced Excel and experience of automating manual reporting processes, particularly using the Power Apps suite (E)Technical proficiency in Power BI and Power Query, with a strong understanding of best‑practice data preparation techniques aligned to Fabric adoption (E)Able to interpret complex datasets and present clear, actionable insights that support operational and strategic decisions. (E)Confident communicator with experience engaging stakeholders, gathering reporting requirements and presenting findings in a clear, structured way. (E)

This is a role for someone who thrives on making data meaningful and impactful. If you’re ready to lead a team that turns numbers into stories and insights into action, we’d love to hear from you.

Application Process  

Please apply using your CV and a two-page covering letter Think carefully about the skills, knowledge and experience in the advert and cover this in your CV and cover letter PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images 

 

Equality, diversity and inclusion

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. We want to represent the city we serve, which will help us become a more innovative and efficient organisation. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. We are a disability confident employer who guarantee an interview to any disabled candidate who meets all of the essential criteria. We also use anonymising software that removes identifying information from CVs and cover letters to make the process fair.

Benefits

In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:

 

Final salary pension scheme

Free travel for you on the TfL network

Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home or 75% reimbursement on a 28-day flexi ticket

30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays

TfL is committed to work-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow

Private healthcare discounted scheme (optional)

Tax-efficient cycle-to-work programme

Retail, health, leisure and travel offers

Discounted Eurostar travel

We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

Vetting Process

At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our-vetting-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

Job Description

ANALYST, STR - LONDON

Overview

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index , CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

STR is the global leader in hospitality data benchmarking, analytics and marketplace insights for the global hospitality industry. STR delivers data that is confidential, accurate and actionable to empower our clients to strategize and compete in their markets.

Learn more about STR.

Role Description

STR, a CoStar group company, is seeking a London-based Analyst to support international forecasting efforts and ensure STR maintains its position as a leading provider of forward-looking hotel performance data worldwide. This role demand an efficient, data-driven thinker with excellent research and analytic skills and a strong understanding of global hospitality performance. The Analyst will be part of a global forecast team responsible for producing hotel performance forecasts on a quarterly basis alongside actionable narratives underscoring the forecasted data.

Responsibilities

Forecasting

Under the direction of the Forecast Director, assist in the production and delivery of STR's Market Forecasts outside of North America.Contribute to development of forecasting methodology that captures region-specific macroeconomic and hotel performance trends.Collaborate with internal teams, STR's external partners, and conduct market research to investigate market conditions and demand drivers, adjusting forecast projections accordingly.Proactively build an in-depth understanding of global hotel performance and key trends impacting the hospitality industry, using knowledge of market trends and demand drivers to create compelling hotel performance storylines.Communicate effectively through written memos/analyses and verbal interactions with clients and colleagues regarding hotel performance trends and forecast data and assumptions.

Data analysis, visualization, and storytelling

Promote STR as a thought leader within the industry, transforming data into meaningful insights by visualizing STR's data for conferences, events, meetings, and client engagements.Contribute analyses to blogs, articles and white papers, which are distributed to clients and stakeholders on a regular basis.

Data integrity, security, and quality

Maintain high levels of data quality and accuracy by applying and maintaining process and robust review. Investigates anomalies and potential errors in data to understand the root cause and find resolution.Adhere to STR’s standards and guidelines for data confidentiality.

Personal and professional development

Maintain proactive and open communication with the Product team, as well as STR’s global analyst teams, whose members sit in different offices throughout the world.Keep up to date on hotel industry trends and news, with particular emphasis on the facts that affect hotel performance.Ensure CoStar brand and corporate values are evident to the customer at all times.

Qualifications

Strong understanding of the hotel industry, with experience working within the industry a plus.Must be adept in use of MS Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.Familiarity with Power BI and SSMS preferred.Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to present to clients.Adaptable to changing working environments, priorities, and organizational needs.Results-oriented with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute tasks independently or as part of a team.Analytical and research skills, including the ability to analyse, interpret, and visualize data, and conduct research to explain data and validate information.Strong decision-making skills, making timely decisions based on available information and taking ownership of decisions.Proficient in presenting trends and insights to relevant stakeholders, both internal and external.Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects within tight deadlines across different time zones.Bachelor’s degree and minimum two years of related work experience; or equivalent work experience

Whats In It For You

Working at CoStar Group means you'll enjoy a culture of collaboration and innovation that attracts the best and brightest across a broad range of disciplines. As well as having an outstanding working environment, equipped to help you to be your best, other perks include full private medical cover, dental cover, Life Assurance and member rewards, 28 days annual leave, a competitive pension, season ticket loans, enhanced maternity and paternity pay and much more!

At CoStar, we recognise the positive value of diversity and promote equality. We aim at all times to recruit the person who is most suited to the job and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds including but not limited to; people of all genders, of all ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, nationalities, religions and beliefs.

rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Dynamo AI
Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.
The RoleOur PMs each own a set of business problems, such as getting AI agents approved for production, reducing the effort legal and compliance teams spend on guardrails, or lowering the cost of running guardrails at scale. Almost every one of these problems depends on evidence: whether an approach works, how well, and at what cost. Product Analysts produce that evidence.Working with the PM who owns a problem, you take a specific question within it and own the answer. You scope the question, design the experiment or prototype, define how success is measured, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation the PM can act on. When building is faster than waiting, that includes standing up a quick tool with AI to test an idea. You may support several PMs as priorities shift.Training and infrastructure code is handled by our engineering and research teams. Your contribution is experimental design, prototyping and analytical rigor.
What You Might Work OnGuardrail creation and upkeep: design and curate the data used to train and accept custom guardrails, keep labeling consistent as datasets grow, and measure whether updates made from production errors improve performance without regressions.Control coverage: benchmark detection against new attack techniques, languages and modalities, and scope what closing each gap would take.Evaluation evidence: assess whether synthetic evaluation and red-teaming data is faithful and diverse enough for customers' approvers to trust, and research new ways to evaluate AI applications and agents.Cost and performance: compare guardrail and orchestration configurations on accuracy, latency and inference cost.Alerting: prototype ways to aggregate and prioritize guardrail alerts, and measure their effect on the workload of security analysts.Workflow prototypes: build and test prototypes of new workflows, such as how legal and compliance reviewers contribute to guardrail policies or how customers onboard an application on their own, and measure the time and effort they take.Rapid tooling: build small custom tools with AI to validate a hypothesis or unblock the team.Benchmarking and reporting: measure performance with standard classification metrics (FNR, FPR, precision, recall) and report what is working and what is not.
Growth PathYou will start on well-scoped questions and move to harder, more ambiguous ones. Over time you will build intuition for SLM training, guardrail orchestration, agent security and how controls fit into a full AI application, along with an understanding of how our customers make approval decisions. This is a track toward a Product Manager or senior technical product role.
RequirementsA degree with strong quantitative or analytical content. We are especially interested in less common backgrounds, such as physics, information or data theory, and business, alongside solid data analysis experience.A clear, demonstrated framework for thinking through problems.Good instincts for data, ML concepts, and what makes an experiment or metric trustworthy.Python and pandas for working with data.Interest in AI security or safety, and in adversarial thinking.Attention to detail and clear writing, including the ability to turn results into a recommendation a PM can act on.
Nice to HaveML coursework, or coursework or projects in statistics or NLP.Reading or working proficiency in Japanese, Chinese or a European language.SQL.A habit of building small tools or scripts, including with AI assistants, to answer your own questions.Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, security tooling, experimental design or annotation work.
Why Join UsProduce the evidence behind product decisions across every Dynamo product.Work on AI security and governance problems that enterprises are facing for the first time.Grow toward a product role at a founder-led startup.Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.
