The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Data Support is a global team that turns The Trade Desk's proprietary data into custom and syndicated segments and insights that clients can activate with confidence. The segments we build power campaigns reaching millions of consumers across the open internet — and the data decisions we support shape how some of the world's largest brands reach their audiences. We maintain the health and integrity of TTD's data marketplace — ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and reliable — and we partner with internal and external stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

We operate as a Dual Impact Team: our time is split between client-facing service — proactive and reactive client work — and internal enablement, including building tools, improving processes, and supporting stakeholders across the business. We thrive when we learn fast, remain humble, and hold ourselves to the highest standard of both technical excellence and premium service delivery.

We are part of a multinational team within the world's leading, independent buying platform for digital advertising, with regional teams across North America, APAC, and EMEA.

What you’ll do:


Build custom segments for The Trade Desk's clients for use within our data management platform, ensuring accuracy, data quality, and policy compliance throughout.Spend meaningful time writing and running SQL to extract, analyze, and validate data across TTD data systems — combining large data sets, interpreting results, and turning findings into optimization strategies and custom segment solutions.QA segment builds and data outputs for accuracy and compliance before delivery; troubleshoot technical issues independently and document findings clearly, escalating with full context when needed.Evaluate each request against TTD ad policy standards — including sensitive categories, advertiser verticals, and geographic requirements — and escalate anything ambiguous before proceeding.Build, maintain, and improve automations, scripts, and workflows that support segment creation and data operations — owning accuracy, checks and balances, and process efficiency across cross-functional and cross-regional teams.Act as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for stakeholders — guiding segment strategy, data best practices, and audience design, communicating proactively, and delivering high-ownership service from intake to completion.Own client and internal requests end-to-end in Salesforce — from intake through resolution — troubleshooting and escalating when needed while maintaining documentation clear enough for any team member to pick up at any point.Work daily alongside teammates and stakeholders across North America, APAC, and EMEA — adapting your communication style to different audiences and levels of technical expertise, coordinating cross-regional handoffs, and building trusted working relationships across cultures and time zones.Contribute to the team's knowledge base through accurate documentation of team systems, processes, and domain knowledge — and serve as a subject matter expert for data analysis methods and tools.Act as a connector between Data Support and other TTD teams to resolve data and segment-related issues, and contribute to internal enablement work — process improvement, tooling, and cross-functional projects — as business needs evolve.

Judi Health is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry's first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

At Judi Health, we're deploying the infrastructure our country needs to deliver the healthcare we all deserve. We are the intelligence platform powering benefits plans for millions of Americans and proudly leading the next generation of care. To learn more, visit www.judi.health.

This role focuses on the technical aspects of data integration, file transformation, error resolution, and ongoing monitoring of data feeds for medical, dental, and vision claims. Data Quality & Validation

Monitoring & Support

Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to optimize and automate data exchange processes, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort Stay current with industry best practices, new technologies, and regulatory requirements related to healthcare data exchange 

Reporting & Analysis

Generate reports on data exchange performance, error rates, and key metricsAnalyze data trends to identify potential issues or areas for improvementAnalyze data trends to identify potential issues or areas for improvementParticipate in projects with Data Exchange impacts including vendor changes, client migrations, and client add-on requests Responsible for adherence to the Capital Rx Code of Conduct including reporting of noncompliance.

 Ready to grow high-value client relationships through tailored wealth solutions? 

 Why HSBC 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

 The Opportunity 

As a Wealth Relationship Manager, you’ll work closely with a Wealth Relationship Officer and service teams to build meaningful relationships with high-value clients. The role focuses on acquiring, developing, advising and retaining a portfolio through strong fundamentals in wealth planning. You’ll provide solutions across banking, investments and insurance based on each client’s objectives, risk tolerance and appropriate asset allocations. Success means deepening relationships, increasing wallet share and building a strong pipeline through referrals and community connections. You’ll also partner with Compliance, Credit and Risk and Internal Control to support a balanced risk operating environment.

What You'll Be Doing

 Provide financial solutions and opportunities across a portfolio of high-value clients  Increase wallet share within existing relationships and identify product opportunities  Conduct full needs assessments and recommend banking, investment and insurance solutions aligned to objectives and risk tolerance  Build asset allocation recommendations that reflect each client’s goals and suitability considerations  Develop and maintain an active prospect pipeline to support portfolio growth  Represent HSBC in community organizations and activities to strengthen visibility and referral networks  Partner with service teams and the Wealth Relationship Officer to deliver a joined-up client experience  Coordinate with Compliance, Credit and Risk and Internal Control to maintain a balanced risk operating environment 

What We're Looking For

 FINRA Series 7 and 66 (or 63 and 65) licensing required  Life and Health insurance licenses or willing to sponsor  Bring meaningful experience in non-traditional banking financial sales including making client recommendations and increasing sales  Apply expert knowledge of wealth planning and wealth products in client conversations and solutions  Interpret macroeconomic, microeconomic and local market developments and apply insights to client needs  Use knowledge of Anti Money Laundering and relevant US regulatory governance in day-to-day activities  Work within the external regulatory framework relevant to wealth management  Deliver needs-based solutions using effective communication, influencing and sales skills  Strengthen relationships within an existing client base to build referrals and deepen engagement  Build business through centers of influence (COIs) and self-sourced opportunities  Partner effectively with Compliance, Credit and Risk and Internal Control to support risk-balanced outcomes 

 Growing meaningful wealth relationships 

This role offers the opportunity to shape outcomes for high-value clients through thoughtful, need-based advice across banking, investments and insurance. You’ll build long-term relationships, expand existing connections and create new opportunities through referrals and community presence. If you’re looking to apply your wealth planning expertise in a role focused on deepening client relationships and building portfolio growth, this is a chance to make that impact at HSBC.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. rows.descriptionText:
Who are Coolr?

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, and Harvest Snaps (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world. The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started… In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the US, the UK, and beyond.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Analyst to join our US team and turn social and influencer performance data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll analyse campaign, organic, influencer and community data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into strategic recommendations for clients.

Working closely with our strategy and client teams, you’ll develop reporting, measurement frameworks and test-and-learn plans, while building real-time dashboards to streamline performance tracking.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social, data and strategy, and wants to turn numbers into stories that drive better creative and business decisions.

The job 💻

Role

Every role at Coolr plays a vital part in the work we do. Here are some of the key areas of responsibility for this role:

Collating and processing high volumes of social-first performance data (Engagement, Views, CTR, CPM, etc.)Monitoring and reporting on performance for social-first campaigns, always-on organic content activity, influencer partnerships and community engagementDistilling clear actions and insight from the data, making strategic recommendations, optimization plans, and presenting findings in a clear, client-facing presentations and reportsCrafting clear performance analysis and narratives in reportingClosely working alongside a team of strategists to develop qualitative and quantitative research for both current clients and new business prospectsCreating automated social dashboards to help aid and manage reporting across the agency. These will be client specific and update in real time to pull results efficientlyDeveloping measurement frameworks and test and learn plans that define ‘which metrics matter’ based on client goals, allowing optimizations and strategic pivots to be grounded in dataCreating data driven insights for the agency as well as working these into white papers and articles for the agency to publish with external media sources

What we are looking for 👀

Skills

Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:

Experience in an analyst or insights role within an agencyHighly skilled in Excel (Pivot tables, custom formulas)Experienced in building custom audience segments in Consumer Insights platforms (Global Web Index, MRI Simmons, etc.) and the analysis of the data against hypotheses.Proficient with a wide suite of social reporting platforms (Brandwatch, Sprout, Sprinklr, Amplify, Meltwater, Talkwater etc.)Proficient with native social media reporting tools (Meta Ads manager, Facebook Ads manager, TikTok insights etc.)Passionate about social media, brands, and the world of communicationUp to date with latest news and trends that are going on in the industryAble to work to tight deadlinesCurious about brands, culture, data and how the three interact

A Coolr Offer

Benefits

We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:

💰 Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

🤸‍♂️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

🌴 Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

🎉 Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

💆 Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

➕ Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

♣ Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $70,000 to $85,000, based on your experience and level.

The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

Coolr DE&I 🌎

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

rows.title: Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI is seeking a Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer who will be a key member of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team, providing advanced operational support, platform maintenance, incident management, and continuous improvement for the enterprise VMware virtualization environment.

The role supports a highly available, business-critical virtualization platform currently based on VMware Cloud Foundation 8 (VCF 8) and will actively participate in the planned migration and transition to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9).

Working as part of a regional and global infrastructure support organization, the engineer is responsible for maintaining platform stability, availability, performance, security, and operational readiness. The position provides Tier 2/3 technical support, participates in the 24×7×365 on-call rotation, troubleshoots complex infrastructure incidents, performs lifecycle and patching activities, and contributes to automation and AI-enabled operational improvements.

The environment includes VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, vRealize Log Insight (VRLI), vRealize Network Insight (VRNI), and associated enterprise storage and networking technologies.

This position is located in the New York, NY or Jersey City, NJ area (Hybrid)

Your future duties and responsibilities

Platform Support & Maintenance

 Provide Tier 2/3 operational support for the VMware virtualization platform as part of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team. Maintain the existing VCF 8 environment and participate in the planning, testing, migration, and operational transition to VCF 9. Support and maintain VMware technologies including vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform routine platform health checks, troubleshooting, maintenance, configuration changes, and lifecycle management activities. Monitor platform availability, capacity, performance, and infrastructure health to ensure services meet established SLAs. Work within established architecture, engineering, security, and operational standards.

Incident & Problem Management

 Respond to production incidents and service requests involving VMware virtualization infrastructure. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for compute, storage, networking, performance, and availability issues. Participate in major incident management and collaborate with application, network, storage, security, and other infrastructure teams to restore services. Document incidents, root causes, corrective actions, known errors, and operational procedures. Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem-management initiatives designed to eliminate or reduce repeat failures. Escalate complex product issues to VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors as required.

VCF 8 to VCF 9 Migration

 Participate as a technical member of the team responsible for migrating the existing VCF 8 platform to VCF 9. Support readiness assessments, compatibility reviews, upgrade planning, testing, implementation, and post-migration validation. Assist with migration activities while minimizing service disruption and maintaining compliance with enterprise security standards. Validate platform health, application connectivity, performance, monitoring, backup, and operational processes following migration activities. Develop and update operational documentation and support procedures for the VCF 9 environment.

Monitoring & Capacity Management

 Configure, maintain, and tune monitoring thresholds, alarms, dashboards, and reporting within Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform proactive monitoring to identify capacity, availability, latency, and performance issues before they impact production services. Review infrastructure utilization and recommend VM rightsizing and capacity optimization opportunities. Support capacity planning across compute, memory, storage, and network resources. Participate in the implementation of anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and intelligent capacity-management capabilities.

Automation & Operational Improvement

 Develop and maintain automation using PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Automate repetitive operational activities including health checks, provisioning, patching, reporting, configuration validation, and lifecycle management. Maintain and improve automated operational runbooks and remediation procedures. Contribute to self-healing capabilities for well-understood infrastructure events where automated remediation can be implemented safely. Explore and implement practical AI-assisted operations capabilities, including incident triage, alert correlation, log analysis, knowledge retrieval, and root cause analysis. Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve platform reliability and support efficiency.

Change, Release & Lifecycle Management

 Participate in change and release management activities for the VMware virtualization environment. Perform VMware software upgrades, firmware updates, security patches, and infrastructure maintenance through approved change processes. Develop implementation, validation, rollback, and recovery procedures for infrastructure changes. Ensure changes comply with enterprise standards, security requirements, and VMware recommended practices. Participate in maintenance windows and after-hours implementation activities when required.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

 Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for workloads hosted on the virtualization platform. Participate in scheduled DR exercises and document results, issues, and remediation actions. Support platform capabilities required to meet established business RPO and RTO requirements, including critical workload targets of RPO ≤ 5 seconds and RTO ≤ 15 minutes, where applicable. Maintain operational documentation and recovery procedures required to support business continuity.

Operational Support

 Participate in the 24×7 on-call support rotation for production virtualization services. Perform morning and end-of-day platform health checks using dashboards, monitoring platforms, and automated scripts. Investigate infrastructure alerts and take appropriate corrective or escalation actions. Support OS, hypervisor, firmware, storage, and VMware platform patching activities. Maintain accurate support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to other members of the infrastructure support team.

Collaboration & Service Management

 Work closely with application owners and infrastructure teams to understand requirements and support the delivery of standardized virtual infrastructure services. Collaborate with networking, storage, security, backup, cloud, and hardware teams to troubleshoot cross-platform issues. Coordinate with VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors for technical support, product defects, upgrades, and complex incidents. Work with regional and global IT teams to maintain consistent platform standards and operational processes. Support the virtualization service catalogue and provide input into service consumption, capacity, cost, and performance reviews.

Reporting & Governance

 Provide operational reporting covering platform availability, incidents, capacity, performance, SLA compliance, patching, and infrastructure health. Contribute to dashboards and metrics used by infrastructure management to evaluate service performance. Track automation benefits, operational improvements, capacity savings, and incident trends. Participate in operational reviews, problem-management meetings, change reviews, and service improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 10+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 5–7+ years of hands-on VMware experience supporting large-scale environments using technologies such as vSphere 8+, VMware Cloud Foundation, NSX-T, and vSAN. Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting production VMware environments. Experience participating in VMware platform upgrades or migrations, preferably involving VMware Cloud Foundation. Experience supporting an existing VCF 8 environment and/or migration to VCF 9 is highly desirable. Strong troubleshooting skills across virtualization, compute, storage, networking, and operating-system layers. Strong automation skills using technologies such as PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Hands-on experience with Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI or equivalent monitoring, logging, and network-visibility platforms. Solid understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, iSCSI, vSAN, and platforms such as Dell/EMC, Isilon, Pure Storage, and NetApp. Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, load balancing, and NSX-T concepts such as micro-segmentation and distributed firewalls. Experience working within formal incident, problem, change, and release management processes. Understanding of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patching, and VMware security-hardening practices. Experience with AI/AIOps concepts such as anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, alert correlation, automated RCA, and intelligent capacity forecasting is desirable. Experience identifying VM rightsizing, capacity optimization, and infrastructure cost-reduction opportunities. Ability to troubleshoot complex production incidents under time-sensitive conditions. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regional and global technical teams. Ability to participate in a 24×7 production support/on-call rotation. Strong organizational skills with experience working in Agile and/or ITIL-based operational environments.

Desired Certifications & Skills

 VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification. VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Cloud Management and Automation certification. Advanced VMware certification such as VCAP is desirable. ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional. Experience with Aria Operations APIs and custom automation. Experience developing operational dashboards, automated health checks, and infrastructure reporting. Exposure to AIOps, LLM-assisted operations, ChatOps, or automated incident-management solutions is beneficial.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Other Information:

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $84,900.00 $188,100.00.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Who We Are

At EY, we’re more than just a professional services firm. We’re a global network united by a shared purpose to build a better working world. We empower our people to challenge the status quo, embrace innovation, and deliver lasting impact for our clients and communities.

CT Tech Activation brings together capabilities that help EY identify market demand, shape and commercialize technology offerings, support product delivery, and strengthen customer adoption and outcomes.

You will find a culture that prioritizes learning, collaboration and growth, providing you with the tools, support and freedom to thrive and shape your career.

The Opportunity

The Program Manager will provide dedicated support to the CTO helping translate strategic priorities into coordinated execution across the organization. The role will manage key operational requirements, coordinate cross-functional priorities, drive follow-through, and support the effective delivery of strategic initiatives and organizational capabilities.

This role requires a proactive, highly organized and strategically minded individual who can operate with discretion, work effectively with senior stakeholders, and bring structure and clarity to complex priorities. The Program Manager will serve as an integrator, advisor and execution partner, connecting work across teams, establishing effective operating rhythms, identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring commitments progress from decision through execution.

Description

About MCM

MCM (Modern Creation München) is a luxury lifestyle goods and fashion house founded in 1976 with an attitude defined by cultural Zeitgeist and German heritage. Position Overview

The CRM Coordinator supports MCM’s global CRM and clienteling operations, with a primary focus on the Americas and support for multi-region initiatives and platform rollouts. This hands-on role keeps CRM running day to day: building client segments, safeguarding data quality, serving as first-line support for clienteling and CRM tools, and producing the reporting that shows how client programs perform. Working closely with Retail, Business Intelligence, Digital, Learning & Development, IT, and global CRM partners, the CRM Coordinator helps turn client data into action for store teams, executing outreach tied to product launches, seasonal moments, and client development programs. The ideal candidate is organized, data-minded, and service-oriented, and is energized by making tools and processes work better for the people who use them.

support data governance and client consent practices in line with applicable privacy laws and company policy so client data remains accurate and compliant.Own recurring CRM performance reporting in partnership with the Business Intelligence team, tracking KPIs such as client retention, reactivation, outreach and appointments, data capture, platform adoption, and campaign ROI; flag trends and data-quality issues and recommend corrective actions.Monitor CRM and clienteling adoption across stores and recommend actions to strengthen engagement and operational efficiency.Participate in user acceptance testing for new integrations, data flows, campaigns, and platform enhancements, providing hands-on feedback before rollout.Maintain CRM process documentation, user guides, and standard operating procedures so knowledge is accessible, current, and transferable.Partner with Learning & Development to train store teams on CRM tools and new features, and support onboarding new hires to client-facing systems.Collaborate with Retail, Merchandising, Digital, Business Intelligence, and global CRM teams to align campaigns with brand objectives and ensure consistency across markets.Partner with stores, customer service, and Voice of Customer teams to gather client feedback and integrate insights into CRM strategies.

SUMMARY The medical receptionist will assist the department with coordination of the daily operations of the front desk, and other duties to ensure efficient work flow and patient care.

Schedule patient appointments and remind the patients of any necessary documentation that may be required for their appointment. Schedule any services or procedures as needed. Obtain/retrieve referrals/authorizations/eligibility verification that may be required. Telephone patients if there is a change in the physician’s schedule and/or if the patient’s appointment needs to be rescheduled. Keep office supplies adequately stocked by anticipating inventory needs and placing orders or advising office manager of items needed. Ensure HIPAA guidelines are followed at all times. Provide additional coverage for night hours and weekend, as needed. Updating and maintaining integrity of client information.Perform all other duties as assigned by management.

High School diploma/GED. Strong organizational and communication skills (both verbal and written).Excellent typing skills and friendly telephone etiquette.

About The TeamBusiness Insights is the analytics function at the center of how Jitsu runs. We own the numbers the business makes decisions on operational performance, pricing, unit economics and the daily dashboards the operations team works from.We sit close to the decision. An analysis here is not a slide that gets filed; it changes a price, a route, a staffing plan or a target the same week. The team is small, which means you will own real questions early.This role is new headcount. We are adding it because demand for analysis is outpacing what the team can turn around, and because we want someone who will grow into owning a domain of their own.
What You'll DoAnswer business questions with data. Pull, join and interrogate data across our warehouse to answer questions from operations, finance and leadership, and know when the answer you found is wrong.Build and run daily operational dashboards. Own a set of dashboards the operations team opens every morning: keep them accurate, keep them fast, and improve what they show as the business changes.Support pricing and financial analysis. Model margin and unit economics, test pricing scenarios, and help quantify the trade-offs behind pricing and commercial decisions.Contribute to strategic analysis. Size opportunities, build the analysis behind planning and market questions, and pressure-test assumptions before they become commitments.Turn analysis into a recommendation. Write up what you found in plain language, with the number that matters up front and a clear view of what you would do about it.Improve how we work. Automate the recurring pulls, document the definitions, and make the next version of every analysis faster than the last.Work directly with stakeholders. Sit with operations, finance and commercial teams to scope the real question behind the request.

You can work through a dataset and get to a defensible answer. SQL experience is ideal; if you have not used SQL but have done real analytical work in Python, R or Excel, we will teach you.Quantitative judgement. You notice when a number looks wrong, and you check it before you send it.Clear communication. You can explain a result to someone who was not in the analysis, without jargon.Genuine appetite to learn. This is the single thing we screen hardest for. The tools and the domain you can pick up; the drive to pick them up quickly, you bring.Comfort in a fast-paced environment. Priorities shift, questions arrive half-formed, and the answer is often needed this week. You need to be able to work with ambiguity rather than wait for it to resolve.Ownership. You follow a question through to the decision it informs, rather than handing off a spreadsheet and moving on.
Nice to haveWorking SQL against a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.)A BI tool: Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase or similarPython or R for analysis, or experience building a repeatable data pipelineFinancial modelling, unit economics or pricing exposureAny experience in logistics, delivery, marketplaces or another operations-heavy businessA portfolio, GitHub, or a personal project where you analyzed something because you were curious about it

rows.title: Business Operations Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The role

Tenex embeds engineering pods inside Fortune 500 companies to build and ship AI systems. Our AI Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers work directly with client teams from the first week of an engagement, which means every person we hire has to be capable of representing us in a senior client environment almost immediately. We are growing from 50 people to 150. That is approximately 100 hires, and the majority of them are Strategist and Engineer roles with a high bar and a competitive market. Hiring is currently the most important and most difficult constraint on this business. It determines which engagements we can win, how well we deliver them, and how quickly we can grow. Nothing else we do matters if we cannot consistently find and assess the right people. We will not reach 150 people by repeating the process that got us to 50. This role exists to build a hiring process that is repeatable, measurable, and fast enough to support that growth, and then to run it. You will own the top of the funnel and candidate screening. That means you will source candidates, run outreach, conduct first round conversations, and determine who moves forward in the process. This is an entry level role with an unusual amount of responsibility. You will speak with more candidates in your first year than most recruiters do in three, and your assessments will directly influence who we hire. 

What you will own

Sourcing and outreach

You will identify and source candidates from MBB firms, Big 4 consultancies, Palantir, and AI-native companies, and you will develop new sources as the existing ones are exhausted. You will write and run outbound campaigns over LinkedIn and email, and you will own the quality of that writing rather than sending templates someone else wrote. You will test messaging variants against one another, measure reply and conversion rates, and discontinue approaches that do not perform. 

Screening

You will conduct first round conversations with candidates across both the Strategist and Forward Deployed Engineer tracks, which requires you to understand what strong performance looks like in each. You will assess candidates against our rubrics for technical depth, client presence, and ownership, and you will help improve those rubrics as you learn where they produce the wrong answer. You will make screening recommendations and explain your reasoning to hiring managers, including in the cases where they initially disagree with your read. 

Hiring data

You will own our hiring metrics, including pass through rates by stage and by source, time to offer, offer acceptance rate, and the points in the process where candidates most often withdraw. You will present those numbers in weekly hiring reviews and recommend specific changes based on what they show, rather than reporting them and waiting for direction. 

Process and documentation

You will maintain our compressed one week interview loop as candidate volume increases, which becomes meaningfully harder as more interviewers and more open roles enter the process. You will document what works clearly enough that the next person we add to this team can execute it without your involvement. You will identify the points where the process slows down or produces inconsistent outcomes, and you will propose and implement fixes. 

Forward planning

You will build candidate relationships for roles we expect to open in the next two quarters, not only for roles that are open today. 

Career progression

We want to be direct about how this role is intended to develop, because it is a significant part of what makes it worth taking. This is not a permanent recruiting role. We are hiring you into talent because talent is the largest constraint on the business right now, and we need someone capable to own it. After approximately twelve to eighteen months, assuming you have built a process that runs reliably and can be handed to someone else, we expect to move you into whatever the largest constraint on the business is at that time. We cannot tell you today what that will be. Based on where the company is heading, the most likely areas are delivery operations, finance and revenue operations, client operations, or a role directly supporting our commercial function. What we can commit to is that we will move you toward the hardest available problem rather than leaving you in a role you have already solved. That is the basis on which we expect you to join, and it is how we intend to develop the people in this seat. 

What we are looking for

You have between zero and two years of full time experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply, and we are more interested in how you think and communicate than in where you have previously worked. You write clearly and persuasively, because the majority of your first interactions with candidates will happen in writing and the quality of that writing determines whether they respond at all. You are comfortable being given an incomplete brief and working out the rest independently, and you will ask for direction when you need it rather than stalling. You can build a funnel model in a spreadsheet without needing to be taught how, and you are comfortable defending the assumptions behind it. You can sustain a high volume of conversations and frequent rejection, both from candidates who decline us and from candidates you have to decline. You have genuine interest in AI and in what separates a strong engineer or strategist from an average one, because you cannot accurately screen for capabilities you do not understand yourself. You will hold a defensible position when a more senior person disagrees with your assessment of a candidate, and you will change your position when they give you a better argument. 

What this role is not

This is not a coordination role centered on scheduling and interview logistics. This is not a role with an established process waiting for you to execute. You will be building the process while the company is actively using it, which is more demanding and more interesting than the alternative. This is not a remote role. Our team works from our New York office, and the screening work benefits substantially from proximity to the hiring managers you support.

rows.title: Marketing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Ecosuite We build technology to Accelerate Distributed Energy.
Ecosuite is changing the way the distributed energy industry connects and collaborates. We offer award winning energy data infrastructure and digital tools to help our customers enhance how they deploy and manage electricity assets. 
Ecosuite's industry leading edge-compute hardware and software platform delivers essential connectivity, data, intelligence, control, and virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities to solar and battery system owners - maximizing performance and financial returns. We serve corporations, municipalities, independent power producers, developers, O&M providers, and utilities, including some of the largest brands in the world. 
Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by eliminating friction across the ecosystem. Our values include open-source computing, data-driven methodology, open access to data and industry-wide growth.We are looking for awesome people to help shape the future of the energy industry and our team.
The TeamThe Business Development team drives how Ecosuite expands its customer base - selling Edge Compute Nodes (ECNs) and software subscriptions to solar and battery project owners, and building strategic partnerships across O&M providers, contract manufacturers, utilities. The team owns each initiative end-to-end, including marketing prospecting, lead generation and sales. 
The RoleWe're hiring a Marketing Analyst to own content, campaigns, and event execution for Ecosuite - turning our technology and customer wins into the stories, materials, and touchpoints that move buyers through a technical B2B sales cycle. You'll work closely with the Business Development team and report to the CEO.This role is about organizing and creating written content, planning and running campaigns, executing events and brand building via effective storytelling. Some basic creative but there will be support for visual assets.Content (top priority)Write new content that highlights our technology and customer success stories, translating technical concepts (edge compute, software platform, O&M benefits, mobile experience, VPPs, Predictive ML, AI applications) into clear, compelling narratives.Develop messaging and sales enablement materials for new product rollouts.Own and organize our content library - website copy, case studies, whitepapers, blog posts, LinkedIn posts, and sales collateral - so the team can find and reuse what already exists more effectively.Keep website copy current and aligned with campaigns and product updates.Campaigns (top priority)Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns - email, LinkedIn, and other channels - that generate leads and move prospects through the funnel.Partner with sales and leadership on positioning and campaign strategy, then take campaigns from plan to execution. Leverage existing internal tools (ie. Ecosuite’s Internal Growth Stack, Salesflare, Social Champ, LinkedIn etc.) and research/implement new tools to accelerate impact.Events (top priority)Own planning and logistics for industry events, trade shows, and virtual webinars - registration, material prep, follow-up, and on-the-ground coordination.Coordinate Ecosuite's presence and messaging at events like RE+, NYSEIA, SolarPlaza Asset Management Summit etc.Analytics, Pipeline & Market Research (supporting)Track and report on sales and marketing KPIs most relevant to our sales motion - e.g. marketing content engagement, campaign performance, qualified calls, product demos, quotes delivered. Categorize by buying persona and user category: asset manager, developer, financier, O&M, grid operator. Maintain and organize pipeline data in Salesflare to help leadership spot bottlenecks and speed up the sales cycle.Monitor DER and B2B SaaS industry trends and competitor positioning, and flag opportunities.
What You BringExperience: 1–3 years in marketing, GTM, or content roles. B2B SaaS or clean-tech experience is a strong plus. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).Writing & storytelling: Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of turning technical subject matter into clear, engaging content.Organization: Comfortable owning a content calendar, campaign timeline, and event logistics simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.Analytical comfort: Able to work with CRM and marketing analytics tools to track performance and report out clearly. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be comfortable with numbers as well as leveraging AI to empower human first engagements.Initiative: Self-motivated and resourceful; you can move a project forward without constant direction, in a fast-paced startup environment.Industry interest: Genuine interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy technology - you don't need a technical background, but you should be motivated to learn the space.
What This Role Is NotA graphic design or creative production role - we brief a freelance designer/agency for visual asset creation.A pure data-analytics role - reporting supports content, campaign, and event decisions, not the other way around.
Why Join Ecosuite?Impact: Your content and campaigns will directly support the sale of technology backed by DOE, NREL, Sandia, Stony Brook University and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory partnerships - real infrastructure accelerating the energy transition.Product: You'll help launch messaging for new AI-driven features like Foresight (predictive forecasting) the Playground (vibe-coding for DERs) and STEVIE (AI assistant) as they roll out.Visibility: You'll work closely with leadership and Business Development, with direct input into how Ecosuite is positioned across the DER industry.Growth: Room to grow scope as we scale - this role can expand toward campaign strategy, brand, growth, sales or analytics ownership over time.
How to ApplySend your resume, 2–3 writing samples (blog posts, case studies, or campaign materials you've created), and a short note on what draws you to the energy transition to recruiting@ecosuite.io

Ecosuite is changing the way the distributed energy industry connects and collaborates. We offer award winning energy data infrastructure and digital tools to help our customers enhance how they deploy and manage electricity assets. 
Ecosuite's industry leading edge-compute hardware and software platform delivers essential connectivity, data, intelligence, control, and virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities to solar and battery system owners - maximizing performance and financial returns. We serve corporations, municipalities, independent power producers, developers, O&M providers, and utilities, including some of the largest brands in the world. 
Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by eliminating friction across the ecosystem. Our values include open-source computing, data-driven methodology, open access to data and industry-wide growth.We are looking for awesome people to help shape the future of the energy industry and our team.
The TeamThe Business Development team drives how Ecosuite expands its customer base - selling Edge Compute Nodes (ECNs) and software subscriptions to solar and battery project owners, and building strategic partnerships across O&M providers, contract manufacturers, utilities. The team owns each initiative end-to-end, including marketing prospecting, lead generation and sales. 
The RoleWe're hiring a Marketing Analyst to own content, campaigns, and event execution for Ecosuite - turning our technology and customer wins into the stories, materials, and touchpoints that move buyers through a technical B2B sales cycle. Leverage existing internal tools (ie. Ecosuite’s Internal Growth Stack, Salesflare, Social Champ, LinkedIn etc.) and research/implement new tools to accelerate impact.Events (top priority)Own planning and logistics for industry events, trade shows, and virtual webinars - registration, material prep, follow-up, and on-the-ground coordination.Coordinate Ecosuite's presence and messaging at events like RE+, NYSEIA, SolarPlaza Asset Management Summit etc.Analytics, Pipeline & Market Research (supporting)Track and report on sales and marketing KPIs most relevant to our sales motion - e.g. marketing content engagement, campaign performance, qualified calls, product demos, quotes delivered. Categorize by buying persona and user category: asset manager, developer, financier, O&M, grid operator. Maintain and organize pipeline data in Salesflare to help leadership spot bottlenecks and speed up the sales cycle.Monitor DER and B2B SaaS industry trends and competitor positioning, and flag opportunities.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).Writing & storytelling: Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of turning technical subject matter into clear, engaging content.Organization: Comfortable owning a content calendar, campaign timeline, and event logistics simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.Analytical comfort: Able to work with CRM and marketing analytics tools to track performance and report out clearly. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be comfortable with numbers as well as leveraging AI to empower human first engagements.Initiative: Self-motivated and resourceful; you can move a project forward without constant direction, in a fast-paced startup environment.Industry interest: Genuine interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy technology - you don't need a technical background, but you should be motivated to learn the space.

rows.descriptionText:
Holly is the HR platform built for city and county government. We help local governments modernize how they hire, classify, and manage their workforce — work that directly shapes public services for millions of people. Our platform is live across 12 states with 70+ jurisdictions representing over 10% of the US population, including major counties like Santa Clara and Contra Costa in the Bay Area, Orange County in LA, and Snohomish County in Washington State. Demand is outpacing our team, and we're building to meet it.

Holly is a seed-stage team of 25+ operators with deep roots in public service, civic tech, and AI. We’ve raised $10M from leading investors in government technology and the future of work and have grown over 100X in the last year. We center public servants and impact in every decision and we bring that same care to how we work here at Holly.

About The Opportunity

Holly is looking for a Data Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day health and integrity of our data.

You'll sit in the Engineering org and be active as the connective tissue between engineering and the Deployments team, making sure the information flowing through our systems is accurate, available, and governed appropriately.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll spend your time writing SQL queries to clean data, building dashboards in Metabase, and in the operational tooling that keeps our pipelines running. This role is a strong fit for someone who is rigorous about data quality, comfortable owning process end to end, and interested in building a data function rather than inheriting one.

What You'll Do

Own how data gets in. Public records requests, agency outreach, general collection and extraction. You set the cadence, track what's outstanding, and collaborate with the deployment team to ensure client launches are set-up with the right data. This will include getting on the phone and talking to agencies as well when data is missing.Run the pipeline day to day. Monitor runs, resolve failures and reruns, and configure schedules, connections, and settings as data sources change.Own data quality end to end. Build the validation checks and monitoring that catch problems early, investigate the ones that get through to root cause, and drive fixes with engineering. When a client flags something that looks wrong, you diagnose it, fix it or route it, and tell them what happened.Own Metabase and the analytics work that runs on it. Dashboards, saved questions, permissions, and shared metric definitions, so the teams asking the same question get the same number. Engineering, product, and Deployments come to you for an operational question answered, an output audited, or reporting that they can run on their own. Do the work once, then turn repeating work into tooling. Find the repetitive work and remove it, whether that's an AI workflow you build yourself, a vendor, or a well-written ticket to engineering. Leave behind documentation, operational runbooks, and data dictionaries for the whole team + future of the data org. 

Who You Are

You're strong in SQL. Complex joins don't bother you, and when a query returns something surprising you find out why instead of moving on. You've administered a BI tool before, whether that's Metabase, Looker, or Tableau.You’re naturally process-driven. You catch the error in row 4,000 and have a track record of building documentation and standards.You can manage projects and drive results. You’re capable of getting stuff done with teammates and collaborators across time zones, while keeping stakeholders consistently and clearly informed. You write clearly, manage tightly, and communicate often. You’re AI-native. You use AI in real workflows, are constantly testing new tools, and are the one your friends go to for tips. You’ve been a data wizard before. You have experience in a data operations, data analytics, tech consulting, or business intelligence role. Bonus points for startup / public sector experience. Experience handling sensitive or regulated data is a plus.

What You'll Get

Direct impact – because of your work, real government clients will learn to use the platform for critical projects that will improve the quality and output of the public sectorPlaybook ownership – you're not just executing a playbook, you're writing it. What you learn shapes how Holly scales to 100+ customersCompetitive package – $80K - $110K base with equity, comprehensive health benefits (platinum plan with vision and dental), 401(k) benefits, professional development stipendCollaborative work culture – join a fast-moving, high-trust team of A players that cares about the work and each other

Ready to join us? A few important notes:

Location: NYC at Holly HQWork Philosophy: We’re an early-stage startup serving government clients with real deadlines. There may be occasional off-hours work around launches or critical issues. We value flexibility and trust you to manage your schedule while maintaining a high bar for responsiveness and customer outcomes.Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship. 

Holly is committed to building a diverse company and working with the broadest talent pool possible. We encourage applications from all races, religions, national origins, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expressions, and ages, as well as veterans and individuals with disabilities.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

80,000 - 110,000 USD per year (hq)

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S.

The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client-delivery objectives. The role combines day-to-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield.

About You

The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield.

You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

 Monitor inventory availability, capacity, sellout levels, and utilization across networks, dayparts, programs, and high-profile events. Identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend actions to improve utilization, protect revenue, and support client delivery. Partner closely with Planning teams to ensure proposals, allocations, stewardship decisions, and inventory changes reflect current availability and business priorities. Support management of oversold inventory, preemptions, underdelivery, liability, and other inventory exceptions. Analyze supply and demand trends and provide actionable recommendations to Planning and Sales leadership. Maintain and validate inventory-related data, including capacities, format grids, ratecards, program information, and other inputs used in planning and inventory systems. Support inventory requirements for tentpoles, live sports, and other high-profile programming. Partner with Programming, Traffic, Planning, and Sales Operations to resolve inventory issues and execute approved changes. Use WideOrbit and related systems to manage inventory and support transactional workflows. Leverage reporting, analytics, AI, and automation tools to improve inventory decision-making and reduce manual processes. Review and validate AI-generated inventory recommendations as new optimization capabilities are introduced. Help define business rules and identify exceptions that should inform future automated inventory workflows. Develop a strong understanding of inventory economics and the relationship between pricing, demand, capacity, client commitments, and yield. Document processes and contribute to consistent inventory operating procedures and team knowledge. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects as needed.

YOU HAVE

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in media, advertising, sales operations, inventory, planning, analytics, or a related field preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Strong Excel skills; experience with reporting or data-visualization tools is preferred. Experience with WideOrbit or other advertising sales/traffic systems is a plus. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Data Support is a global team that turns The Trade Desk's proprietary data into custom and syndicated segments and insights that clients can activate with confidence. The segments we build power campaigns reaching millions of consumers across the open internet — and the data decisions we support shape how some of the world's largest brands reach their audiences. We maintain the health and integrity of TTD's data marketplace — ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and reliable — and we partner with internal and external stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

We operate as a Dual Impact Team: our time is split between client-facing service — proactive and reactive client work — and internal enablement, including building tools, improving processes, and supporting stakeholders across the business. We thrive when we learn fast, remain humble, and hold ourselves to the highest standard of both technical excellence and premium service delivery.

We are part of a multinational team within the world's leading, independent buying platform for digital advertising, with regional teams across North America, APAC, and EMEA.

What you’ll do:


Build custom segments for The Trade Desk's clients for use within our data management platform, ensuring accuracy, data quality, and policy compliance throughout.Spend meaningful time writing and running SQL to extract, analyze, and validate data across TTD data systems — combining large data sets, interpreting results, and turning findings into optimization strategies and custom segment solutions.QA segment builds and data outputs for accuracy and compliance before delivery; troubleshoot technical issues independently and document findings clearly, escalating with full context when needed.Evaluate each request against TTD ad policy standards — including sensitive categories, advertiser verticals, and geographic requirements — and escalate anything ambiguous before proceeding.Build, maintain, and improve automations, scripts, and workflows that support segment creation and data operations — owning accuracy, checks and balances, and process efficiency across cross-functional and cross-regional teams.Act as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for stakeholders — guiding segment strategy, data best practices, and audience design, communicating proactively, and delivering high-ownership service from intake to completion.Own client and internal requests end-to-end in Salesforce — from intake through resolution — troubleshooting and escalating when needed while maintaining documentation clear enough for any team member to pick up at any point.Work daily alongside teammates and stakeholders across North America, APAC, and EMEA — adapting your communication style to different audiences and levels of technical expertise, coordinating cross-regional handoffs, and building trusted working relationships across cultures and time zones.Contribute to the team's knowledge base through accurate documentation of team systems, processes, and domain knowledge — and serve as a subject matter expert for data analysis methods and tools.Act as a connector between Data Support and other TTD teams to resolve data and segment-related issues, and contribute to internal enablement work — process improvement, tooling, and cross-functional projects — as business needs evolve.

Who you are:


Bachelor's degree or relevant work experience (0–3 years); a background in data, analytics, marketing technology, or a related field is a plus.Proficient in Excel and MS Office, including pivot tables, charts, and manipulation of large data sets.Able to write and run complex SQL queries, including multiple joins, temp tables, CTEs, CASE WHEN logic, and nested queries.Comfortable engaging with stakeholders at varying levels of technical expertise — you can translate complexity into clarity.Collaborative and effective cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment, with a track record of building strong working relationships at all levels of the organization.Detail-oriented and precise, with a strong commitment to data handling ethics and consumer privacy.Skilled at solving complex technical problems creatively while anticipating stakeholder needs and consistently meeting or exceeding expectations.Comfortable with ambiguity and change — you approach shifting requirements as opportunities rather than obstacles.Comfortable adopting and adapting to new technologies, tools, and coding environments — including platforms like Databricks, Python, and AI-assisted tooling (Copilot, Claude, etc.) — as the tech stack and industry continue to evolve.Strong time manager who can work across functions in a dynamic, solution-oriented environment while meeting deadlines.Self-motivated and innovative; comfortable working independently, but an excellent team player with a growth mindset and a desire to make those around you better.

rows.title: Data Analytics Engineering Intern

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

About This Role

Perchwell is expanding rapidly across the US, and every new MLS client brings a data source we haven't worked with before. Our Data Analytics Engineering team owns what happens next: understanding what is actually in that data, transforming it into our warehouse, and building the intelligence layer that sits on top of it. This summer, you'll work on that alongside our analytics engineers and data engineers, supporting both the MLS customers we serve today and the ones we're onboarding next.

What We’re Looking For

Rising seniors enrolled in a CS, data science, statistics, or other STEM degree program who are looking to intern at a fast paced SaaS company this summer. Passionate problem solvers who thrive in fast moving environments. Strong communicators and team players who can work cross functionally. Careful thinkers who chase down a number that looks wrong instead of passing it along. Eager learners who want to gain real world analytics engineering experience. 

What You’ll Do

Understand New Data: Profile the data we are ingesting for new clients and partner with members of the broader engineering org to identify the most effective patterns for onboarding them into our standard reporting product. Build and Ship: Extend the dbt models that transform raw MLS data into our warehouse, adding the tests and documentation the rest of the team depends on. Build Intelligence: Strengthen the layer that sits on top of the warehouse, including metric definitions, semantic models, and the dashboards internal teams and customers rely on. Own a Project: Take ownership of a summer project, making key modeling, tooling, and implementation decisions. Profiling and mapping a new non MLS data source is one strong candidate. Collaborate and Learn: Partner with analytics engineers, data engineers, product managers, and customer facing teams to turn open questions into answers people can act on. Deliver Impact: Work on scalable solutions from broadly defined problems and see your work in production. 

Why This Internship? 

Dedicated Mentor: You'll work 1:1 with an experienced analytics engineer who will provide mentorship and support your growth. Real Ownership: Over 10 weeks, early June to mid August, you will choose and lead your own project, making key decisions along the way. Fully In Person Experience: This is a full time, in-office internship based at our beautiful New York City HQ in Soho. You'll work on site five days a week and collaborate closely with our team, gaining hands-on experience in a fast paced, learning oriented environment. Showcase Your Work: At the end of the summer, present your project to our executive and data teams. Work on Real Data: Beyond your project, you'll contribute to models, tests, and dashboards running in production against live customer data. NYC Perks and Fun: From team dinners to museum trips, immerse yourself in the greatest city in the world while working with an awesome team. 

Required For The Role

Working familiarity with RDBMS storage systems and SQL, including joins, aggregations, and CTEs. You don't need window functions yet, but you should want to learn them. Curiosity about where data comes from and what it represents, not just how to query it. Attention to detail and an instinct for when something doesn't add up. Strong communication and problem solving abilities. Excitement to learn, grow, and build. 

Bonus Points for the Following

Coursework, projects, or prior internship experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. Exposure to dbt or another transformation framework. An understanding of Python for working with data, such as pandas in coursework or personal projects. Familiarity with Git and version controlled workflows. Experience with a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Mode, or Metabase. Any project, academic or personal, where you took messy source data and made it usable. Demonstrated leadership skills developed during your college experience. 

Internship Information

Internship Dates: June 7 - August 13, 2027

Application Deadline: Applications for this internship close on October 18, 2026, at 11 PM ET. Be sure to apply by the deadline to be considered! We will be reviewing all applications, so please take the time to submit a thoughtful application.

Offers: Internship offers will be extended by November 25, 2026.

Salary Information

$12,000 for 10 weeks (minus applicable taxes and withholdings)

Excited to launch your career with a tech startup in NYC? Apply now and build something meaningful with us in Summer 2027!

Note: Benefits package listed below is for reference only for those who later join Perchwell full-time.

Strong Benefits Package

Flexible PTO, plus 10 paid company holidays401K with a company matchMedical, dental, and vision plansHSA and FSA optionsCommuter benefitsParental leaveCompany-wide onsite or offsite each yearBeautiful office in Soho, Manhattan with a stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch once per week, happy hours and meet-ups

Note: At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S.

rows.title: Social Media Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who are Coolr?

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, and Harvest Snaps (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world. The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started… In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the US, the UK, and beyond.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Analyst to join our US team and turn social and influencer performance data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll analyse campaign, organic, influencer and community data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into strategic recommendations for clients.

Working closely with our strategy and client teams, you’ll develop reporting, measurement frameworks and test-and-learn plans, while building real-time dashboards to streamline performance tracking.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social, data and strategy, and wants to turn numbers into stories that drive better creative and business decisions.

The job 💻

Role

Every role at Coolr plays a vital part in the work we do. Here are some of the key areas of responsibility for this role:

Collating and processing high volumes of social-first performance data (Engagement, Views, CTR, CPM, etc.)Monitoring and reporting on performance for social-first campaigns, always-on organic content activity, influencer partnerships and community engagementDistilling clear actions and insight from the data, making strategic recommendations, optimization plans, and presenting findings in a clear, client-facing presentations and reportsCrafting clear performance analysis and narratives in reportingClosely working alongside a team of strategists to develop qualitative and quantitative research for both current clients and new business prospectsCreating automated social dashboards to help aid and manage reporting across the agency. These will be client specific and update in real time to pull results efficientlyDeveloping measurement frameworks and test and learn plans that define ‘which metrics matter’ based on client goals, allowing optimizations and strategic pivots to be grounded in dataCreating data driven insights for the agency as well as working these into white papers and articles for the agency to publish with external media sources

What we are looking for 👀

Skills

Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:

Experience in an analyst or insights role within an agencyHighly skilled in Excel (Pivot tables, custom formulas)Experienced in building custom audience segments in Consumer Insights platforms (Global Web Index, MRI Simmons, etc.) and the analysis of the data against hypotheses.Proficient with a wide suite of social reporting platforms (Brandwatch, Sprout, Sprinklr, Amplify, Meltwater, Talkwater etc.)Proficient with native social media reporting tools (Meta Ads manager, Facebook Ads manager, TikTok insights etc.)Passionate about social media, brands, and the world of communicationUp to date with latest news and trends that are going on in the industryAble to work to tight deadlinesCurious about brands, culture, data and how the three interact

A Coolr Offer

Benefits

We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:

💰 Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

🤸‍♂️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

🌴 Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

🎉 Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

💆 Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

➕ Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

♣ Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $70,000 to $85,000, based on your experience and level.

Coolr Culture

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

Coolr DE&I 🌎

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.
