rows.descriptionText:
Headquartered in New York with a nationally-scaled platform, RXR is a 450+ person, vertically integrated investment manager with expertise in a wide array of value creation activities, including acquisitions, asset and portfolio management, property operations, development, construction, leasing, and technological innovation. RXR is an active investor in real estate credit, rental housing, commercial property, and property technology through value-added and opportunistic investment strategies.

Job Summary

The Enterprise Risk & Insurance Data Analyst is a strategic and operationally focused position responsible for managing the information that supports the Company's enterprise insurance and risk related programs.

This position creates, documents, implements, and manages the business processes and governance standards surrounding enterprise risk and insurance-related information including property and operational exposures and compliance requirements. The individual partners with business leaders across Finance, Property Management, Development, Construction, Asset Management, Investment Management, Legal, Engineering, and Information Technology/ Digital Lab to create a trusted, enterprise-wide source of operational, financial, and insurance data used to assess performance and risk.

Leveraging AI technologies and business intelligence tools, this role transforms operational data into concise, meaningful reports and portfolio-level risk analytics that enhance risk and accounting relevant data management, improve underwriting outcomes, reduce renewal effort, strengthen accountability and governance, and support strategic business decisions.

The position serves as the Company's risk management and insurance information steward, ensuring that enterprise-relevant information is complete, accurate, standardized, and readily available when needed.

Responsibilities

Establish and maintain a single source of truth for insurance and exposure data.Create and automate standardized reporting for investment valuation, transaction management, insured property oversight, construction projects, and other enterprise relevant information.Improve the quality and consistency of insurance and risk data and reduce manual efforts.Provide centralized data, analytical, and operational support to the accounting and risk management function around managing enterprise risk, improving internal controls, and insurance related activities.Support the development and implementation of consistent data standards, controls and workflows. Govern insurance related data across multiple operating platforms.Leverage AI technologies to automate data collection, validation, summarization, and reporting.Support company risk assessment efforts.Support decision-making through the creation and critical evaluation of analytics and reporting tools including scenario planning, stress testing, premium estimation, and claim management.Data Governance, Dashboards, and Management Reporting for risk and insurance data (including policy, claim, economics and compliance).Develop and Maintain Architecture and Reporting for Risk and Insurance Intelligence.Support Insurance economics (invoice and payment monitoring oversight).Renewal and Insurance Placement Support.Manage Insurance Related Project Management activities, including overall program administration, location assessments, carrier assessments, and claims oversight.Supporting enterprise-wide internal control assessment and improvement activities.Cross-Functional Business Partnership including diligence support, assessing insurance requirements, and coordinating documentation requirements.Support Business Process Improvement Assessment activities.Reporting & Analytics Resource Management; including dashboards and general management reporting.

Qualifications

Top Competencies

Detail oriented, organized, proactive and highly curious; committed to learning and being a financial technical resource.Strong analytical and organizational skills.Excellent communication and presentation skills.Enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive attitude.Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Experience and Education

Required

Relevant experience in enterprise data governance, data analytics, automation, financial operations and AI tools and/or risk management.Experience managing complex business information across multiple departments.Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency and ability to work with large, multi-source datasets.

Preferred

Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Management, Data Analytics, or related discipline.Commercial real estate and/or financial markets experience.Commercial property insurance experience.Construction risk management experience.Experience using business intelligence platforms.Experience implementing enterprise governance programs.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who are Coolr?

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, and Harvest Snaps (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world. The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started… In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the US, the UK, and beyond.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Analyst to join our US team and turn social and influencer performance data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll analyse campaign, organic, influencer and community data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into strategic recommendations for clients.

Working closely with our strategy and client teams, you’ll develop reporting, measurement frameworks and test-and-learn plans, while building real-time dashboards to streamline performance tracking.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social, data and strategy, and wants to turn numbers into stories that drive better creative and business decisions.

The job 💻

Role

Every role at Coolr plays a vital part in the work we do. Here are some of the key areas of responsibility for this role:

Collating and processing high volumes of social-first performance data (Engagement, Views, CTR, CPM, etc.)Monitoring and reporting on performance for social-first campaigns, always-on organic content activity, influencer partnerships and community engagementDistilling clear actions and insight from the data, making strategic recommendations, optimization plans, and presenting findings in a clear, client-facing presentations and reportsCrafting clear performance analysis and narratives in reportingClosely working alongside a team of strategists to develop qualitative and quantitative research for both current clients and new business prospectsCreating automated social dashboards to help aid and manage reporting across the agency. These will be client specific and update in real time to pull results efficientlyDeveloping measurement frameworks and test and learn plans that define ‘which metrics matter’ based on client goals, allowing optimizations and strategic pivots to be grounded in dataCreating data driven insights for the agency as well as working these into white papers and articles for the agency to publish with external media sources

What we are looking for 👀

Skills

Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:

Experience in an analyst or insights role within an agencyHighly skilled in Excel (Pivot tables, custom formulas)Experienced in building custom audience segments in Consumer Insights platforms (Global Web Index, MRI Simmons, etc.) and the analysis of the data against hypotheses.Proficient with a wide suite of social reporting platforms (Brandwatch, Sprout, Sprinklr, Amplify, Meltwater, Talkwater etc.)Proficient with native social media reporting tools (Meta Ads manager, Facebook Ads manager, TikTok insights etc.)Passionate about social media, brands, and the world of communicationUp to date with latest news and trends that are going on in the industryAble to work to tight deadlinesCurious about brands, culture, data and how the three interact

A Coolr Offer

Benefits

We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:

💰 Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

🤸‍♂️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

🌴 Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

🎉 Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

💆 Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

➕ Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

♣ Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $70,000 to $85,000, based on your experience and level.

Coolr Culture

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

Coolr DE&I 🌎

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

About the RoleCookies for Kids’ Cancer is looking for a creative, highly organized Digital Content Coordinator to manage content across our social media, email marketing and blog. This role will plan and execute our digital content calendar, develop social concepts, write copy, manage email communications and support creator and influencer partnerships and blog content. We’re looking for someone who follows what’s happening across social and digital, brings new ideas to the table and can turn those ideas into thoughtful, well-organized content while managing multiple projects at once. The Digital Content Coordinator will report to the Marketing & Communications Manager and collaborate closely with the Graphic Design & Video Associate to bring content to life.
What You’ll Do
Social Media & ContentOwn and maintain the organization’s social media content calendar across platformsDevelop original social media ideas, concepts, campaigns and recurring contentWrite engaging social copy that is thoughtful, clear and true to our voiceTurn broader campaign priorities, research, stories and organizational updates into social content people will actually want to read, watch and engage withPlan content well in advance while maintaining flexibility for timely opportunities and trendsStay current on social media trends, emerging formats, platform changes and what leading nonprofits, brands and creators are doing wellDevelop clear creative briefs that communicate the idea, objective, copy and visual direction needed for social contentCollaborate with our Graphic Design & Video Associate to bring concepts and ideas to lifeReview content performance and use insights to inform future ideas and planning
Email MarketingOwn and maintain the organization’s email marketing calendarWrite emails supporting fundraising campaigns, events, organizational initiatives and other communicationsCoordinate email timing and messaging with the larger marketing and content calendarThink strategically about how email, social media, blog and website content can work together rather than treating each channel independentlyReview email performance and help identify opportunities to strengthen engagement
Blog & Editorial ContentPlan, write and manage blog content throughout the yearIdentify opportunities for blog content based on campaigns, stories, research and organizational prioritiesConnect blog content to social media, email and other channels when appropriateWork with internal team members to gather the information needed to develop strong, accurate content
Creator & Influencer PartnershipsIdentify creators, influencers and community partners who could authentically help expand the organization’s reachHelp build and maintain relationships with relevant creators and influencersCoordinate creator and influencer collaborations, including outreach, content needs, timelines and deliverablesLook for organic opportunities to engage creators, public figures and other potential partners with a meaningful connection to our missionIncorporate creator partnerships into the larger content calendar and campaign strategy when appropriate
What We’re Looking ForBachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or a related field requiredApproximately 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in social media, digital marketing, communications, content marketing or a related fieldHands-on experience managing social media accounts and content calendars for a brand, organization or companyExcellent writing and editing skills with strong instincts for voice, storytelling and digital contentExceptional organizational and project management skillsAbility to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities, campaigns and deadlines simultaneouslySomeone who genuinely enjoys social media and naturally keeps up with trends, formats, conversations and emerging platformsA creative thinker who brings ideas to the table rather than waiting to be given every assignmentComfortable working independently, making decisions and taking ownership while also collaborating well with othersAble to receive and incorporate feedback while also confidently communicating your own perspective and ideasProficient using AI tools as part of a modern content workflow, including ChatGPT and/or Claude, while bringing the judgment and writing skills necessary to make the final work distinctly humanExperience with email marketing platforms and content management systems is a plusExperience with influencer or creator partnerships, outreach or campaign coordination is a plusNonprofit experience is helpful but not required
Benefits & What We OfferFully remote workUnlimited PTO, with a minimum of five days required annually and additional time off encouraged13 paid holidays, plus one additional flex holiday of your choiceHalf-day Fridays between Memorial Day and Labor DayHoliday quiet hours for two weeks around Christmas and New Year’s, with no meetings and a reduced schedule so our team can slow down and enjoy the holiday seasonHealth, dental and vision insuranceFlexible Spending AccountHealth Reimbursement Account401(k) with employer matchAnnual professional development budgetA supportive remote work environment with reasonable flexibility for life outside of work
Location & ScheduleThis is a fully remote position open to candidates across the United States. Priority will be given to candidates located in Florida, Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Michigan, but we encourage strong candidates from other states to apply.Our team works regular 9–5 business hours, and occasional organization-paid travel may be required for events, meetings or content needs.
How to ApplyVisit our Careers page at CookiesForKidsCancer.org/careers to learn more about working at Cookies for Kids’ Cancer and view our current openings. Select the position you’d like to apply for and click Apply Now to complete the application form.
Please be prepared to provide:Your current resumeAn optional cover letterA link to your portfolio or screenshots/examples of social media posts or accounts you have managedIf your work examples aren’t available through a public link, you may provide a link to a Google Drive folder. Please make sure the sharing settings allow anyone with the link to view your work.
Our Hiring ProcessWe want our hiring process to give you a chance to learn about us while giving us an opportunity to understand how you think, create and work.
1. Screening Interview A first conversation to learn more about your experience, interests and what you’re looking for in your next role.
2. Short Content ExerciseCandidates moving forward will be asked to complete a short exercise designed to show us how you approach content development. The exercise should take no more than two hours. We do not expect or encourage candidates to spend additional time polishing it.
You’ll be given a topic relevant to our organization and asked to:Develop a social media post concept based on the topicCreate a concise creative brief that could be handed to a graphic designer, clearly communicating the concept, objective and visual directionDevelop one additional social media idea that you believe would be a strong fit for our brand and audience
We’re less interested in creating a “perfect” assignment than we are in seeing how you think, organize an idea, communicate creative direction and make decisions within a reasonable amount of time.
3. Interview with the Hiring Manager A conversation with the Marketing & Communications Manager to talk more deeply about the role, your experience, your approach to the work and your content exercise.
4. Final InterviewFinalists will meet with our Executive Director and Chief Revenue Officer before a hiring decision is made.

About Ecosuite We build technology to Accelerate Distributed Energy.
Ecosuite is changing the way the distributed energy industry connects and collaborates. We offer award winning energy data infrastructure and digital tools to help our customers enhance how they deploy and manage electricity assets. 
Ecosuite's industry leading edge-compute hardware and software platform delivers essential connectivity, data, intelligence, control, and virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities to solar and battery system owners - maximizing performance and financial returns. We serve corporations, municipalities, independent power producers, developers, O&M providers, and utilities, including some of the largest brands in the world. 
Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by eliminating friction across the ecosystem. Our values include open-source computing, data-driven methodology, open access to data and industry-wide growth.We are looking for awesome people to help shape the future of the energy industry and our team.
The TeamThe Business Development team drives how Ecosuite expands its customer base - selling Edge Compute Nodes (ECNs) and software subscriptions to solar and battery project owners, and building strategic partnerships across O&M providers, contract manufacturers, utilities. The team owns each initiative end-to-end, including marketing prospecting, lead generation and sales. 
The RoleWe're hiring a Marketing Analyst to own content, campaigns, and event execution for Ecosuite - turning our technology and customer wins into the stories, materials, and touchpoints that move buyers through a technical B2B sales cycle. You'll work closely with the Business Development team and report to the CEO.This role is about organizing and creating written content, planning and running campaigns, executing events and brand building via effective storytelling. Some basic creative but there will be support for visual assets.Content (top priority)Write new content that highlights our technology and customer success stories, translating technical concepts (edge compute, software platform, O&M benefits, mobile experience, VPPs, Predictive ML, AI applications) into clear, compelling narratives.Develop messaging and sales enablement materials for new product rollouts.Own and organize our content library - website copy, case studies, whitepapers, blog posts, LinkedIn posts, and sales collateral - so the team can find and reuse what already exists more effectively.Keep website copy current and aligned with campaigns and product updates.Campaigns (top priority)Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns - email, LinkedIn, and other channels - that generate leads and move prospects through the funnel.Partner with sales and leadership on positioning and campaign strategy, then take campaigns from plan to execution. Leverage existing internal tools (ie. Ecosuite’s Internal Growth Stack, Salesflare, Social Champ, LinkedIn etc.) and research/implement new tools to accelerate impact.Events (top priority)Own planning and logistics for industry events, trade shows, and virtual webinars - registration, material prep, follow-up, and on-the-ground coordination.Coordinate Ecosuite's presence and messaging at events like RE+, NYSEIA, SolarPlaza Asset Management Summit etc.Analytics, Pipeline & Market Research (supporting)Track and report on sales and marketing KPIs most relevant to our sales motion - e.g. marketing content engagement, campaign performance, qualified calls, product demos, quotes delivered. Categorize by buying persona and user category: asset manager, developer, financier, O&M, grid operator. Maintain and organize pipeline data in Salesflare to help leadership spot bottlenecks and speed up the sales cycle.Monitor DER and B2B SaaS industry trends and competitor positioning, and flag opportunities.
What You BringExperience: 1–3 years in marketing, GTM, or content roles. B2B SaaS or clean-tech experience is a strong plus. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).Writing & storytelling: Strong written and verbal communication, with a track record of turning technical subject matter into clear, engaging content.Organization: Comfortable owning a content calendar, campaign timeline, and event logistics simultaneously without things falling through the cracks.Analytical comfort: Able to work with CRM and marketing analytics tools to track performance and report out clearly. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be comfortable with numbers as well as leveraging AI to empower human first engagements.Initiative: Self-motivated and resourceful; you can move a project forward without constant direction, in a fast-paced startup environment.Industry interest: Genuine interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy technology - you don't need a technical background, but you should be motivated to learn the space.
What This Role Is NotA graphic design or creative production role - we brief a freelance designer/agency for visual asset creation.A pure data-analytics role - reporting supports content, campaign, and event decisions, not the other way around.
Why Join Ecosuite?Impact: Your content and campaigns will directly support the sale of technology backed by DOE, NREL, Sandia, Stony Brook University and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory partnerships - real infrastructure accelerating the energy transition.Product: You'll help launch messaging for new AI-driven features like Foresight (predictive forecasting) the Playground (vibe-coding for DERs) and STEVIE (AI assistant) as they roll out.Visibility: You'll work closely with leadership and Business Development, with direct input into how Ecosuite is positioned across the DER industry.Growth: Room to grow scope as we scale - this role can expand toward campaign strategy, brand, growth, sales or analytics ownership over time.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Holly is the HR platform built for city and county government. We help local governments modernize how they hire, classify, and manage their workforce — work that directly shapes public services for millions of people. Our platform is live across 12 states with 70+ jurisdictions representing over 10% of the US population, including major counties like Santa Clara and Contra Costa in the Bay Area, Orange County in LA, and Snohomish County in Washington State. Demand is outpacing our team, and we're building to meet it.

Holly is a seed-stage team of 25+ operators with deep roots in public service, civic tech, and AI. We’ve raised $10M from leading investors in government technology and the future of work and have grown over 100X in the last year. We center public servants and impact in every decision and we bring that same care to how we work here at Holly.

About The Opportunity

Holly is looking for a Data Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day health and integrity of our data.

You'll sit in the Engineering org and be active as the connective tissue between engineering and the Deployments team, making sure the information flowing through our systems is accurate, available, and governed appropriately.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll spend your time writing SQL queries to clean data, building dashboards in Metabase, and in the operational tooling that keeps our pipelines running. This role is a strong fit for someone who is rigorous about data quality, comfortable owning process end to end, and interested in building a data function rather than inheriting one.

What You'll Do

Own how data gets in. Public records requests, agency outreach, general collection and extraction. You set the cadence, track what's outstanding, and collaborate with the deployment team to ensure client launches are set-up with the right data. This will include getting on the phone and talking to agencies as well when data is missing.Run the pipeline day to day. Monitor runs, resolve failures and reruns, and configure schedules, connections, and settings as data sources change.Own data quality end to end. Build the validation checks and monitoring that catch problems early, investigate the ones that get through to root cause, and drive fixes with engineering. When a client flags something that looks wrong, you diagnose it, fix it or route it, and tell them what happened.Own Metabase and the analytics work that runs on it. Dashboards, saved questions, permissions, and shared metric definitions, so the teams asking the same question get the same number. Engineering, product, and Deployments come to you for an operational question answered, an output audited, or reporting that they can run on their own. Do the work once, then turn repeating work into tooling. Find the repetitive work and remove it, whether that's an AI workflow you build yourself, a vendor, or a well-written ticket to engineering. Leave behind documentation, operational runbooks, and data dictionaries for the whole team + future of the data org. 

Who You Are

You're strong in SQL. Complex joins don't bother you, and when a query returns something surprising you find out why instead of moving on. You've administered a BI tool before, whether that's Metabase, Looker, or Tableau.You’re naturally process-driven. We maintain the health and integrity of TTD's data marketplace — ensuring data is accurate, accessible, and reliable — and we partner with internal and external stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

RXR is an active investor in real estate credit, rental housing, commercial property, and property technology through value-added and opportunistic investment strategies.

Job Summary

The Enterprise Risk & Insurance Data Analyst is a strategic and operationally focused position responsible for managing the information that supports the Company's enterprise insurance and risk related programs.

This position creates, documents, implements, and manages the business processes and governance standards surrounding enterprise risk and insurance-related information including property and operational exposures and compliance requirements. The individual partners with business leaders across Finance, Property Management, Development, Construction, Asset Management, Investment Management, Legal, Engineering, and Information Technology/ Digital Lab to create a trusted, enterprise-wide source of operational, financial, and insurance data used to assess performance and risk.

Leveraging AI technologies and business intelligence tools, this role transforms operational data into concise, meaningful reports and portfolio-level risk analytics that enhance risk and accounting relevant data management, improve underwriting outcomes, reduce renewal effort, strengthen accountability and governance, and support strategic business decisions.

The position serves as the Company's risk management and insurance information steward, ensuring that enterprise-relevant information is complete, accurate, standardized, and readily available when needed.

Responsibilities

The Kimberly and Eric J. Waldman Department of Dermatology at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is dedicated to delivering superior, comprehensive dermatologic care that exceeds patient expectations, and to advancing the science of dermatology through research and education.

About the Role:

Are you passionate about scientific discovery and eager to contribute to research that advances the understanding and treatment of cancer?

Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Research Associate to support innovative laboratory research projects that have the potential to improve patient outcomes and expand scientific knowledge. In this role, you'll work alongside researchers and investigators, conducting experiments, analyzing data, processing biological samples, and helping drive studies from concept to discovery.

Perform laboratory experiments and specialized testing in support of ongoing research studies and scientific investigations.

Collect, analyze, and accurately document research data and experimental results.

Assist with the development, optimization, and troubleshooting of laboratory methods and research procedures.

Process and prepare blood, tissue, and other biological samples for a variety of research applications.

Isolate cells and other biological materials used in pre-clinical and clinical research projects.

Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain specialized laboratory equipment and instrumentation.

Create data summaries, charts, and reports using scientific software and data analysis tools.

Monitor laboratory inventory and ensure supplies, reagents, and materials are available to support research activities.

Assist investigators in implementing new techniques and procedures published in scientific literature.

Maintain accurate laboratory records and documentation in accordance with established standards.

Support the day-to-day operation of laboratory and research facilities.

Collaborate with researchers, students, trainees, and laboratory staff to advance research goals.

Stay current with scientific advancements through literature reviews, educational programs, conferences, and training opportunities.

We're looking for an individual who is passionate about research, enjoys problem-solving, and thrives in a collaborative scientific environment.

Experience working in a laboratory or research setting.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Knowledge of laboratory techniques, scientific procedures, and data collection methods.

The ability to organize, analyze, and interpret research data.

Experience working with biological samples, laboratory equipment, and scientific instrumentation.

Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

Enjoy hands-on laboratory work and experimental research.

Are naturally curious and eager to learn new scientific techniques.

Take initiative when solving research challenges.

Value teamwork and knowledge sharing.

Are motivated by contributing to discoveries that may improve patient care and outcomes.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Roswell Park, every member of our team contributes to a shared mission: eliminating cancer's grip on humanity through research, education, prevention, and patient care.

When You Join Roswell Park, You'll Enjoy

The opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking cancer research and scientific discovery.

Access to leading researchers, clinicians, and cutting-edge technologies.

A collaborative and supportive research environment that encourages innovation and learning.

Opportunities for professional growth, mentorship, and career development.

The chance to publish, present, and contribute to meaningful scientific advancements.

A mission-driven culture where your work can have a direct impact on patients and families.

As a Research Associate, you'll do more than conduct experiments. You'll help generate the knowledge that drives future breakthroughs in cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. If you're excited about advancing science and making a meaningful contribution to research, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Roswell Park.

 Master’s degree and the equivalent of eighteen (18) months of full-time professional research experience in a laboratory, clinical or scientific research environment; or Bachelor’s degree and the equivalent of thirty (30) months of full-time professional research experience in a laboratory, clinical or scientific research environment.

We are responsible for coordinating the citywide communications strategy, including messaging from all city agencies. Our goal is to ensure the administration speaks with one voice, effectively and consistently communicating the Mayor's policies and their impact on everyday New Yorkers.

 You have an interest in local politics and a passion for New York City (candidates with local ties are highly encouraged). You are self-motivated to find the latest news. rows.title: Data Analytics Engineering Intern

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

About This Role

Perchwell is expanding rapidly across the US, and every new MLS client brings a data source we haven't worked with before. Our Data Analytics Engineering team owns what happens next: understanding what is actually in that data, transforming it into our warehouse, and building the intelligence layer that sits on top of it. This summer, you'll work on that alongside our analytics engineers and data engineers, supporting both the MLS customers we serve today and the ones we're onboarding next.

What We’re Looking For

Rising seniors enrolled in a CS, data science, statistics, or other STEM degree program who are looking to intern at a fast paced SaaS company this summer. Passionate problem solvers who thrive in fast moving environments. Strong communicators and team players who can work cross functionally. Careful thinkers who chase down a number that looks wrong instead of passing it along. Eager learners who want to gain real world analytics engineering experience. 

What You’ll Do

Understand New Data: Profile the data we are ingesting for new clients and partner with members of the broader engineering org to identify the most effective patterns for onboarding them into our standard reporting product. Build and Ship: Extend the dbt models that transform raw MLS data into our warehouse, adding the tests and documentation the rest of the team depends on. Build Intelligence: Strengthen the layer that sits on top of the warehouse, including metric definitions, semantic models, and the dashboards internal teams and customers rely on. Own a Project: Take ownership of a summer project, making key modeling, tooling, and implementation decisions. Profiling and mapping a new non MLS data source is one strong candidate. Collaborate and Learn: Partner with analytics engineers, data engineers, product managers, and customer facing teams to turn open questions into answers people can act on. Deliver Impact: Work on scalable solutions from broadly defined problems and see your work in production. 

Why This Internship? 

Dedicated Mentor: You'll work 1:1 with an experienced analytics engineer who will provide mentorship and support your growth. Real Ownership: Over 10 weeks, early June to mid August, you will choose and lead your own project, making key decisions along the way. Fully In Person Experience: This is a full time, in-office internship based at our beautiful New York City HQ in Soho. You'll work on site five days a week and collaborate closely with our team, gaining hands-on experience in a fast paced, learning oriented environment. Showcase Your Work: At the end of the summer, present your project to our executive and data teams. Work on Real Data: Beyond your project, you'll contribute to models, tests, and dashboards running in production against live customer data. NYC Perks and Fun: From team dinners to museum trips, immerse yourself in the greatest city in the world while working with an awesome team. 

Required For The Role

Working familiarity with RDBMS storage systems and SQL, including joins, aggregations, and CTEs. You don't need window functions yet, but you should want to learn them. Curiosity about where data comes from and what it represents, not just how to query it. Attention to detail and an instinct for when something doesn't add up. Strong communication and problem solving abilities. Excitement to learn, grow, and build. 

Bonus Points for the Following

Coursework, projects, or prior internship experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. Exposure to dbt or another transformation framework. An understanding of Python for working with data, such as pandas in coursework or personal projects. Familiarity with Git and version controlled workflows. Experience with a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Mode, or Metabase. Any project, academic or personal, where you took messy source data and made it usable. Demonstrated leadership skills developed during your college experience. 

Internship Information

Internship Dates: June 7 - August 13, 2027

Application Deadline: Applications for this internship close on October 18, 2026, at 11 PM ET. Be sure to apply by the deadline to be considered! We will be reviewing all applications, so please take the time to submit a thoughtful application.

Offers: Internship offers will be extended by November 25, 2026.

Salary Information

$12,000 for 10 weeks (minus applicable taxes and withholdings)

Excited to launch your career with a tech startup in NYC? Apply now and build something meaningful with us in Summer 2027!

Note: Benefits package listed below is for reference only for those who later join Perchwell full-time.

Strong Benefits Package

Flexible PTO, plus 10 paid company holidays401K with a company matchMedical, dental, and vision plansHSA and FSA optionsCommuter benefitsParental leaveCompany-wide onsite or offsite each yearBeautiful office in Soho, Manhattan with a stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch once per week, happy hours and meet-ups

Note: At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S.

Holly is the HR platform built for city and county government. We help local governments modernize how they hire, classify, and manage their workforce — work that directly shapes public services for millions of people. Our platform is live across 12 states with 70+ jurisdictions representing over 10% of the US population, including major counties like Santa Clara and Contra Costa in the Bay Area, Orange County in LA, and Snohomish County in Washington State. Demand is outpacing our team, and we're building to meet it.

Holly is a seed-stage team of 25+ operators with deep roots in public service, civic tech, and AI. We’ve raised $10M from leading investors in government technology and the future of work and have grown over 100X in the last year. We center public servants and impact in every decision and we bring that same care to how we work here at Holly.

About The Opportunity

Holly is looking for a Data Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day health and integrity of our data.

You'll sit in the Engineering org and be active as the connective tissue between engineering and the Deployments team, making sure the information flowing through our systems is accurate, available, and governed appropriately.This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll spend your time writing SQL queries to clean data, building dashboards in Metabase, and in the operational tooling that keeps our pipelines running. This role is a strong fit for someone who is rigorous about data quality, comfortable owning process end to end, and interested in building a data function rather than inheriting one.

What You'll Do

Own how data gets in. Public records requests, agency outreach, general collection and extraction. You set the cadence, track what's outstanding, and collaborate with the deployment team to ensure client launches are set-up with the right data. This will include getting on the phone and talking to agencies as well when data is missing.Run the pipeline day to day. Monitor runs, resolve failures and reruns, and configure schedules, connections, and settings as data sources change.Own data quality end to end. Build the validation checks and monitoring that catch problems early, investigate the ones that get through to root cause, and drive fixes with engineering. When a client flags something that looks wrong, you diagnose it, fix it or route it, and tell them what happened.Own Metabase and the analytics work that runs on it. Dashboards, saved questions, permissions, and shared metric definitions, so the teams asking the same question get the same number. Engineering, product, and Deployments come to you for an operational question answered, an output audited, or reporting that they can run on their own. Do the work once, then turn repeating work into tooling. Find the repetitive work and remove it, whether that's an AI workflow you build yourself, a vendor, or a well-written ticket to engineering. Leave behind documentation, operational runbooks, and data dictionaries for the whole team + future of the data org. 

Who You Are

You're strong in SQL. Complex joins don't bother you, and when a query returns something surprising you find out why instead of moving on. You've administered a BI tool before, whether that's Metabase, Looker, or Tableau.You’re naturally process-driven. You catch the error in row 4,000 and have a track record of building documentation and standards.You can manage projects and drive results. You’re capable of getting stuff done with teammates and collaborators across time zones, while keeping stakeholders consistently and clearly informed. You write clearly, manage tightly, and communicate often. You’re AI-native. You use AI in real workflows, are constantly testing new tools, and are the one your friends go to for tips. You’ve been a data wizard before. You have experience in a data operations, data analytics, tech consulting, or business intelligence role. Bonus points for startup / public sector experience. Experience handling sensitive or regulated data is a plus.

What You'll Get

Direct impact – because of your work, real government clients will learn to use the platform for critical projects that will improve the quality and output of the public sectorPlaybook ownership – you're not just executing a playbook, you're writing it. What you learn shapes how Holly scales to 100+ customersCompetitive package – $80K - $110K base with equity, comprehensive health benefits (platinum plan with vision and dental), 401(k) benefits, professional development stipendCollaborative work culture – join a fast-moving, high-trust team of A players that cares about the work and each other

Ready to join us? A few important notes:

Location: NYC at Holly HQWork Philosophy: We’re an early-stage startup serving government clients with real deadlines. There may be occasional off-hours work around launches or critical issues. We value flexibility and trust you to manage your schedule while maintaining a high bar for responsiveness and customer outcomes.Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship. 

Holly is committed to building a diverse company and working with the broadest talent pool possible. We encourage applications from all races, religions, national origins, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities, gender expressions, and ages, as well as veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Job Summary

The Deal Desk Analyst serves as a critical operational and analytical partner within the Deal Desk organization, supporting the full deal lifecycle from opportunity qualification through contract execution. This role is responsible for maintaining Salesforce data integrity, supporting deal modeling, drafting professional memos, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and developing scalable processes that improve deal velocity. The Analyst will leverage strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and pattern recognition to identify trends across pricing, commercial terms, and deal structures. This individual will document best practices, create playbooks and deal matrices, and help establish repeatable frameworks that enable faster decision-making, and operational efficiency across the organization. This position serves as the operational foundation that enables Deal Desk Managers to act as strategic advisors to Sales and Leadership while ensuring disciplined execution of Deal Desk processes. Deal Support & Analysis

Analyze commercial terms, pricing structures, profitability, and revenue implications to support deal reviews. Facilitate deal progression by partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations and Leadership teams. 

Salesforce Data Quality & Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate and complete Salesforce opportunity records to support pipeline management. Ensure required fields, pricing data, deal stages, and commercial terms are properly documented and maintained. Support process governance and data validation efforts that improve data accuracy and operational reporting. Identify and resolve data inconsistencies and process gaps that create friction in the deal lifecycle. Ensure deal documentation and financial assumptions are accurately captured. Provide reporting and insights to support executive and business reviews. 

Process Improvement & Enablement

Identify recurring deal structures, pricing models, and commercial patterns to develop scalable playbooks and best practices. Build and maintain deal matrices, operating procedures, and decision-making frameworks to improve consistency and efficiency. 

Cross-Functional Partnership

Act as a liaison between Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Recognition, Operations, and Leadership teams to find a “path to yes” that drives company growth. Ensure alignment across stakeholders and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and approval requirements.

rows.title: Security Software Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

As a Security Software Engineer, you will help build and maintain foundational security systems that protect our users and infrastructure. You will bring strong technical fundamentals, product thinking, and a collaborative mindset. You’ll take ownership of scoped features, grow quickly with mentorship, and build strong security and full-stack fundamentals. Working closely with senior engineers, you will collaborate on core functions such as authentication (login, MFA), identity management (SCIM, RBAC), and secret management, learning how to design and implement robust, scalable security solutions into our platform.

The Team

The Infrastructure and Security team at Hover ensures the scalability, reliability, and security of our platform, empowering engineers to build and deploy applications faster, safer, and with greater stability. This collaborative team is composed of engineers with expertise in cloud infrastructure, security, automation, and CI/CD best practices. We handle everything from Kubernetes environments and cloud architecture to securing user authentication and automating vulnerability detection.

Our mission is to make the best path the easiest path by providing robust automation, consistent patterns, and secure-by-design principles. We partner with engineering teams to tackle challenges like managing rich geospatial and machine learning workloads, hardening cloud infrastructure, and implementing security features across our stack (Ruby, TypeScript, Docker, GCP, Terraform, and more).

Team members are supported with professional growth opportunities, a strong focus on learning, and a culture that values collaboration, innovation, and the continuous improvement of our systems and security posture. Join us to work on cutting-edge challenges that are critical to the foundation of Hover’s success.

You will contribute by

Security Service Development: Collaborate on the development of core security services (e.g., permissions management, secrets orchestration, secure MLOps). Help build secure-by-default libraries and frameworks that empower engineering teams to write secure code.Security Infrastructure Automation: Assist with enhancing our CI/CD pipeline by integrating automated self-serve security controls (e.g., SAST, supply chain security checks).Architecture & Code Review: Support secure code and architecture reviews, assist in enforcing secure-by-design principles, and learn to lead threat modeling under mentorship.System Hardening: Contribute to maintaining resilient cloud infrastructure, network isolation, automated vulnerability detection, and defense-in-depth strategies to harden our production environment.Compliance & Process: Contribute to security incident response, document security risks, and support compliance audits (e.g., SOC 2).Collaboration & Education: Advise teams on security best practices, identify and solve for developer security friction points, and bring security awareness to engineering.


Your background includes

rows.title: Software Engineer, Research Data Platform

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

The Research Data Platform team builds the tools that Anthropic's researchers use every day to manage, query, and analyze the data that goes into training and evaluating frontier models. We power the internal applications researchers rely on to monitor RL runs, explore finetuning datasets, and understand what's happening inside their experiments.

We're looking for engineers who love working directly with users and who excel at building data products — the pipelines that move data out of training runs into queryable storage, and the APIs, libraries, and services researchers use to manage and explore it. This role sits closer to the research workflow than a typical data infrastructure position: you'll often embed with research teams, build ML-specific tooling alongside them, and leverage what our Data Infrastructure team has already built rather than reinventing it.

We do not require prior ML or AI training experience. If you enjoy working closely with technical users, learning new domains quickly, and building tools people actually want to use, you'll pick up the research context fast.

Responsibilities

Build and operate data pipelines that extract data from research training runs and land it in storage systems that are easy and fast to queryWork closely with researchers to design and build APIs, libraries, and web interfaces that support data management, exploration, and analysisDevelop dataset management, data cataloging, and provenance tooling that researchers use in their day-to-day workEmbed with research teams to understand their workflows, identify high-leverage tooling opportunities, and ship solutions quicklyCollaborate with adjacent teams to build on existing systems rather than reinventing them

You may be a good fit if you

Have significant software engineering experience, particularly building data-intensive applications or internal toolingEnjoy working directly with users, gathering requirements iteratively, and shipping things that get adoptedAre results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impactPick up slack, even if it goes outside your job descriptionWant to learn more about machine learning researchCare about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have experience with

Large-scale ETL, columnar storage formats, and query engines (e.g., Spark, BigQuery, DuckDB, Parquet)High-volume time series data — ingestion, storage, and efficient queryingData cataloging, lineage, or metadata management systemsML experiment tracking or metrics platformsWorking in environments where engineers partner closely with quantitative users — research labs, trading firms, observability or analytics startupsComplex data visualization and full-stack web application development

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.title: Co-op -- Applied AI

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the frontier of applied AI and agentic systems, ingesting and reasoning over millions of short-form videos to uncover consumer insights no one else can see. Our work impacts real product decisions, global marketing campaigns, and how brands engage their fans.

You'll join a small experienced team where engineers ship product — not tickets. You'll work hand-in-hand with our product designer from day one, shaping features before specs exist and turning rough ideas into shipped experiences. You'll work directly with founders, hop on customer calls, and own company-defining features end-to-end. If you want real responsibility, fast learning loops, and the ability to shape both product and company, Plot is the place. It's also a perfect fit if you aspire to build your own startup one day — we operate with a deep founder's mindset.

What You'll Work On

Build agentic, reasoning-driven systems on top of cutting-edge LLMs to power consumer intelligence, marketing automation, and influencer activation. Collaborate deeply with product design to prototype, iterate, and ship AI features from 0→1. You'll be in Figma reviews, whiteboarding sessions, and user interviews — not just implementing handed-down specs. Design & execute LLM/ML evaluation frameworks — from offline benchmarks to live A/B tests — to measure quality, reliability, and business impact. Own full-stack AI product features: prompt design, orchestration, tooling, monitoring, and the UX that brings it all together. Collaborate closely with founders, design, marketing, and customers to ensure our AI deliver real customer valueStay at the front of the curve: research, prototype, and integrate emerging methods in agentic reasoning, context engineering, and LLM-driven automation. Note: This role is not focused on training foundation models — it's about building high-leverage systems on top of them (think "Claude-Code over Claude-Model"). 

What We're Looking For

Proven track record shipping customer-facing products. You've built features users love and can move quickly across the entire stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure. Deep, hands-on familiarity with LLMs — evaluation, prompt engineering, tool use, context management, and agentic workflows. You stay current with the latest advances in AI and are excited to experiment with new techniques and apply them to real product problems. Strong product sense and design instinct. You have opinions about what makes AI experiences great — and what makes them terrible. You're comfortable working with designers in the earliest stages, before the UX is settled, to collaboratively shape what the product should be. You can wear multiple hats: engineer, product thinker, and user advocate. High ownership mindset. You like talking to users, debugging real data, reading logs, and doing the unglamorous work required to build great AI products. Curiosity, grit, and a drive to build things that feel like magic. No degree requirements.

Position Summary

The Research Assistant will work at the Sergievsky Center/Taub Institute in a study of memory, aging and Alzheimer's disease among racially and ethnically diverse adults. The incumbent will perform telephone and in-person interviews and assessments of study participants.

Responsibilities

Conduct standardized participant interviews to collect medical, family, and research-related history information in accordance with study protocols and under the supervision of the Principal Investigator. Administer assessments of participants' everyday functioning and neuropsychological performance, and assist with the identification and recruitment of research participants for ongoing studies, including brain donation initiatives. Assist with the informed consent process for minimal-risk research studies by evaluating participant understanding in accordance with approved study procedures and obtaining informed consent under the direction of the Principal Investigator and in compliance with Institutional Review Board policies and regulations. Collect biological specimens from research participants and perform phlebotomy procedures when appropriately trained and authorized. Process, prepare, label, document, store, and track biological samples in accordance with study protocols, safety standards, and regulatory requirements. Maintain and manage research data by scoring assessment protocols, entering and validating study data, performing quality assurance and data cleaning activities, organizing and maintaining research records, and preparing reports, summaries, and presentations of study data for research staff and investigators. Support day-to-day research operations by preparing, copying, scanning, organizing, and maintaining study materials and documentation, coordinating research-related records, and performing other duties as assigned to support the successful conduct of research activities. Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned/requested.

Supervision: All duties are performed under the supervision of the Principal Investigator and senior research staff.

Bachelor's degree and at least one and one-half years of related experience or equivalent in education, training and experience.Knowledge of various related laboratory procedures and techniques required.

Good organizational and time management skills.Excellent oral and written communication, and interpersonal skills. Computer skills, ability to conduct chart reviews.Must be able to learn and operate research project software.

Equal Opportunity Employer / Disability / Veteran

rows.title: Current PhD, AI Engineering Internship Program - Summer 2027

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Key Role Details

This is a full-time paid internship program spanning twelve weeks from June through August. Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program. Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position with their team and will work with their manager on identifying a start date upon graduation. 

This is a paid internship. This is a limited-time internship position, and Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. However, a full-time AI Engineering role, for which you may be considered upon completion of the internship (subject to business need, market conditions, and other factors) is eligible for employer immigration sponsorship. 

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained by August 2029 or earlier. Must be continuing in the same course of study of the most recent degree following completion of the internship period. At least 1 year of experience or academic work developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies. At least 1 year of experience or academic work programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience or academic work with deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure). Experience or academic work in developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing AI/ML training or inference pipelines, including distributed GPU computational frameworks. Experience or academic work with AI/ML domains and systems (e.g., LLM Inference, Search and Retrieval, NLP, Computer Vision, Guardrails, Memory). Familiarity with Agentic Frameworks (Eg: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Autogen, MCP/A2A, frontier-labs agent SDKs). 

AI Engineering Internship 

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing deep personalization and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description: 

Join the AI Engineering Internship Program for a specialized summer experience that directly contributes to delivering industry-leading agentic capabilities and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. As part of this team, you'll help build Agentic AI applications and platform capabilities that power customer-facing experiences with GenAI workflows, industry-leading infrastructure, and internal agentic coding tools. You'll work on the Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team, which is tasked with advancing the state-of-the-art in AI science and engineering. You’ll make valuable contributions from day one by building AI systems and shaping ideas key to delivering AI-native experiences and products for our 100mm+ customers.

In this role, you will:

Partner deeply with a cross-functional team of research scientists, PMs, and engineers to prototype and ship AI-native products that reach millions of customers. Research, prototype, and productionalize high-impact AI systems, including multimodal search, intelligent document processing, and autonomous agentic workflows that push the boundaries of current industry benchmarks. Design and optimize the critical infrastructure of our AI stack—from fine-tuning pre-training pipelines and reinforcement learning to implementing inference optimization, robust guardrails and sophisticated evaluation frameworks. Leverage a broad stack of technologies including AWS Ultraclusters, PyTorch, and leading-edge agentic frameworks. You’ll be empowered with top-tier developer tools like Claude Code and Windsurf to accelerate the path from concept to code. Architect agentic workflows that go beyond simple chat—enabling AI systems to autonomously navigate tools, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and integrate seamlessly with complex microservice environments. 

The Ideal Candidate:

You are curious, love to build systems, and also share our passion to do it the right way. You want to work on problems that have not been attempted before and will help change banking for good. You move fluently from reading a research paper to implementing it in production. You have a deep, intuitive grasp of the latest advances in agentic workflows and multimodal models. You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss. You excel at decomposing complex problems. You possess the judgment to decide where AI adds value and how to orchestrate AI workflows incorporating time-tested systems design principles, integrating both into a unified whole. 

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $176,000 - $176,000 for AI Engineer PhD Intern

New York, NY: $192,000 - $192,000 for AI Engineer PhD Intern

San Jose, CA: $192,000 - $192,000 for AI Engineer PhD Intern

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Title

Research Associate

Job Type

Regular

Company

Health Research, Inc. (HRI) Roswell Park Division

Department

Surgical Oncology

Full time

Weekly Hours

40

Fte

Summary

About the Role:

Are you passionate about scientific discovery and eager to contribute to research that advances the understanding and treatment of cancer?

Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Research Associate to support innovative laboratory research projects that have the potential to improve patient outcomes and expand scientific knowledge. In this role, you'll work alongside researchers and investigators, conducting experiments, analyzing data, processing biological samples, and helping drive studies from concept to discovery.

This is an excellent opportunity for a curious, detail-oriented scientist who enjoys hands-on laboratory work and wants to make a meaningful impact through research.

The starting annual salary for this position is $62,514 and this can include a full comprehensive benefits package.

What You'll Do

As a Research Associate, you will:

Perform laboratory experiments and specialized testing in support of ongoing research studies and scientific investigations.

Collect, analyze, and accurately document research data and experimental results.

Assist with the development, optimization, and troubleshooting of laboratory methods and research procedures.

Process and prepare blood, tissue, and other biological samples for a variety of research applications.

Isolate cells and other biological materials used in pre-clinical and clinical research projects.

Operate, calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain specialized laboratory equipment and instrumentation.

Create data summaries, charts, and reports using scientific software and data analysis tools.

Monitor laboratory inventory and ensure supplies, reagents, and materials are available to support research activities.

Assist investigators in implementing new techniques and procedures published in scientific literature.

Maintain accurate laboratory records and documentation in accordance with established standards.

Support the day-to-day operation of laboratory and research facilities.

Collaborate with researchers, students, trainees, and laboratory staff to advance research goals.

Stay current with scientific advancements through literature reviews, educational programs, conferences, and training opportunities.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for an individual who is passionate about research, enjoys problem-solving, and thrives in a collaborative scientific environment.

Successful Candidates Will Have

Experience working in a laboratory or research setting.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Knowledge of laboratory techniques, scientific procedures, and data collection methods.

The ability to organize, analyze, and interpret research data.

Experience working with biological samples, laboratory equipment, and scientific instrumentation.

Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

You'll Be Especially Successful In This Role If You

Enjoy hands-on laboratory work and experimental research.

Are naturally curious and eager to learn new scientific techniques.

Take initiative when solving research challenges.

Value teamwork and knowledge sharing.

Are motivated by contributing to discoveries that may improve patient care and outcomes.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Roswell Park, every member of our team contributes to a shared mission: eliminating cancer's grip on humanity through research, education, prevention, and patient care.

When You Join Roswell Park, You'll Enjoy

The opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking cancer research and scientific discovery.

Access to leading researchers, clinicians, and cutting-edge technologies.

A collaborative and supportive research environment that encourages innovation and learning.

Opportunities for professional growth, mentorship, and career development.

The chance to publish, present, and contribute to meaningful scientific advancements.

A mission-driven culture where your work can have a direct impact on patients and families.

Make a Difference Through Discovery

As a Research Associate, you'll do more than conduct experiments. You'll help generate the knowledge that drives future breakthroughs in cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment. If you're excited about advancing science and making a meaningful contribution to research, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Roswell Park.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

 Master’s degree and the equivalent of eighteen (18) months of full-time professional research experience in a laboratory, clinical or scientific research environment; or Bachelor’s degree and the equivalent of thirty (30) months of full-time professional research experience in a laboratory, clinical or scientific research environment.
