rows.title: ML Engineer, Applied AI
rows.descriptionText:
Your Impact at LILA

We are growing our Applied AI org and seeking Machine Learning Engineers with expertise in model training, evaluation, and production-oriented ML systems. You’ll work on improving Lila’s AI models for customer-specific scientific needs, with a focus on turning frontier model capabilities into reliable workflows that can be evaluated, iterated, and used in real customer contexts. This is a rare chance to join an early team with the autonomy, flexibility, and compute to tackle frontier science problems.

Applied AI sits at the intersection of AI Research, model engineering, and product deployment. The team partners closely with AI Researchers and Software teams to adapt Lila models to customer workflows, improve model quality through experimentation, and ensure model behavior works well end to end inside the application.

This role is ideal for someone who can bridge research and engineering: training or adapting models, building evaluation loops, debugging model behavior, and collaborating across AI and Software to move promising capabilities into production-quality systems.

What You'll Be Building

Close the last-mile gap between Lila AI model capabilities and customer-specific scientific workflows.Post-train models using approaches such as SFT and RL (DPO, PPO/GRPO) to align model behavior with customer-specific requirements and feedback.Build evaluation loops that measure model quality, reliability, and customer fit.Design experiments to improve model performance across applied customer use cases.Feed customer learnings, data signals, and evaluation results back into the Lila AI model improvement cycles.Partner with AI researchers to translate model improvements into usable capabilities.Work with Software to integrate model behavior into end-to-end product workflows.Debug model failures using traces, evaluations, customer context, and scientific feedback.Build reusable tooling for model adaptation, evaluation, and deployment workflows.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Experience building, training, adapting, or evaluating machine learning models.Strong software engineering skills in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.Experience designing experiments, evaluation metrics, or test sets for model performance.Ability to debug model behavior using data, traces, logs, and qualitative feedback.Experience working across research and engineering teams to move ML capabilities into usable systems.Familiarity with large language models, multi-modal models, or agentic AI systems.Clear communication skills for translating customer needs into technical model improvements.

Bonus Points For

Experience adapting models for customer-facing or production workflows.Experience with scientific, technical, or data-intensive customer use cases.Experience building evaluation harnesses, model monitoring, or quality dashboards.Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, or agentic workflows.Experience with RL post-training, such as RLHF, GRPO, or tool-augmented RL.Experience training MoE architectures.Experience working with product or customer-facing teams to translate needs into ML improvements.

CompensationWe offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range: $116,000 USD - $170,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

rows.title: Senior AI Engineer I
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer I embedded within Secure Power, you leverage generative AI, automation platforms, and low-code tooling to solve real operational problems and remove manual work from the team’s day-to-day. You build, test, and deploy AI agents, automated workflows, and dashboards while maintaining the integrations and infrastructure that keep them running. Your core responsibilities include translating business rules and decision logic into reliable agent instructions, converting manual processes into automated workflows, and building the dashboards leadership relies on to track performance. You automate processes for Secure Power to enhance efficiency and collaborate with process owners and team leaders to develop working prototypes and production-ready tools.

Your mission is to apply specialized technical expertise in AI and automation to identify inefficiencies, map processes, and build new tools that address Secure Power’s most persistent operational pain points. Your work directly impacts how Secure Power runs day to day – contributing to faster cycle times, cleaner data, and better visibility for leadership. You are a specialized technical expert in AI engineering, focused on the delivery, implementation, and design of AI agents, automation, and reporting tools embedded within a single business team. You apply broad technical knowledge to deliver results with direct, visible impact on Secure Power’s operations. You make decisions regarding your own work and priorities, often guided by established precedents, technical standards, and some interpretation. You are responsible for guiding other professionals and providing mentorship on non-routine or escalated issues, and your work is reviewed for accuracy and quality to ensure the highest standards of AI engineering are met.

What You Will Do

Build and deploy AI agents (e.g., using Microsoft Copilot Studio) that solve real Secure Power business problems Design and maintain the automation and dashboard infrastructure (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, Smartsheet) that supports scalable, production-grade solutions for the team. Collaborate with process owners and team leaders to map current-state workflows, redesign broken or redundant steps, and transform them into working prototypes and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs). Automate workflows and processes across systems the team already uses – including Salesforce, Oracle, CPQ, and SharePoint – to boost efficiency and remove manual re-entry. Run pilots, gather feedback, and iterate quickly; create simple documentation so the team can use and own what you’ve built. Collaborate with the central AI team and ensure all AI solutions adhere to established governance, security, and responsible AI policies. 

Required Skills

AI Agent Development: Building, training, and deploying AI agents (e.g., Copilot Studio) into real production use. Workflow Automation: Implementing and deploying automated workflows in low-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps). Process Mapping & Redesign: Mapping current-state workflows end-to-end and identifying where automation will – and won’t – add value. Data Integration: Connecting AI and automation tools across enterprise systems via API (e.g., Salesforce, Oracle) to eliminate manual data re-entry. Prompt & Logic Design: Translating business rules and decision logic into clear, testable agent instructions. Responsible AI & Governance: Applying data privacy, security, and responsible AI practices, including human review where outputs affect a customer or an order. 

Qualifications For Success

Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to handle ambiguous, undocumented processes independently. Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Growth-oriented mindset with strong curiosity to explore new AI and automation technologies and methodologies. Adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to navigate a fast-moving, embedded team environment with ease. Comfortable explaining a technical tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder or leader. 

Benefits & Growth

Work on AI and automation projects that directly impact how an entire business team operates. Collaborate with Secure Power leaders, process owners, and the central AI team in a supportive, innovation-driven culture. Access continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and technical mentorship

The Role

This is a full-time summer internship based in Cambridge, MA from June 7, 2027 – August 20, 2027. Candidates must be available for the entire duration of the program.

The Statistical Innovation & Data Analytics (SiDA) team is advancing AI-enabled statistical and clinical data solutions to accelerate data-driven decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen regulatory readiness across clinical development programs.

Role

This role provides hands-on experience at the intersection of statistics, clinical data science, and AI engineering, with opportunities to work on:

Clinical and statistical data analytics, including EDC, SDTM, ADaM, and translational dataAI/ML research and applied statistical modeling for clinical development use casesLLM and agentic AI development, including domain-specific agents, tool integration, retrieval, and workflow orchestrationLocal and domain-specific model post-training, evaluation, and optimization for statistical and clinical applicationsAI-assisted statistical programming and analytics, exploring opportunities to automate and augment existing biometrics workflowsScalable and governed AI solutions, transitioning promising prototypes toward production-oriented applications that meet clinical data, security, quality, and compliance requirements

The student will contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and implementation of AI-enabled capabilities that support statisticians, statistical programmers, data scientists, and clinical development teams.

The role is particularly suited for students interested in going beyond general-purpose AI experimentation to understand how AI can be tailored, evaluated, and operationalized for statistical and clinical research workflows, with the goal of reducing repetitive work, accelerating time to insight, and enabling more agile use of clinical data.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Develop and evaluate AI/ML and agentic solutions for clinical data analysis, statistical programming, and workflow automation, including tool-calling, RAG, and skill-based agent architectures.Explore LLM post-training, adaptation, and evaluation approaches to improve model performance for statistical and clinical research use cases.Design agentic workflows with appropriate human oversight, traceability, and reproducibility for use in regulated clinical development environments.Build scalable and modular AI pipelines that integrate clinical, statistical, and translational datasets.Develop interactive data visualizations, dashboards, and analytical applications to accelerate clinical insights and decision-making.Collaborate with statisticians, statistical programmers, data scientists, and scientists to translate clinical and business needs into practical technical solutions.Explore opportunities to automate and augment the clinical data lifecycle, including data processing, analysis, QC, interpretation, and reporting.Contribute to documentation, evaluation, validation considerations, and reusable AI capabilities that can scale across studies and programs.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Master, doctoral or advanced undergraduate Student in statistics, biostatistics, computational biology, health informatics, data science or computer science related quantitative disciplines.Excellent statistical knowledge and quantitative skills with the ability to apply the knowledge to solve scientific and clinical problems.Experience in coding in Python (required) and R (preferred); demonstrated ability in cloud computing platforms, containerization, backend development, and SQL.Experience or demonstrated interest in GenAI/LLMs, machine learning, agentic systems, model post-training, or AI application development.Familiarity with one or more of the following is a plus: cloud computing, containerization, APIs/backend development, RAG, model evaluation, or AI deployment.Experience developing data visualizations, analytical applications, dashboards, or reusable computational tools is preferred.Interest in building practical, reliable, and scalable AI solutions for clinical or biomedical research.Strong analytical thinking, engineering mindset, curiosity, and written and verbal communication skills.Ability to learn quickly, work across disciplines, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical solutions.

Our Working Model 

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.

Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. rows.title: Intermediate Applied Operations Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutionsFrame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analysesPresent results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifactsWork independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain expertsWork successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problemsBe willing to adapt and learnDemonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related fieldPreference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomesFamiliarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

Secret

Top Secret

rows.title: Research Analyst, Community Insights
rows.descriptionText:
THE ROLE: Research Analyst, Community Insights

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We are looking for a Research Analyst, Community Insights. This role will partner closely with the Research & Insights team and colleagues across Britebound on internal- and external-facing research, while owning the strategy and day-to-day effectiveness of our online research communities.

What You’ll Do 

Research & Data Analysis: Ensure data integrity through data cleaning, validation, and preparation across diverse datasets; produce topline statistics, subgroup comparisons, and multivariate analyses that address key research questions.Apply statistical methods such as regression analysis, clustering, significance testing, and driver analysis to uncover insights, explain variation in outcomes, and identify actionable findings.Translate complex findings into clear charts, captions, visualizations, dashboards, reports, briefs, and presentations that are compelling and accessible to non-technical audiences.Online Research Community Management : Manage Britebound’s three distinct online research communities (teens, parents, and counselors).Engage with internal Britebound teams to design and conduct weekly research engagements to meet team needs. Synthesize and deliver findings on a quick-turnaround cadence.Design and program research engagements based on organizational needs for teen, parent, and counselor online communities.Lead the launch and ongoing management of Britebound’s new counselor community, including recruitment, engagement, research programming, and continuous improvement of the member experience.Online Community Strategy: Develop and steward Britebound’s overarching strategy for online research communities, establishing consistent approaches to recruitment, retention, incentives, engagement, research cadence, governance, and insight sharing across audiences.Collaboration & Leadership: Help shape the Research & Insights team’s research agenda and analytical approaches; build strong cross-functional relationships to identify shared research needs and advance data-driven initiatives across Britebound.Contribute to Research & Insights reports by activating Britebound’s online communities to source relevant qualitative feedback that adds depth and context to quantitative findings.Propose and develop strategies for creating dashboards or other data visualizations that enable impactful use of findings from online research communities and other Britebound research projects.
About You

5-10 years of experience in research, polling, analytics, community-based research, or a related role, with a proven track record of completing complex analyses, working with rich datasets, and developing clear data visualizations.Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with tools such as R, SQL, Python, STATA, SPSS, Dataiku, and/or comparable platforms; able to synthesize complex information and develop actionable insights.Experience building, managing, or engaging online communities, panels, or research participant networks; skilled in recruitment, retention, incentive strategy, moderation, and translating member feedback into usable insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn quantitative and qualitative findings into concise, audience-appropriate stories and recommendations.Able to connect the big picture to execution, manage multiple workstreams and deadlines, and proactively identify opportunities to improve research quality and business impact.Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, results-oriented, and comfortable engaging in constructive debate and incorporating diverse perspectives. Able to build trust and credibility across levels and functions.

Salary Range: $87,700 - $115,000

Britebound is committed to fair and transparent pay. In determining compensation, we consider a variety of job-related factors, including prior experience, certifications and licenses, skills and expertise, geographic location, and internal equity.

We take a total compensation approach, meaning we look beyond salary alone to support, reward, and recognize the whole individual. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

Why Britebound?

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

rows.title: Risk Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Verisk's Catastrophe and Risk Solutions (CRS) team provides risk modeling software and consulting services to insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and other financial intermediaries. We're looking for a Risk Consultant or Risk Analyst to join our Consulting and Client Service Team, based in Boston, MA.

In this role, you will build client relationships based on your knowledge of Verisk's products, helping clients get the most out of their catastrophe modeling workflow. You will support a range of client-facing project work, from routine questions to multi-month consulting engagements.

You will interpret and analyze data using Verisk's Touchstone, TouchstoneRe, and Synergy Studio software, and provide recommendations to internal and external stakeholders on how to apply that data to their business problems. You will lead, manage, and execute projects for clients and internal stakeholders, working with other internal teams to deliver projects efficiently and to a high standard of quality.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and client deadlines at once will be important assets in this role.

Responsibilities

 Perform a wide range of risk analyses in support of consulting projects and internal initiatives Respond to client questions in a timely manner and help bring them to a speedy and accurate resolution by working collaboratively with our internal teams Communicate directly with clients to develop project timelines and manage deliverable expectations Employ project management best practices when performing consulting studies and other mid- to large-scale projects Support model and product change management efforts when model updates or new features are introduced in our software Provide input to internal teams regarding the evolution of our products based on client feedback and your usage of our products. Remain engaged with the internal teams through feature design, development and release Act as a connector across the CRS vertical and with other groups within Verisk, sharing context, surfacing cross-team needs, and helping align work across groups

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s Degree that included quantitative courses such as mathematics, actuarial science, statistics, business or computer science Experience of two or more years in a catastrophe modeling or actuarial support role is preferred Experience with Microsoft Office products, including Powerpoint, Word and Excel is essential. Working knowledge or experience with Power Query or Power BI is also preferred. Experience with SQL Server Management Studio or other database management or querying software is preferred Experience with Claude, Microsoft Copilot or other AI tools is preferred

About Us

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

Verisk Businesses

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance

Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events.

Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement

Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group.

Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger

Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. We offer a competitive total rewards package that includes base salary determined based on role, experience, skill set, and location.

All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

Why Britebound?

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

rows.descriptionText:
Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do

Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platformField customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate outputDesign and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflowsMine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketingRun structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers doPartner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and qualityPartner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements

What We're Looking For

0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaintFamiliarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audienceHigh attention to detail and self-driven mindset.Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week

Qualifications

Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.US Person required.Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Competitive salary and meaningful equityPlatinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependentsBasic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

rows.title: Research Analyst, Community Insights
rows.descriptionText:
THE ROLE: Research Analyst, Community Insights

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We are looking for a Research Analyst, Community Insights. This role will partner closely with the Research & Insights team and colleagues across Britebound on internal- and external-facing research, while owning the strategy and day-to-day effectiveness of our online research communities.

What You’ll Do 

Research & Data Analysis: Ensure data integrity through data cleaning, validation, and preparation across diverse datasets; produce topline statistics, subgroup comparisons, and multivariate analyses that address key research questions.Apply statistical methods such as regression analysis, clustering, significance testing, and driver analysis to uncover insights, explain variation in outcomes, and identify actionable findings.Translate complex findings into clear charts, captions, visualizations, dashboards, reports, briefs, and presentations that are compelling and accessible to non-technical audiences.Online Research Community Management : Manage Britebound’s three distinct online research communities (teens, parents, and counselors).Engage with internal Britebound teams to design and conduct weekly research engagements to meet team needs. Synthesize and deliver findings on a quick-turnaround cadence.Design and program research engagements based on organizational needs for teen, parent, and counselor online communities.Lead the launch and ongoing management of Britebound’s new counselor community, including recruitment, engagement, research programming, and continuous improvement of the member experience.Online Community Strategy: Develop and steward Britebound’s overarching strategy for online research communities, establishing consistent approaches to recruitment, retention, incentives, engagement, research cadence, governance, and insight sharing across audiences.Collaboration & Leadership: Help shape the Research & Insights team’s research agenda and analytical approaches; build strong cross-functional relationships to identify shared research needs and advance data-driven initiatives across Britebound.Contribute to Research & Insights reports by activating Britebound’s online communities to source relevant qualitative feedback that adds depth and context to quantitative findings.Propose and develop strategies for creating dashboards or other data visualizations that enable impactful use of findings from online research communities and other Britebound research projects.
About You

5-10 years of experience in research, polling, analytics, community-based research, or a related role, with a proven track record of completing complex analyses, working with rich datasets, and developing clear data visualizations.Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with tools such as R, SQL, Python, STATA, SPSS, Dataiku, and/or comparable platforms; able to synthesize complex information and develop actionable insights.Experience building, managing, or engaging online communities, panels, or research participant networks; skilled in recruitment, retention, incentive strategy, moderation, and translating member feedback into usable insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn quantitative and qualitative findings into concise, audience-appropriate stories and recommendations.Able to connect the big picture to execution, manage multiple workstreams and deadlines, and proactively identify opportunities to improve research quality and business impact.Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, results-oriented, and comfortable engaging in constructive debate and incorporating diverse perspectives. Able to build trust and credibility across levels and functions.

Salary Range: $87,700 - $115,000

Britebound is committed to fair and transparent pay. In determining compensation, we consider a variety of job-related factors, including prior experience, certifications and licenses, skills and expertise, geographic location, and internal equity.

We take a total compensation approach, meaning we look beyond salary alone to support, reward, and recognize the whole individual. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

Why Britebound?

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

THE ROLE: Research Analyst, Community Insights

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We are looking for a Research Analyst, Community Insights. This role will partner closely with the Research & Insights team and colleagues across Britebound on internal- and external-facing research, while owning the strategy and day-to-day effectiveness of our online research communities.

What You’ll Do 

Research & Data Analysis: Ensure data integrity through data cleaning, validation, and preparation across diverse datasets; produce topline statistics, subgroup comparisons, and multivariate analyses that address key research questions.Apply statistical methods such as regression analysis, clustering, significance testing, and driver analysis to uncover insights, explain variation in outcomes, and identify actionable findings.Translate complex findings into clear charts, captions, visualizations, dashboards, reports, briefs, and presentations that are compelling and accessible to non-technical audiences.Online Research Community Management : Manage Britebound’s three distinct online research communities (teens, parents, and counselors).Engage with internal Britebound teams to design and conduct weekly research engagements to meet team needs. Synthesize and deliver findings on a quick-turnaround cadence.Design and program research engagements based on organizational needs for teen, parent, and counselor online communities.Lead the launch and ongoing management of Britebound’s new counselor community, including recruitment, engagement, research programming, and continuous improvement of the member experience.Online Community Strategy: Develop and steward Britebound’s overarching strategy for online research communities, establishing consistent approaches to recruitment, retention, incentives, engagement, research cadence, governance, and insight sharing across audiences.Collaboration & Leadership: Help shape the Research & Insights team’s research agenda and analytical approaches; build strong cross-functional relationships to identify shared research needs and advance data-driven initiatives across Britebound.Contribute to Research & Insights reports by activating Britebound’s online communities to source relevant qualitative feedback that adds depth and context to quantitative findings.Propose and develop strategies for creating dashboards or other data visualizations that enable impactful use of findings from online research communities and other Britebound research projects.
About You

5-10 years of experience in research, polling, analytics, community-based research, or a related role, with a proven track record of completing complex analyses, working with rich datasets, and developing clear data visualizations.Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with tools such as R, SQL, Python, STATA, SPSS, Dataiku, and/or comparable platforms; able to synthesize complex information and develop actionable insights.Experience building, managing, or engaging online communities, panels, or research participant networks; skilled in recruitment, retention, incentive strategy, moderation, and translating member feedback into usable insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn quantitative and qualitative findings into concise, audience-appropriate stories and recommendations.Able to connect the big picture to execution, manage multiple workstreams and deadlines, and proactively identify opportunities to improve research quality and business impact.Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, results-oriented, and comfortable engaging in constructive debate and incorporating diverse perspectives. Able to build trust and credibility across levels and functions.

Salary Range: $87,700 - $115,000

Britebound is committed to fair and transparent pay. In determining compensation, we consider a variety of job-related factors, including prior experience, certifications and licenses, skills and expertise, geographic location, and internal equity.

We take a total compensation approach, meaning we look beyond salary alone to support, reward, and recognize the whole individual. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

Why Britebound?

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. rows.title: Intermediate Applied Operations Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE’s Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics.

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation’s toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Apply advanced analytical and mathematical modeling techniques to inform difficult policy and acquisition decisions, to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency, and achieve highest quality engineering solutionsFrame problems, collect and manipulate data, develop & code customized algorithms, identify risks, and incorporate domain-specific context, as necessary & applicable, to supplement and enhance insight gained solely from mathematical analysesPresent results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise, including creative data visualization artifactsWork independently and collaborate with a team of technical staff and domain expertsWork successfully both in a remote environment and with in-person presence

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related field or an advanced degree with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.Be passionate about applying operations research, statistics, and data analytics to real world problemsBe willing to adapt and learnDemonstrated ability to use at least one optimization package (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, PuLP, AMPL)Demonstrated ability to use at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Java)Demonstrated ability to use at least one simulation platform (e.g., Stella, Simio, Arena, AnyLogic, SimPy, RSimmer)Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance and must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires 4 days a week on site

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Mathematics/Statistics, or equivalent knowledge and skills in a related fieldPreference given to qualified candidates with active clearance (e.g. TS/SCI)Experience working with/for agencies and/or departments of the US Government (e.g., FAA, DoD, DoE, DHS, Treasury, IRS)Demonstrated ability to develop and incorporate a variety of AI/ML models, techniques, and principles into analytical work to efficiently achieve rigorous outcomesFamiliarity and/or experience with Electromagnetic Spectrum (EMS) organizations, concepts, modeling, testing, and assessment, to include the Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations Center (JEC), Joint Electromagnetic Warfare Center (JEWC), Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO), Electromagnetic Battle Management—Joint (EMBM-J), Spectrum Consumption Modeling (SCM), and Electronic Warfare (EW)Familiarity and/or experience with the Mission Engineering paradigm of decomposing a key operational problem, establishing a system-of-systems model of components, technology, policies, procedures, and techniques, and ultimately simulating the process on a technical platform

Secret

Top Secret

Job Description

Verisk's Catastrophe and Risk Solutions (CRS) team provides risk modeling software and consulting services to insurers, reinsurers, brokers, and other financial intermediaries. We're looking for a Risk Consultant or Risk Analyst to join our Consulting and Client Service Team, based in Boston, MA.

In this role, you will build client relationships based on your knowledge of Verisk's products, helping clients get the most out of their catastrophe modeling workflow. You will support a range of client-facing project work, from routine questions to multi-month consulting engagements.

You will interpret and analyze data using Verisk's Touchstone, TouchstoneRe, and Synergy Studio software, and provide recommendations to internal and external stakeholders on how to apply that data to their business problems. You will lead, manage, and execute projects for clients and internal stakeholders, working with other internal teams to deliver projects efficiently and to a high standard of quality.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and client deadlines at once will be important assets in this role.

Responsibilities

 Perform a wide range of risk analyses in support of consulting projects and internal initiatives Respond to client questions in a timely manner and help bring them to a speedy and accurate resolution by working collaboratively with our internal teams Communicate directly with clients to develop project timelines and manage deliverable expectations Employ project management best practices when performing consulting studies and other mid- to large-scale projects Support model and product change management efforts when model updates or new features are introduced in our software Provide input to internal teams regarding the evolution of our products based on client feedback and your usage of our products. Remain engaged with the internal teams through feature design, development and release Act as a connector across the CRS vertical and with other groups within Verisk, sharing context, surfacing cross-team needs, and helping align work across groups

Qualifications

Working knowledge or experience with Power Query or Power BI is also preferred. Experience with SQL Server Management Studio or other database management or querying software is preferred Experience with Claude, Microsoft Copilot or other AI tools is preferred

rows.title: Research Associate, In Vivo
rows.descriptionText:
Company Summary:

FL106 Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company focused on developing novel drug delivery modalities. FL106 Inc. is backed by Flagship Pioneering, which provides the strategic vision and resources to advance FL106 from platform validation to clinical impact.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated Research Associate with broad expertise conducting in vivo studies, histology preparation and analysis, and molecular biology. This individual will play an important role in generating high-quality data on the biodistribution, target engagement, and biological response of our molecules in animal models.

The candidate must be independent, goal-oriented, have excellent communication skills, and be willing to work in a highly dynamic and fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. This is a unique opportunity to drive the growth of an early-stage biotechnology company where you can contribute to the next frontier of genetic medicines. We are looking for collaborative, enthusiastic problem-solvers to join our team, driven by a shared goal of making a practical impact.

Key Responsibilities:

In Vivo Pharmacology

Conduct in vivo studies in rodent models including experience with peripheral administration (IV, IP, SC) and stereotactic surgeries for direct to CNS administration. Conduct terminal procedures, including animal takedowns, blood collection, and necropsies. Perform tissue harvesting and dissection as appropriate for downstream bioanalytical and histological applications. 

Histology & Imaging

Prepare, embed, and section a variety of mammalian tissues using microtome, vibratome, or cryostat techniques (FFPE or fresh-frozen samples). Perform immunohistochemistry (IHC) and immunofluorescence (IF) on tissue sectionsAcquire high-quality images using epifluorescence and/or confocal microscopyPerform in vivo and ex vivo fluorescence and bioluminescence imaging using IVIS or equivalent small-animal imaging systems, including organ collection, image acquisition, and quantitative analysis of signal intensity and tissue distribution. Conduct quantitative image analysis (cell counts, regional MFI, colocalization analysis, morphometric quantification) using software such as ImageJ, QuPath, Halo, or equivalent platforms. 

Molecular Biology

Perform measurement of gene and protein expression analyses using qRT-PCR, Western blotting, and ELISA methodologies and interpret dataReport results clearly to the scientific team

Qualifications and Skills:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Cell Biology or a related field, with 1+ years of laboratory experience, preferably in the biopharmaceutical industry. Strong hands-on experience with rodent in vivo studiesStrong hands-on experience in histology, including tissue embedding, sectioning, staining, IHC/IF, and imaging. 

Additional Qualifications (preferred but not required):

Authorship on a peer reviewed publicationExperience with multiplex IHC/IF and advanced image analysis platforms. 

About Flagship

Flagship Pioneering is a bioplatform innovation company that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in generation of over 500 patents, initiation of over 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents and an aggregate value of more than $90 billion. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

rows.descriptionText:
THE ROLE: Research Analyst, Community Insights

Britebound is a national non-profit with a mission to support middle and high school learners to explore their interests, experience potential careers, and navigate a path to a meaningful and rewarding future. We fulfill our mission through free digital-first experiences, grantmaking, policy advocacy, research, and impact investing.

We believe that exploring career possibilities, as early as middle school, and providing access to education-to-career pathways aligned with one’s passions and goals will result in greater confidence and long-term success for all students.

We are looking for a Research Analyst, Community Insights. This role will partner closely with the Research & Insights team and colleagues across Britebound on internal- and external-facing research, while owning the strategy and day-to-day effectiveness of our online research communities.

What You’ll Do 

Research & Data Analysis: Ensure data integrity through data cleaning, validation, and preparation across diverse datasets; produce topline statistics, subgroup comparisons, and multivariate analyses that address key research questions.Apply statistical methods such as regression analysis, clustering, significance testing, and driver analysis to uncover insights, explain variation in outcomes, and identify actionable findings.Translate complex findings into clear charts, captions, visualizations, dashboards, reports, briefs, and presentations that are compelling and accessible to non-technical audiences.Online Research Community Management : Manage Britebound’s three distinct online research communities (teens, parents, and counselors).Engage with internal Britebound teams to design and conduct weekly research engagements to meet team needs. Synthesize and deliver findings on a quick-turnaround cadence.Design and program research engagements based on organizational needs for teen, parent, and counselor online communities.Lead the launch and ongoing management of Britebound’s new counselor community, including recruitment, engagement, research programming, and continuous improvement of the member experience.Online Community Strategy: Develop and steward Britebound’s overarching strategy for online research communities, establishing consistent approaches to recruitment, retention, incentives, engagement, research cadence, governance, and insight sharing across audiences.Collaboration & Leadership: Help shape the Research & Insights team’s research agenda and analytical approaches; build strong cross-functional relationships to identify shared research needs and advance data-driven initiatives across Britebound.Contribute to Research & Insights reports by activating Britebound’s online communities to source relevant qualitative feedback that adds depth and context to quantitative findings.Propose and develop strategies for creating dashboards or other data visualizations that enable impactful use of findings from online research communities and other Britebound research projects.
About You

5-10 years of experience in research, polling, analytics, community-based research, or a related role, with a proven track record of completing complex analyses, working with rich datasets, and developing clear data visualizations.Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with tools such as R, SQL, Python, STATA, SPSS, Dataiku, and/or comparable platforms; able to synthesize complex information and develop actionable insights.Experience building, managing, or engaging online communities, panels, or research participant networks; skilled in recruitment, retention, incentive strategy, moderation, and translating member feedback into usable insights.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn quantitative and qualitative findings into concise, audience-appropriate stories and recommendations.Able to connect the big picture to execution, manage multiple workstreams and deadlines, and proactively identify opportunities to improve research quality and business impact.Collaborative, adaptable, resilient, results-oriented, and comfortable engaging in constructive debate and incorporating diverse perspectives. Able to build trust and credibility across levels and functions.

Salary Range: $87,700 - $115,000

Britebound is committed to fair and transparent pay. In determining compensation, we consider a variety of job-related factors, including prior experience, certifications and licenses, skills and expertise, geographic location, and internal equity.

We take a total compensation approach, meaning we look beyond salary alone to support, reward, and recognize the whole individual. Depending on role eligibility, your offer may also include a bonus, 403(b) retirement plan participation, generous paid time off, and comprehensive health and life insurance benefits. As a result, final offer amounts may vary from the salary range listed in the job posting.

Join our mission-driven organization to enjoy these perks and benefits as well as investment in your growth, contributions, and future.

Why Britebound?

Britebound offers a wide range of perks and benefits to Team Members, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans, a retirement plan (plus match), weekly lunches, commuter benefits, and tuition reimbursement.

We also heavily prioritize a healthy work/life balance, which is why we offer all full-time Team Members generous PTO options, Summer Fridays (every Friday off between Memorial Day and Labor Day), and a company holiday break between December 25th and January 1st.

Britebound works in a Hybrid schedule (2) two days a week in our Boston HQ. We prioritize strategic thinkers, collaborators, and work/life pros who are looking to help make a difference in kid's education and career goals.

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Empress is pioneering mechanistic intelligence for drug discovery — helping R&D teams understand what their molecules are doing, what is driving activity, what liabilities may emerge, and which candidates are best positioned to advance. By integrating multi-omics, chemoproteomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, computational inference, knowledge graphs, and CRISPR-based functional validation, Empress turns biological complexity into clearer development decisions. Our platform gives discovery teams access to capabilities that would otherwise require years, specialized infrastructure, and rare cross-functional expertise to build internally.

Empress is a privately held biotech conceived by Flagship Pioneering, which brings the courage, long-term vision, and resources needed to realize unreasonable results.

We're looking for a Research Associate II to join the Genomics team and own day-to-day operations of our automated high-throughput bulk RNA sequencing platform. Motivated candidates will have opportunities to cross-train in complementary areas such as molecular cloning within a production-scale platform, including DNA assembly, transformation, colony picking, and plasmid verification.

rows.title: Biomedical Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About LifeCanvas Technologies
LifeCanvas Technologies, an MIT spinoff venture, is revolutionizing the way we see and study biological systems. LifeCanvas offers cutting-edge technologies and end-to-end solutions that enable holistic molecular imaging of biological systems, accelerating breakthrough discoveries in science and the development of new therapeutic strategies. As a key partner in this global effort, our computational team works on enabling scientific innovation and directly collaborates with global researchers in bioengineering, neuroscience, and oncology.
Job SummaryWe are seeking an ambitious and motivated Biomedical Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with biomedical data analysis, machine learning, or scientific computing, and a strong interest in building scalable software solutions for both research and industrial applications in a fast-paced start-up environment. In this role, you will support the analysis of large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets generated by LifeCanvas Technologies. You will work closely with our tissue processing, image acquisition, and Contract Research teams to run analyses, validate outputs, troubleshoot issues, and help generate high-quality quantitative results for internal teams and external scientific partners.
Key Responsibilities:Run, validate, and troubleshoot analyses for Contract Research projects, ensuring accurate results and timely project completion.Perform quality control on analysis outputs to validate results.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth data acquisition, integration, and downstream analysis.Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal teams and external scientific partners.Assist with maintaining and improving components of LifeCanvas image-analysis pipelines for large-scale 3D fluorescence microscopy datasets.Support the development of data engineering workflows, including database management, ETL processes, and handling of large imaging datasets.
Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, bioengineering, computational biology, electrical engineering, or a relevant field.Experience with image processing for biological and/or biomedical applicationsExperience using Python for data science, scientific computing, automation, and image analysis.Strong problem-solving skills with a self-motivated and detail-oriented mindset and the ability to work in a team environment.Adaptable and proactive in a fast-paced environment, comfortable working across multiple concurrent projects and evolving requirements.Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications:Familiarity with light microscopy, neuroscience, and immunohistochemistryFamiliarity with best practices for software engineering.Exposure to machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Experience in working with data engineering/analysis pipelines.
Benefits:Competitive salary.Full insurance package for full-time employees.Flexible time off.401(k) benefits.

rows.title: Intern, Biometrics
rows.descriptionText:
The Role

This is a full-time summer internship based in Cambridge, MA from June 7, 2027 – August 20, 2027. Candidates must be available for the entire duration of the program.

The Statistical Innovation & Data Analytics (SiDA) team is advancing AI-enabled statistical and clinical data solutions to accelerate data-driven decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen regulatory readiness across clinical development programs.

Role

This role provides hands-on experience at the intersection of statistics, clinical data science, and AI engineering, with opportunities to work on:

Clinical and statistical data analytics, including EDC, SDTM, ADaM, and translational dataAI/ML research and applied statistical modeling for clinical development use casesLLM and agentic AI development, including domain-specific agents, tool integration, retrieval, and workflow orchestrationLocal and domain-specific model post-training, evaluation, and optimization for statistical and clinical applicationsAI-assisted statistical programming and analytics, exploring opportunities to automate and augment existing biometrics workflowsScalable and governed AI solutions, transitioning promising prototypes toward production-oriented applications that meet clinical data, security, quality, and compliance requirements

The student will contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and implementation of AI-enabled capabilities that support statisticians, statistical programmers, data scientists, and clinical development teams.

The role is particularly suited for students interested in going beyond general-purpose AI experimentation to understand how AI can be tailored, evaluated, and operationalized for statistical and clinical research workflows, with the goal of reducing repetitive work, accelerating time to insight, and enabling more agile use of clinical data.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Develop and evaluate AI/ML and agentic solutions for clinical data analysis, statistical programming, and workflow automation, including tool-calling, RAG, and skill-based agent architectures.Explore LLM post-training, adaptation, and evaluation approaches to improve model performance for statistical and clinical research use cases.Design agentic workflows with appropriate human oversight, traceability, and reproducibility for use in regulated clinical development environments.Build scalable and modular AI pipelines that integrate clinical, statistical, and translational datasets.Develop interactive data visualizations, dashboards, and analytical applications to accelerate clinical insights and decision-making.Collaborate with statisticians, statistical programmers, data scientists, and scientists to translate clinical and business needs into practical technical solutions.Explore opportunities to automate and augment the clinical data lifecycle, including data processing, analysis, QC, interpretation, and reporting.Contribute to documentation, evaluation, validation considerations, and reusable AI capabilities that can scale across studies and programs.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Master, doctoral or advanced undergraduate Student in statistics, biostatistics, computational biology, health informatics, data science or computer science related quantitative disciplines.Excellent statistical knowledge and quantitative skills with the ability to apply the knowledge to solve scientific and clinical problems.Experience in coding in Python (required) and R (preferred); demonstrated ability in cloud computing platforms, containerization, backend development, and SQL.Experience or demonstrated interest in GenAI/LLMs, machine learning, agentic systems, model post-training, or AI application development.Familiarity with one or more of the following is a plus: cloud computing, containerization, APIs/backend development, RAG, model evaluation, or AI deployment.Experience developing data visualizations, analytical applications, dashboards, or reusable computational tools is preferred.Interest in building practical, reliable, and scalable AI solutions for clinical or biomedical research.Strong analytical thinking, engineering mindset, curiosity, and written and verbal communication skills.Ability to learn quickly, work across disciplines, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical solutions.

Our Working Model 

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our co-op benefits are designed to support you during your time with us —at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

Free premium access to meditation and mindfulness classesSubsidized commuter benefitsGenerous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, volunteer days, and a discretionary year-end shutdownLocation-specific perks and extras

An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs.
