rows.title: Senior Analyst, Analytics and Visualization Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

Choice Hotels International is seeking a Senior Analyst, Analytics and Visualization Engineer who is passionate about turning data into decisions, not simply dashboards. As part of the Advanced Analytics team, you will design and deliver analytics products that combine business intelligence, artificial intelligence tools, and compelling data storytelling.

In this role, you will help franchisees, commercial teams, and senior leaders discover meaningful insights, explore data more easily, and take informed action. You will develop scalable, self-service analytics experiences that include visualizations, AI-generated narratives, conversational analytics, and automated reporting solutions. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and business partners, you will help make governed data more accessible and useful across the organization.

Responsibilities

Analytics and Data Storytelling

Design, build, and enhance Tableau dashboards that combine effective visualizations with AI-generated commentary about key business drivers, anomalies, and potential actions.Transform complex analytical findings into clear, decision-oriented stories for audiences ranging from franchisees to senior executives.Collaborate with data scientists to present model outputs and predictions through intuitive business intelligence experiences.Prepare analytical views and supporting narratives for manager-led executive presentations and business discussions.

Conversational and AI-Enabled Analytics

Build and maintain analytics experiences that allow nontechnical users to explore governed data using natural-language questions.Support the prototyping and refinement of workflows that integrate large language models with enterprise data sources.Develop automated performance summaries and anomaly explanations under the direction of the manager.Evaluate and improve AI-supported analytics experiences based on user needs, data quality, and business requirements.

Data Preparation and Analytics Infrastructure

Build and maintain governed data sources, flows, semantic layers, and published extracts that support dashboards and AI-enabled analytics products.Write and optimize SQL queries against AWS Redshift and Amazon S3 data tables.Validate and structure data to support accurate, reliable, and high-performing dashboards and automated reporting workflows.Develop user-friendly analytics products beyond dashboards, including Python-generated Excel reports, automated workbooks, and lightweight analytical tools.Coordinate with Data Engineering partners to identify data gaps, dependencies, and upstream issues affecting analytics products.

Collaboration and Delivery

Translate questions from franchise operations, revenue management, marketing, and other business areas into structured analytical requirements and user-ready solutions.Partner with data scientists, engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders in an agile delivery environment.Align stakeholders on governed definitions, reporting logic, and expected analytical outcomes.Manage multiple priorities while maintaining data accuracy, product reliability, and delivery commitments.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

1-3 years of experience developing Tableau dashboards, analytical reports, or data products.1-3 years years of experience writing SQL queries.Experience working with semantic layers, governed metrics, reusable data models, or similar business intelligence practices.Experience with AWS Redshift or another columnar database is preferred.Experience developing data products or reporting solutions for business users is preferred.

Technical Skills

Proficiency with Tableau and SQL.Working knowledge of data modeling, joins, aggregation logic, semantic layers, and query-performance considerations.Experience using database query tools such as DBVisualizer, DBeaver, or comparable applications.Familiarity with AWS Redshift and Amazon S3.Experience with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.Exposure to Jira, Confluence, or similar tools used for task tracking and documentation.Experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or comparable products, is preferred.Exposure to Python-based reporting, automation, or lightweight analytical tools is preferred.

Additional Skills And Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate and resolve complex data or reporting issues.Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.Ability to translate technical concepts and business requirements into clear, practical data solutions.Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting insights to technical and nontechnical audiences.Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, manage competing priorities, and navigate ambiguity.Collaborative approach to working with data scientists, engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in analytics, data science, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.Relevant technical certifications are preferred but not required.

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $99,919-$117,552. Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

WORK LOCATION & HYBRID SCHEDULE

This position is based at Choice Hotels International's corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland. Associates follow a hybrid work schedule, working in the office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays.

RELOCATION & SPONSORSHIP

Please note that relocation assistance is not available for this position. Additionally, Choice Hotels is not able to provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future for this role.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverageLeave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observanceFinancial benefits for retirement and health savingsEmployee recognition programsDiscounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

rows.descriptionText:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About The Position

Dexis is seeking a Data Collector to support a large-scale Army test and evaluation program. The project provides data collection, technical writing, computer operations, range scheduling, and administrative support services necessary to execute the government’s test mission. Support encompasses testing of a wide variety of automotive, combat, electronic, general equipment, and ordnance materiel, with services including data collection and coordination, data compilation and processing, development and management of data collection forms, test monitoring, technical writing and editorial review, reporting, data and software administration, range scheduling, and related operational support.

The Data Collector is an entry-level position that develops practical knowledge of the equipment, procedures, and tools used in the data collection process through classroom and on-the-job training. The role assists with routine test projects by observing equipment and test instruments, recording and compiling test data, performing basic computations, and capturing image data.

Work will be performed primarily onsite in Aberdeen, Maryland, with travel to other locations within the Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) as required by mission needs. This position is contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities

Acquire practical knowledge of the characteristics, properties, and uses of equipment necessary to carry out the data collection process through formal and informal classroom and on-the-job training. Become familiar with detailed data collection procedures that are established or repetitive. Assist with visually examining equipment or test items for flaws or defects on routine projects. Observe equipment operation to detect apparent malfunctions. Observe simple test instruments and controls during tests and record related test data. Download test data from onboard instrumentation. Perform specified arithmetic computations. Extract and compile specified data, including detailed narrative information, from records and other sources such as specifications and drawings. Capture image data in support of test activities. Perform job functions at sites other than Aberdeen as required. 

Qualifications

One (1) year of experience using a computer and Microsoft software; OR successful completion of two (2) accredited computer classes. Must have a GPA of 2.5 or higher in each individual discipline of math and science and a GPA of 3.0 or higher in high school English or a GPA of 2.5 or higher in college English from an accredited high school or university. Must possess a high school diploma. Must be proficient in speaking, reading, writing, and understanding English. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. Must be proficient in the use of computers and Microsoft Office software. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance. Must be able to meet the physical requirements necessary to perform assigned functions, which may include working in extreme heat or cold, high humidity, blowing sand and dust, confined spaces, at heights, and walking distances over unimproved terrain while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE). Must be available to support work outside normal duty hours when required by mission needs. Must be willing and able to travel within CONUS and OCONUS as required. 

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Your Impact at GEICO

The Business Intelligence Analyst partners closely with business leaders to translate complex data into actionable insights that drive strategic and operational decision-making. This role is responsible for leading and executing analytical projects with a strong focus on business outcomes, customer experience, and performance improvement. The analyst operates with a high degree of autonomy, collaborates cross-functionally, and serves as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders across the organization.

How You’ll Make a Difference

Analytical Leadership & Insight Generation

Lead large, complex ad-hoc and planned analytical initiatives from problem definition through insight delivery.Identify analytical opportunities, proactively surface business questions, and recommend data-driven courses of action.Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to evaluate trends, performance drivers, customer behavior, and business outcomes.Translate complex analyses into clear, compelling insights and recommendations for senior leaders.

Business Partnership

Act as a strategic partner and liaison between analytics, technology, and business teams.Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to define requirements, align on objectives, and influence decision-making.Represent the analytics function in cross-functional forums and presentations to management and senior leadership.

Project & Work Management

Coordinate and prioritize multiple analytical projects simultaneously, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timeliness.Delegate components of work to junior analysts as appropriate and provide guidance to ensure strong analytical outcomes.Support team leads and managers with planning, prioritization, and delivery of analytics work.

Data & Technical Expertise

Leverage advanced querying, database, and analytical tools to extract, analyze, and validate large, complex datasets.Ensure data integrity, consistency, and appropriate use across analyses.Develop a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, transactional systems, and the relationships between data sources.

Communication & Influence

Present analytical findings and recommendations to a broad audience, including senior management.Communicate clearly and professionally in both written and verbal formats, tailoring messages to technical and non-technical audiences.Influence decisions by connecting insights to business strategy, risks, and opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in analytics, business, economics, statistics, or a related field.Strong experience performing business or data analysis in complex, fast-paced environments.Demonstrated ability to independently lead analytical projects and manage competing priorities.Advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.Proven ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels.

Core Skills

Proficiency with analytical and reporting tools such as SQL, Excel, and data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau).Experience applying statistical techniques (e.g., regression, segmentation, trend analysis).Ability to mentor or provide informal leadership to junior analysts.Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data to strategy and operational outcomes.Comfort operating under pressure and adapting quickly to changing priorities.

The GEICO Pledge

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

rows.title: AI Connect Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As an Outside Plant Engineer, you will play a pivotal, end-to-end role in the successful deployment of our AI Connect Ultra Long Haul Network by driving the engineering, real estate acquisition, and construction of In Line Amplification (ILA) and Outside Plant (OSP) infrastructure. In this highly cross-functional position, your responsibility revolves around conceptualizing project plans and driving timelines for key business initiatives, such as Data Center Interconnectivity (DCI) and Verizon Long Haul Infrastructure. You will have the autonomy to select and implement optimal deployment strategies while working closely with Global Real Estate, Network Planning, Power/Space/Cooling (PSC), AI Connect, VBG Sales, and multiple external vendors to ensure seamless execution of the network build.

Design, engineer, and maintain outside plant infrastructure. Conduct route analyses for underground and aerial fiber optic installations. Conduct site walks with contractors to ensure construction, power, and fiber requirements are met. Lead strategic infrastructure expansions in Central Offices and Technical Facilities.Analyze potential site locations, create business cases for site acquisition, and act as a 5G MLA Real Estate project specialist to obtain and track all necessary construction-related permits.Manage external vendors and purchasing during site acquisition and construction to ensure schedules align with activation targets. Develop service order requirements for internal and external customers. Provide regular updates on construction progress, changes, and risks to leadership.Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations. Act as the primary interface between landlords, government employees, community officials, legal counsel, and building contractors.Provide guidance to junior OSP engineers to monitor infrastructure and troubleshoot/repair fiber and equipment issues. Direct internal departments and coordinate efforts to ensure the best outcomes.

What We’re Looking For...

You know a lot about outside plant engineering practices, network construction, and site acquisition. You enjoy analyzing complex deployment problems and have the autonomy to implement the right solutions. While you work well independently, you are also a great team player who excels at managing moving parts across multiple disciplines.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.Four or more years of relevant experience, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience (specifically in OSP/fiber engineering, construction, or site acquisition/real estate).A valid driver's license.Willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Facility/Construction Management, or a related technical/STEM field.Deep knowledge of Outside Plant Engineering practices, Hi-Capacity Services, FTTC, FTTP, FIOS, Network Transformation, and CORE procedures.Experience in A&E design, as well as Engineering and Network Assurance standards.Strong planning, time management, and multitasking skills with a track record of driving complex project timelines.Exceptional leadership abilities with strong interpersonal and communication skills for navigating regulatory and community stakeholders.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $96,000.00 - $157,000.00.

rows.title: Data Scientist - Clearance Required
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Data Scientist – Journeyman will support the Army's ammunition planning and resupply mission through the development, sustainment, and refinement of data-driven analytics and machine learning models. This role will work within a team to maintain and enhance ML-driven demand forecasts, support dashboard metrics in Army Vantage, and contribute to workflow automation that improves ammunition distribution efficiency and unit readiness.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

 Responsibilities 

 Support development, testing, and refinement of forecasting and analytics models for ammunition consumption and resupply.  Maintain and enhance existing Vantage-based analytics, dashboards, and data products, including incorporating new data sources.  Assist in integrating and validating data into Vantage pipelines to centralize munitions data.  Conduct descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analytics on historical ammunition consumption and unit forecast data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.  Support requirement-gathering sessions with logisticians, ammunition SMEs, and Government stakeholders to define analytical use cases, data needs, and model enhancements.  Develop and maintain reproducible analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and related tools; document model logic, assumptions, and limitations.  Assist in monitoring model performance and key metrics.  Prepare clear visualizations and summary analyses to support leadership decision-making, including monthly status reports and briefings.  Support project backlog management by creating and updating user stories and technical tasks related to data science work. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or related discipline.  2–5 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a closely related field.  Demonstrated experience with:  Python (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL for data preparation, analysis, and basic modeling.  Building and validating regression, time series, or classification models.  Working with large, structured datasets in relational databases or data warehouses.  Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills; ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical problems and solutions.  Ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, concise terms.  Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an Agile environment with shifting priorities.  Active or attainable SECRET clearance; please note, only US Citizens can obtain a clearance. 
Desired Qualifications

 Experience supporting an enterprise data analytics platform (e.g., Army Vantage, Army Data Platform, or similar).  Familiarity with Army logistics processes, ammunition management, or supply chain analytics.  Experience with dashboarding/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Vantage-native visualization tools).  Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and Agile/Scrum practices (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).  Exposure to ML model monitoring and MLOps concepts. 

Target salary range: $130,000-$160,000

Disclaimer:  The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

rows.title: Forensic Scientist (Crime Scene)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

This is an Interdisciplinary Position that involves work in two different occupations which may be filled under the Forensic Scientist, 0401 Series or the Crime Scene Analyst, 0301 Series, depending on the qualifications of the person selected.

This position is located in the Department of Forensic Sciences (DFS). The mission of DFS is to provide high quality, timely, accurate, and reliable forensic science services using best practices and best available technology, focusing on unbiased science and transparency, to enhance public safety and health. The position is responsible for recognizing, recording, and recovering evidence in criminal investigations at the scene(s) of crime(s) by analyzing, photographing, collecting, preserving, and presenting physical evidence. Crime scenes include person crimes, such as homicides, sexual assaults, and robberies, as well as property crimes and traffic accidents, etc.

Duties And Responsibilities

Receives training in and/or investigates assigned crime scenes in various locations in the city; assist with sealing the crime scene to protect and preserve important evidence. Receives training in and/or collects fingerprints/palm prints, tire and shoe prints, tool mark impressions, firearms, hair, clothing, fibers, and biological evidence or any other physical evidence deemed necessary; analyzes and records crime scenes showing correlation between evidence and the scene. Performs various chemical and photographic processes in the field or laboratory. Receives training in and/or attends autopsies to fingerprint the deceased for identification purposes, and collect relevant physical evidence.

The incumbent advises on the collection of evidence in each case, including those involving deaths, especially when homicide is suspected; evaluates risks concerning or identifying hazardous materials in the field and the laboratory. Testifies in court in connection with the evidence processed, developed, and preserved as well as any examinations or analyses performed. Prepares detailed reports and supplements; accepts documents, and bar-codes evidence associated with each crime scene case.

Qualifications And Education

A Degree in biological sciences, agriculture, natural resource management, chemistry, or related disciplines appropriate to the position.

Or

Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major, as shown in A above, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

In addition, applicants must have specialized experience. Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licensure and Certifications

None – However, incumbent must be able to successfully complete the DFS Crime Scene Sciences Competency Testing. Certification from the International Association for Identification is preferred.

Work Environment

This position’s duty station will be housed within the Consolidated Forensic Laboratory (CFL) which is a protection-sensitive facility. As such, incumbents of this position are designated as safety-sensitive and shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and pre-employment drug and alcohol testing, and other requirements as applicable. Due to the handling of primary evidence, the applicant will be required to submit a buccal swab for the purposes of the DNA Quality Control database for the DFS.

The nature of the DFS mission necessarily involves the potential risks associated with biological or chemical hazards, including morgue functions. Although contact with these functions is intended to be minimal, the risks are nevertheless possible; training to recognize, address, and mitigate these risks is required as is dealing with potentially personally difficult topics, such as crime, death, and disease.

Work is performed in the field at the crime scenes; in the laboratory during the analysis, and autopsies, as well as in an office setting when preparing documentation/reports, etc. Also work in a variety of weather conditions with exposure to the elements and travel/walk over rough, uneven, or rocky surfaces. The incumbent may be exposed to hazardous materials, toxic substances, and blood borne pathogens and is required to follow safe field and laboratory practices and wear protective clothing, including facial masks, safety glasses, gloves, etc. May be exposed to various objectionable material (e.g., pornography, etc.). The work may require the incumbent to be in unstable locations necessitating the wearing of a ballistic safety vest. The position requires the use of electronic communication devices including, but not limited to, cell phones, communication radios, and wireless computers.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Shift, weekend, and holiday work is required. Overtime before or after the daily tour may be required. Mandatory overtime (scheduled or unscheduled) may be required.

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0401/0301-09

Promotion Potential: No Known Promotion Potential

Type of Appointment: Career Service (CS) - Regular Appointment

Collective Bargaining Unit: This position is covered under a collective bargaining agreement, National Association of Government Employees (NAGE) Local R3-05, and you may be required to pay an agency service fee (union dues) through direct payroll deduction.

Position Suitability: This position has been deemed Safety-Sensitive under the guidelines of the DC Personnel Manual. Incumbents of this position are subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC personnel regulations. Accordingly, you must successfully pass a criminal background and drug and alcohol screening as a condition of employment and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks, background investigations, and drug tests for the duration of your tenure.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as Essential and acceptance of this offer confirms you agree to adhere to the policies in sections 1271 and 1274 of DPM Chapter 12, regarding essential/emergency employees. As an essential employee, you will be required to either report to work, stay at work, or telework (if directed to do so) during a declared emergency or during a period of non-emergency where your duties have been deemed as critical District government functions/operations. You may be required to perform other duties outside of your position description during a period of a declared emergency (such as manual labor, shelter services, etc.).

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.

Data Scientist - AI/ML (DCO)

Columbia, MD

Job Description

X8 is seeking a Senior Data Scientist - AI/ML to support Defensive Cyber Operations by applying statistics, machine learning, and advanced analytics to intelligence questions and mission data. The role develops reusable analytic products, identifies patterns and anomalies, and translates complex data into actionable insights for analysts and decision-makers.

This position also supports production model implementation and refinement, data curation and integration, model-performance monitoring, technical documentation, and research into emerging data science tradecraft and technology.

What You'll Be Doing

 Apply statistical, machine-learning, and analytic approaches to intelligence questions and produce reusable products for Intelligence Analysts. Engineer and transform data features; identify hidden patterns and trends; build and optimize classifiers; develop automated anomaly detection; and automate analytic workflows. Evaluate statistical models, collaborate with software developers to implement validated models in production, and periodically re-evaluate and refine production models. Curate data from traditional and non-traditional sources by extracting, transforming, integrating, and loading data into accessible data stores. Collaborate with Data Scientists to develop processes and tools that monitor model performance and data accuracy. Work with analysts to interpret results, refine analysis, and communicate findings and ideas to decision-makers and other stakeholders. Document processes, models, and activities, including development and implementation of configuration-management plans for data sets. Research emerging data science tradecraft and technology.

 Active TS/SCI with polygraph required for consideration. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and 8 years of experience; an advanced degree may be considered in lieu of years of experience.

Proficiency with R or Python and SQL to manipulate data and draw insights from large and small data sets. Exposure to AWS, Cisco/CCNA, STIGs/IAVA, and/or Big Data Platform (BDP).

What Desired Skills You'll Bring

 Strong Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL), Windows, and virtual-environment skills. Independent problem-solving and engineering ability; experience with Python, Jupyter Notebooks, and network analysis tools.

WHY JOIN X8?

 Apply advanced AI/ML and data science capabilities to mission-critical defensive cyber operations. Work directly with analysts, engineers, and decision-makers on high-impact intelligence challenges. When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As an Outside Plant Engineer, you will play a pivotal, end-to-end role in the successful deployment of our AI Connect Ultra Long Haul Network by driving the engineering, real estate acquisition, and construction of In Line Amplification (ILA) and Outside Plant (OSP) infrastructure. In this highly cross-functional position, your responsibility revolves around conceptualizing project plans and driving timelines for key business initiatives, such as Data Center Interconnectivity (DCI) and Verizon Long Haul Infrastructure. You will have the autonomy to select and implement optimal deployment strategies while working closely with Global Real Estate, Network Planning, Power/Space/Cooling (PSC), AI Connect, VBG Sales, and multiple external vendors to ensure seamless execution of the network build.

Design, engineer, and maintain outside plant infrastructure. Conduct route analyses for underground and aerial fiber optic installations. Conduct site walks with contractors to ensure construction, power, and fiber requirements are met. Direct internal departments and coordinate efforts to ensure the best outcomes.

What We’re Looking For...

You know a lot about outside plant engineering practices, network construction, and site acquisition. You enjoy analyzing complex deployment problems and have the autonomy to implement the right solutions. While you work well independently, you are also a great team player who excels at managing moving parts across multiple disciplines.

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.Four or more years of relevant experience, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience (specifically in OSP/fiber engineering, construction, or site acquisition/real estate).A valid driver's license.Willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time.

A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Facility/Construction Management, or a related technical/STEM field.Deep knowledge of Outside Plant Engineering practices, Hi-Capacity Services, FTTC, FTTP, FIOS, Network Transformation, and CORE procedures.Experience in A&E design, as well as Engineering and Network Assurance standards.Strong planning, time management, and multitasking skills with a track record of driving complex project timelines.Exceptional leadership abilities with strong interpersonal and communication skills for navigating regulatory and community stakeholders.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The Card DS team is working continuously to innovate the way we handle data to transform every corner of our business through analytics, infrastructure, valuations, and strategy. We build human-centric experiences for moments that matter throughout the customer journey, and we do this by harnessing data, technology, and talent to propel our business forward. To accomplish this goal, we design, build, and maintain the appropriate solutions we use across Card to make smart, informed decisions. We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build predictive models and utilize the advantages of large-scale data and cloud-based processing. Through these techniques, we extract relevant insights from data to tackle a huge variety of business problems.

In this role you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal candidate will be:

Curious and creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions, and you love pushing hard to find the answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. Technical: You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions from concept to production using open source tools and modern cloud computing platforms. You are not afraid of petabytes of data. Statistically-minded. You have built models, validated them and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series analysis and deep learning. Customer and product oriented. You share our passion for changing banking for good.

rows.title: Current PhD, AI Engineering Internship Program - Summer 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Key Role Details

This is a full-time paid internship program spanning twelve weeks from June through August. Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program. Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position with their team and will work with their manager on identifying a start date upon graduation. 

This is a paid internship. This is a limited-time internship position, and Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. However, a full-time AI Engineering role, for which you may be considered upon completion of the internship (subject to business need, market conditions, and other factors) is eligible for employer immigration sponsorship. 

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained by August 2029 or earlier. Must be continuing in the same course of study of the most recent degree following completion of the internship period. At least 1 year of experience or academic work developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies. At least 1 year of experience or academic work programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience or academic work with deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure). Experience or academic work in developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing AI/ML training or inference pipelines, including distributed GPU computational frameworks. Experience or academic work with AI/ML domains and systems (e.g., LLM Inference, Search and Retrieval, NLP, Computer Vision, Guardrails, Memory). Familiarity with Agentic Frameworks (Eg: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Autogen, MCP/A2A, frontier-labs agent SDKs). 

AI Engineering Internship 

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing deep personalization and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description: 

Join the AI Engineering Internship Program for a specialized summer experience that directly contributes to delivering industry-leading agentic capabilities and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. As part of this team, you'll help build Agentic AI applications and platform capabilities that power customer-facing experiences with GenAI workflows, industry-leading infrastructure, and internal agentic coding tools. You'll work on the Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team, which is tasked with advancing the state-of-the-art in AI science and engineering. You’ll make valuable contributions from day one by building AI systems and shaping ideas key to delivering AI-native experiences and products for our 100mm+ customers.

In this role, you will:

Partner deeply with a cross-functional team of research scientists, PMs, and engineers to prototype and ship AI-native products that reach millions of customers. Research, prototype, and productionalize high-impact AI systems, including multimodal search, intelligent document processing, and autonomous agentic workflows that push the boundaries of current industry benchmarks. Design and optimize the critical infrastructure of our AI stack—from fine-tuning pre-training pipelines and reinforcement learning to implementing inference optimization, robust guardrails and sophisticated evaluation frameworks. Leverage a broad stack of technologies including AWS Ultraclusters, PyTorch, and leading-edge agentic frameworks. You’ll be empowered with top-tier developer tools like Claude Code and Windsurf to accelerate the path from concept to code. Job Description

Montgomery College, Rockville Campus, is seeking a full-time Biology faculty member in the Natural Sciences and Engineering (NSE) area to fill a position starting January 2027. This position will primarily teach Microbiology, with additional teaching responsibilities in Introductory Biology (both majors and non-majors) and Genetics. We are seeking an enthusiastic and dedicated educator who exhibits a high degree of professionalism, a strong commitment to our students, and the ability to motivate and educate in an engaging manner. This position is part of a collective bargaining unit.

Montgomery College has a long history of successfully preparing students for transfer to four-year institutions such as the University of Maryland, Georgetown University, George Washington University, and the University of Maryland, Baltimore County. Additionally, all of Montgomery College's science buildings were constructed within the last 15 years and feature state-of-the-art facilities and equipment.

The successful candidate will appreciate teaching in a multi-cultural environment and will welcome the opportunity to work with students with diverse learning abilities. Faculty duties include classroom and laboratory instruction, assessment, curriculum development, advising, professional inquiry, committee work, and instructional technology. The opportunity to engage in research with students is also supported and encouraged.

Teaching assignments may include various delivery modes, such as face-to-face, online, remote, hybrid and/or blended formats during days, evenings, and weekends. Montgomery College has four campuses and instructs courses at area high schools, as part of the growing dual enrollment program. Faculty may be assigned to any of these campuses and/or teaching different modalities.

Duties Include But Are Not Limited To

Teaching and Curriculum

Teaches non-majors and majors-level biology courses with a minimum of 30 semester hours per academic year. This teaching position is expected to include Microbiology (BIOL 210), Introductory Biology (BIOL 101 and/or BIOL 150), Principles of Genetics (BIOL 222), and other courses in the discipline as needed.Teaches a varied schedule that may include day, evening, early morning, weekend, and accelerated sections. Opportunities may exist for teaching summer classes.Designs, implements, manages, and assesses courses taught in a variety of modes, incorporating the use of a learning management system (Blackboard) and other relevant technology into instruction.Engages students in learning through active, collaborative learning approaches, and accommodates students with varying backgrounds and learning styles.Contributes to curriculum development and revision, including course design, and the review and selection of instructional materials.Delivers assigned courses in accordance with College catalog descriptions and the teaching standards of the College and the NSE area.Participates in General Education assessment, course recertification, and program review with the goal of increasing student success.

Laboratory Instruction

Designs and prepares laboratory activities for microbiology and introductory biology courses, collaborating with lab staff on necessary equipment, supplies, and instructional materials.Implements and enforces laboratory safety protocols, including safe handling of microbial cultures and other biological materials, in accordance with College policy.

Student Support and Advising

Holds regular office hours and maintains availability to students. Mentors and tutors students outside of class to assist them with being successful in college.Advises students about program curricula, transfer options to four-year institutions, and professional/career opportunities.Arranges and promotes scholarship, research, and internship opportunities for students.Advises and supports student clubs and related student activities.

Service and Professional Development

Participates in college and community activities that contribute to the growth and development of students, the College, and the community.Serves on and leads department, discipline, campus, and college committees.Stays current in the discipline and pursues continuous professional development, including participation in professional organizations and activities.

Required Qualifications

Master's degree in Biological Sciences, Microbiology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, or Genetics another closely related field.One year of demonstrated college-level teaching experience, which may include experience as a graduate teaching assistant or instructor of record.Experience designing and/or setting up hands-on laboratory activities with attention to safety protocols.Excellent oral and written communication skills.Eligible applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States and not require employer visa sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

Ph.D. in Microbiology, Cell Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or another closely related field.Two or more years of recent college teaching experience.Demonstrated experience teaching majors-level lecture and laboratory courses in biological sciences, such as microbiology, cell biology, and genetics.Experience teaching at a community college, another open-enrollment setting, or otherwise working with students of widely varying academic preparation.Demonstrated experience using varied teaching modalities (face-to-face, blended/hybrid, and online).Demonstrated experience using techniques to engage students in the classroom.Demonstrated commitment to student success including increasing retention, transfer, and graduation.Demonstrated experience in implementing or developing undergraduate research opportunities for students.Evidence of ongoing professional development.

Hiring Range: $64,510 - $98,220

Required Application Materials

Submit a cover letter addressing how your teaching experience, scholarship, professional development, and/or service would contribute to student success in Biology and align with Montgomery College’s mission and vision. Submit a resume or Curriculum Vitae (CV).Submit an unofficial copy of your transcripts from the highest degree earned

Please submit all required materials in a single PDF file with your online application. Incomplete applications will not be considered. 

Application Process

Complete online applications must be received by October 2, 2026.Include dates of employment (month/year) in your application or attachment.

For degrees earned outside of the U.S., a copy of your education equivalency, conducted by a nationally recognized evaluation service, must be included in your application.

Successful completion of a background check and degree verification (if applicable). Participation in a retirement plan (Pension or Optional Retirement Plan, depending on the position). Job Title: Software Engineer (Top Secret Clearance)

Job Description

Software Engineer focuses on the development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of satellite ground software for complex space missions. You will work in a highly technical environment building full-stack solutions that support spacecraft operations, mission planning, and ground segment capabilities. The position requires an active Top Secret clearance at the time of application and offers the opportunity to contribute to systems that must perform flawlessly in demanding space environments.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack software at the operating system, platform, and mission-unique application layers for satellite ground systems.Develop client and server applications and services using service-oriented or object-oriented architectures and message bus-based data exchange, including first-of-a-kind capabilities.Build and enhance applications using Python, C++, Postgres, Ansible, cloud infrastructure provisioning tools, PKI, and static code analysis tools, including remediation of identified findings.Act as a self-starter who makes sound technical decisions while considering overall project budget, schedule, and mission priorities.Support operations of ground software and associated configurations, including troubleshooting software errors and hardware issues that affect ground system performance.Configure ground segment software to meet mission and operational requirements.Investigate, resolve, and remediate software defects, ensuring robust and reliable ground system performance.Implement software enhancements driven by customer change requests and evolving mission needs.Support acceptance test events by planning, executing, and documenting tests to validate ground software functionality.Develop and maintain test automation to improve verification efficiency and reliability.Provide ground software support during launch and launch rehearsal events to ensure successful mission execution.Support the installation and deployment of new ground segment software in operational, development, and test environments.Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams working on spacecraft, radiation effects, autonomy, orbital mechanics, systems integration, and mission assurance challenges.

Essential Skills

Demonstrated professional software development experience.Proficiency in Python application development.Strong experience with C++ for backend and systems-level development.Understanding of object-oriented architectures and service-oriented design.Experience with full-stack development across operating system, platform, and mission-specific application layers.Ability to work with message bus-based data exchange architectures.Experience with ground systems or ground software for satellites or spacecraft is highly relevant.Familiarity with Linux and Windows environments.Ability to troubleshoot complex software and hardware issues in operational systems.Active Top Secret clearance at the time of application.For Software Engineer Level 3: Bachelors degree in a STEM field (ideally Computer Science or Engineering) and 5 years of experience; OR a masters degree and 3 years; OR a PhD; OR an additional 4 years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.For Software Engineer Level 4: Bachelors degree in a STEM field (ideally Computer Science or Engineering) and 8 years of experience; OR a masters degree and 6 years; OR a PhD and 3 years; OR an additional 4 years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Strong preference for candidates with Top Secret clearance and SCI eligibility or access.Experience with satellite ground stations, spacecraft operations, or mission planning systems.Experience in space-related domains such as orbital mechanics, autonomy, or mission assurance.Experience with UI/UX considerations for mission operations tools.Familiarity with tools and technologies such as MATLAB and FreeFlyer.Experience with Postgres databases and related data management practices.Exposure to cloud infrastructure provisioning and automation tools such as Ansible.Understanding of PKI and secure software practices, including static code analysis and remediation.Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.Intellectual curiosity and interest in working on hardware and software that operate in space.Experience supporting launch operations or rehearsals is a plus.

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in a highly technical engineering environment focused on building, integrating, testing, and operating spacecraft and their ground systems. Work takes place at facilities in Dulles, VA or McLean/Tysons Corner, VA, where teams tackle challenging problems in radiation effects, autonomy, orbital mechanics, systems integration, and mission assurance. rows.title: Manager, Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The Card DS team is working continuously to innovate the way we handle data to transform every corner of our business through analytics, infrastructure, valuations, and strategy. We build human-centric experiences for moments that matter throughout the customer journey, and we do this by harnessing data, technology, and talent to propel our business forward. To accomplish this goal, we design, build, and maintain the appropriate solutions we use across Card to make smart, informed decisions. We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build predictive models and utilize the advantages of large-scale data and cloud-based processing. Through these techniques, we extract relevant insights from data to tackle a huge variety of business problems.

In this role you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal candidate will be:

Curious and creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions, and you love pushing hard to find the answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. Technical: You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions from concept to production using open source tools and modern cloud computing platforms. You are not afraid of petabytes of data. Statistically-minded. You have built models, validated them and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series analysis and deep learning. Customer and product oriented. You share our passion for changing banking for good.

rows.title: Data Scientist - Clearance Required
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Data Scientist – Journeyman will support the Army's ammunition planning and resupply mission through the development, sustainment, and refinement of data-driven analytics and machine learning models. This role will work within a team to maintain and enhance ML-driven demand forecasts, support dashboard metrics in Army Vantage, and contribute to workflow automation that improves ammunition distribution efficiency and unit readiness.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

 Responsibilities 

 Support development, testing, and refinement of forecasting and analytics models for ammunition consumption and resupply.  Maintain and enhance existing Vantage-based analytics, dashboards, and data products, including incorporating new data sources.  Assist in integrating and validating data into Vantage pipelines to centralize munitions data.  Conduct descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analytics on historical ammunition consumption and unit forecast data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.  Support requirement-gathering sessions with logisticians, ammunition SMEs, and Government stakeholders to define analytical use cases, data needs, and model enhancements.  Develop and maintain reproducible analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and related tools; document model logic, assumptions, and limitations.  Assist in monitoring model performance and key metrics.  Prepare clear visualizations and summary analyses to support leadership decision-making, including monthly status reports and briefings.  Support project backlog management by creating and updating user stories and technical tasks related to data science work. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or related discipline.  2–5 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a closely related field.  Demonstrated experience with:  Python (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL for data preparation, analysis, and basic modeling.  Building and validating regression, time series, or classification models.  Working with large, structured datasets in relational databases or data warehouses.  Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills; ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical problems and solutions.  Ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, concise terms.  Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an Agile environment with shifting priorities.  Active or attainable SECRET clearance; please note, only US Citizens can obtain a clearance. 
Desired Qualifications

 Experience supporting an enterprise data analytics platform (e.g., Army Vantage, Army Data Platform, or similar).  Familiarity with Army logistics processes, ammunition management, or supply chain analytics.  Experience with dashboarding/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Vantage-native visualization tools).  Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and Agile/Scrum practices (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).  Exposure to ML model monitoring and MLOps concepts. 

Target salary range: $130,000-$160,000

Disclaimer:  The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

rows.title: Forensic Scientist (Crime Scene)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

This is an Interdisciplinary Position that involves work in two different occupations which may be filled under the Forensic Scientist, 0401 Series or the Crime Scene Analyst, 0301 Series, depending on the qualifications of the person selected.

This position is located in the Department of Forensic Sciences (DFS). The mission of DFS is to provide high quality, timely, accurate, and reliable forensic science services using best practices and best available technology, focusing on unbiased science and transparency, to enhance public safety and health. The position is responsible for recognizing, recording, and recovering evidence in criminal investigations at the scene(s) of crime(s) by analyzing, photographing, collecting, preserving, and presenting physical evidence. Crime scenes include person crimes, such as homicides, sexual assaults, and robberies, as well as property crimes and traffic accidents, etc.

Duties And Responsibilities

Receives training in and/or investigates assigned crime scenes in various locations in the city; assist with sealing the crime scene to protect and preserve important evidence. Receives training in and/or collects fingerprints/palm prints, tire and shoe prints, tool mark impressions, firearms, hair, clothing, fibers, and biological evidence or any other physical evidence deemed necessary; analyzes and records crime scenes showing correlation between evidence and the scene. Performs various chemical and photographic processes in the field or laboratory. Receives training in and/or attends autopsies to fingerprint the deceased for identification purposes, and collect relevant physical evidence.

The incumbent advises on the collection of evidence in each case, including those involving deaths, especially when homicide is suspected; evaluates risks concerning or identifying hazardous materials in the field and the laboratory. Testifies in court in connection with the evidence processed, developed, and preserved as well as any examinations or analyses performed. Prepares detailed reports and supplements; accepts documents, and bar-codes evidence associated with each crime scene case.

Qualifications And Education

A Degree in biological sciences, agriculture, natural resource management, chemistry, or related disciplines appropriate to the position.

Or

Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major, as shown in A above, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

In addition, applicants must have specialized experience. Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licensure and Certifications

None – However, incumbent must be able to successfully complete the DFS Crime Scene Sciences Competency Testing. Certification from the International Association for Identification is preferred.

Work Environment

This position’s duty station will be housed within the Consolidated Forensic Laboratory (CFL) which is a protection-sensitive facility. As such, incumbents of this position are designated as safety-sensitive and shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and pre-employment drug and alcohol testing, and other requirements as applicable. Due to the handling of primary evidence, the applicant will be required to submit a buccal swab for the purposes of the DNA Quality Control database for the DFS.

The nature of the DFS mission necessarily involves the potential risks associated with biological or chemical hazards, including morgue functions. Although contact with these functions is intended to be minimal, the risks are nevertheless possible; training to recognize, address, and mitigate these risks is required as is dealing with potentially personally difficult topics, such as crime, death, and disease.

Work is performed in the field at the crime scenes; in the laboratory during the analysis, and autopsies, as well as in an office setting when preparing documentation/reports, etc. Also work in a variety of weather conditions with exposure to the elements and travel/walk over rough, uneven, or rocky surfaces. The incumbent may be exposed to hazardous materials, toxic substances, and blood borne pathogens and is required to follow safe field and laboratory practices and wear protective clothing, including facial masks, safety glasses, gloves, etc. May be exposed to various objectionable material (e.g., pornography, etc.). The work may require the incumbent to be in unstable locations necessitating the wearing of a ballistic safety vest. The position requires the use of electronic communication devices including, but not limited to, cell phones, communication radios, and wireless computers.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Shift, weekend, and holiday work is required. Overtime before or after the daily tour may be required. Mandatory overtime (scheduled or unscheduled) may be required.

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0401/0301-09

Promotion Potential: No Known Promotion Potential

Type of Appointment: Career Service (CS) - Regular Appointment

Collective Bargaining Unit: This position is covered under a collective bargaining agreement, National Association of Government Employees (NAGE) Local R3-05, and you may be required to pay an agency service fee (union dues) through direct payroll deduction.

Position Suitability: This position has been deemed Safety-Sensitive under the guidelines of the DC Personnel Manual. Incumbents of this position are subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC personnel regulations. Accordingly, you must successfully pass a criminal background and drug and alcohol screening as a condition of employment and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks, background investigations, and drug tests for the duration of your tenure.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as Essential and acceptance of this offer confirms you agree to adhere to the policies in sections 1271 and 1274 of DPM Chapter 12, regarding essential/emergency employees. As an essential employee, you will be required to either report to work, stay at work, or telework (if directed to do so) during a declared emergency or during a period of non-emergency where your duties have been deemed as critical District government functions/operations. You may be required to perform other duties outside of your position description during a period of a declared emergency (such as manual labor, shelter services, etc.).

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.
