rows.descriptionText:
Key Role Details

This is a full-time paid internship program spanning twelve weeks from June through August. Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program. Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position with their team and will work with their manager on identifying a start date upon graduation. 

This is a paid internship. This is a limited-time internship position, and Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. However, a full-time AI Engineering role, for which you may be considered upon completion of the internship (subject to business need, market conditions, and other factors) is eligible for employer immigration sponsorship. 

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained by August 2029 or earlier. Must be continuing in the same course of study of the most recent degree following completion of the internship period. At least 1 year of experience or academic work developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies. At least 1 year of experience or academic work programming with Python, Go, Scala, or Java. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience or academic work with deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure). Experience or academic work in developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing AI/ML training or inference pipelines, including distributed GPU computational frameworks. Experience or academic work with AI/ML domains and systems (e.g., LLM Inference, Search and Retrieval, NLP, Computer Vision, Guardrails, Memory). Familiarity with Agentic Frameworks (Eg: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Autogen, MCP/A2A, frontier-labs agent SDKs). 

AI Engineering Internship 

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing deep personalization and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description: 

Join the AI Engineering Internship Program for a specialized summer experience that directly contributes to delivering industry-leading agentic capabilities and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. As part of this team, you'll help build Agentic AI applications and platform capabilities that power customer-facing experiences with GenAI workflows, industry-leading infrastructure, and internal agentic coding tools. You'll work on the Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team, which is tasked with advancing the state-of-the-art in AI science and engineering. You’ll make valuable contributions from day one by building AI systems and shaping ideas key to delivering AI-native experiences and products for our 100mm+ customers.

In this role, you will:

Partner deeply with a cross-functional team of research scientists, PMs, and engineers to prototype and ship AI-native products that reach millions of customers. Research, prototype, and productionalize high-impact AI systems, including multimodal search, intelligent document processing, and autonomous agentic workflows that push the boundaries of current industry benchmarks. Design and optimize the critical infrastructure of our AI stack—from fine-tuning pre-training pipelines and reinforcement learning to implementing inference optimization, robust guardrails and sophisticated evaluation frameworks. Leverage a broad stack of technologies including AWS Ultraclusters, PyTorch, and leading-edge agentic frameworks. You’ll be empowered with top-tier developer tools like Claude Code and Windsurf to accelerate the path from concept to code. Architect agentic workflows that go beyond simple chat—enabling AI systems to autonomously navigate tools, orchestrate multi-step reasoning, and integrate seamlessly with complex microservice environments. 

The Ideal Candidate:

You are curious, love to build systems, and also share our passion to do it the right way. You want to work on problems that have not been attempted before and will help change banking for good. You move fluently from reading a research paper to implementing it in production. You have a deep, intuitive grasp of the latest advances in agentic workflows and multimodal models. You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enable you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss. You excel at decomposing complex problems. You possess the judgment to decide where AI adds value and how to orchestrate AI workflows incorporating time-tested systems design principles, integrating both into a unified whole.

rows.title: AI Connect Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As an Outside Plant Engineer, you will play a pivotal, end-to-end role in the successful deployment of our AI Connect Ultra Long Haul Network by driving the engineering, real estate acquisition, and construction of In Line Amplification (ILA) and Outside Plant (OSP) infrastructure. In this highly cross-functional position, your responsibility revolves around conceptualizing project plans and driving timelines for key business initiatives, such as Data Center Interconnectivity (DCI) and Verizon Long Haul Infrastructure. You will have the autonomy to select and implement optimal deployment strategies while working closely with Global Real Estate, Network Planning, Power/Space/Cooling (PSC), AI Connect, VBG Sales, and multiple external vendors to ensure seamless execution of the network build.

Design, engineer, and maintain outside plant infrastructure. Conduct route analyses for underground and aerial fiber optic installations. Conduct site walks with contractors to ensure construction, power, and fiber requirements are met. Lead strategic infrastructure expansions in Central Offices and Technical Facilities.Analyze potential site locations, create business cases for site acquisition, and act as a 5G MLA Real Estate project specialist to obtain and track all necessary construction-related permits.Manage external vendors and purchasing during site acquisition and construction to ensure schedules align with activation targets. Develop service order requirements for internal and external customers. Provide regular updates on construction progress, changes, and risks to leadership.Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations. Act as the primary interface between landlords, government employees, community officials, legal counsel, and building contractors.Provide guidance to junior OSP engineers to monitor infrastructure and troubleshoot/repair fiber and equipment issues. Direct internal departments and coordinate efforts to ensure the best outcomes.

What We’re Looking For...

You know a lot about outside plant engineering practices, network construction, and site acquisition. You enjoy analyzing complex deployment problems and have the autonomy to implement the right solutions. While you work well independently, you are also a great team player who excels at managing moving parts across multiple disciplines.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.Four or more years of relevant experience, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience (specifically in OSP/fiber engineering, construction, or site acquisition/real estate).A valid driver's license.Willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Facility/Construction Management, or a related technical/STEM field.Deep knowledge of Outside Plant Engineering practices, Hi-Capacity Services, FTTC, FTTP, FIOS, Network Transformation, and CORE procedures.Experience in A&E design, as well as Engineering and Network Assurance standards.Strong planning, time management, and multitasking skills with a track record of driving complex project timelines.Exceptional leadership abilities with strong interpersonal and communication skills for navigating regulatory and community stakeholders.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Columbia, MD

Job Description

X8 is seeking a Senior Data Scientist - AI/ML to support Defensive Cyber Operations by applying statistics, machine learning, and advanced analytics to intelligence questions and mission data. rows.title: Forensic Scientist (Crime Scene)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

This is an Interdisciplinary Position that involves work in two different occupations which may be filled under the Forensic Scientist, 0401 Series or the Crime Scene Analyst, 0301 Series, depending on the qualifications of the person selected.

This position is located in the Department of Forensic Sciences (DFS). The mission of DFS is to provide high quality, timely, accurate, and reliable forensic science services using best practices and best available technology, focusing on unbiased science and transparency, to enhance public safety and health. The position is responsible for recognizing, recording, and recovering evidence in criminal investigations at the scene(s) of crime(s) by analyzing, photographing, collecting, preserving, and presenting physical evidence. Crime scenes include person crimes, such as homicides, sexual assaults, and robberies, as well as property crimes and traffic accidents, etc.

Duties And Responsibilities

Receives training in and/or investigates assigned crime scenes in various locations in the city; assist with sealing the crime scene to protect and preserve important evidence. Receives training in and/or collects fingerprints/palm prints, tire and shoe prints, tool mark impressions, firearms, hair, clothing, fibers, and biological evidence or any other physical evidence deemed necessary; analyzes and records crime scenes showing correlation between evidence and the scene. Performs various chemical and photographic processes in the field or laboratory. Receives training in and/or attends autopsies to fingerprint the deceased for identification purposes, and collect relevant physical evidence.

The incumbent advises on the collection of evidence in each case, including those involving deaths, especially when homicide is suspected; evaluates risks concerning or identifying hazardous materials in the field and the laboratory. Testifies in court in connection with the evidence processed, developed, and preserved as well as any examinations or analyses performed. Prepares detailed reports and supplements; accepts documents, and bar-codes evidence associated with each crime scene case.

Qualifications And Education

A Degree in biological sciences, agriculture, natural resource management, chemistry, or related disciplines appropriate to the position.

Or

Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major, as shown in A above, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

In addition, applicants must have specialized experience. Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licensure and Certifications

None – However, incumbent must be able to successfully complete the DFS Crime Scene Sciences Competency Testing. Certification from the International Association for Identification is preferred.

Work Environment

This position’s duty station will be housed within the Consolidated Forensic Laboratory (CFL) which is a protection-sensitive facility. As such, incumbents of this position are designated as safety-sensitive and shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and pre-employment drug and alcohol testing, and other requirements as applicable. Due to the handling of primary evidence, the applicant will be required to submit a buccal swab for the purposes of the DNA Quality Control database for the DFS.

The nature of the DFS mission necessarily involves the potential risks associated with biological or chemical hazards, including morgue functions. Although contact with these functions is intended to be minimal, the risks are nevertheless possible; training to recognize, address, and mitigate these risks is required as is dealing with potentially personally difficult topics, such as crime, death, and disease.

Work is performed in the field at the crime scenes; in the laboratory during the analysis, and autopsies, as well as in an office setting when preparing documentation/reports, etc. Also work in a variety of weather conditions with exposure to the elements and travel/walk over rough, uneven, or rocky surfaces. The incumbent may be exposed to hazardous materials, toxic substances, and blood borne pathogens and is required to follow safe field and laboratory practices and wear protective clothing, including facial masks, safety glasses, gloves, etc. May be exposed to various objectionable material (e.g., pornography, etc.). The work may require the incumbent to be in unstable locations necessitating the wearing of a ballistic safety vest. The position requires the use of electronic communication devices including, but not limited to, cell phones, communication radios, and wireless computers.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Shift, weekend, and holiday work is required. Overtime before or after the daily tour may be required. Mandatory overtime (scheduled or unscheduled) may be required.

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0401/0301-09

Promotion Potential: No Known Promotion Potential

Type of Appointment: Career Service (CS) - Regular Appointment

Collective Bargaining Unit: This position is covered under a collective bargaining agreement, National Association of Government Employees (NAGE) Local R3-05, and you may be required to pay an agency service fee (union dues) through direct payroll deduction.

Position Suitability: This position has been deemed Safety-Sensitive under the guidelines of the DC Personnel Manual. Incumbents of this position are subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC personnel regulations. Accordingly, you must successfully pass a criminal background and drug and alcohol screening as a condition of employment and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks, background investigations, and drug tests for the duration of your tenure.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as Essential and acceptance of this offer confirms you agree to adhere to the policies in sections 1271 and 1274 of DPM Chapter 12, regarding essential/emergency employees. As an essential employee, you will be required to either report to work, stay at work, or telework (if directed to do so) during a declared emergency or during a period of non-emergency where your duties have been deemed as critical District government functions/operations. You may be required to perform other duties outside of your position description during a period of a declared emergency (such as manual labor, shelter services, etc.).

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

EEO Statement: The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non-merit factor.

rows.title: AI Connect Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As an Outside Plant Engineer, you will play a pivotal, end-to-end role in the successful deployment of our AI Connect Ultra Long Haul Network by driving the engineering, real estate acquisition, and construction of In Line Amplification (ILA) and Outside Plant (OSP) infrastructure. In this highly cross-functional position, your responsibility revolves around conceptualizing project plans and driving timelines for key business initiatives, such as Data Center Interconnectivity (DCI) and Verizon Long Haul Infrastructure. You will have the autonomy to select and implement optimal deployment strategies while working closely with Global Real Estate, Network Planning, Power/Space/Cooling (PSC), AI Connect, VBG Sales, and multiple external vendors to ensure seamless execution of the network build.

Design, engineer, and maintain outside plant infrastructure. Conduct route analyses for underground and aerial fiber optic installations. Conduct site walks with contractors to ensure construction, power, and fiber requirements are met. Lead strategic infrastructure expansions in Central Offices and Technical Facilities.Analyze potential site locations, create business cases for site acquisition, and act as a 5G MLA Real Estate project specialist to obtain and track all necessary construction-related permits.Manage external vendors and purchasing during site acquisition and construction to ensure schedules align with activation targets. Develop service order requirements for internal and external customers. Provide regular updates on construction progress, changes, and risks to leadership.Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations. Act as the primary interface between landlords, government employees, community officials, legal counsel, and building contractors.Provide guidance to junior OSP engineers to monitor infrastructure and troubleshoot/repair fiber and equipment issues. Direct internal departments and coordinate efforts to ensure the best outcomes.

What We’re Looking For...

You know a lot about outside plant engineering practices, network construction, and site acquisition. You enjoy analyzing complex deployment problems and have the autonomy to implement the right solutions. While you work well independently, you are also a great team player who excels at managing moving parts across multiple disciplines.

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.Four or more years of relevant experience, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience (specifically in OSP/fiber engineering, construction, or site acquisition/real estate).A valid driver's license.Willingness to travel up to approximately 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Facility/Construction Management, or a related technical/STEM field.Deep knowledge of Outside Plant Engineering practices, Hi-Capacity Services, FTTC, FTTP, FIOS, Network Transformation, and CORE procedures.Experience in A&E design, as well as Engineering and Network Assurance standards.Strong planning, time management, and multitasking skills with a track record of driving complex project timelines.Exceptional leadership abilities with strong interpersonal and communication skills for navigating regulatory and community stakeholders.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Work Location: Herndon, VA (Hybrid - Onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursday)

Are you a technical developer who loves building cutting-edge AI prototypes, but also enjoys stepping away from the keyboard to consult with business leaders? SAP NS2 is looking for an AI Solution Engineer (Software Engineer T2) to join our Central AI & Data Observability (AIDO) organization within the AI Platform Strategy & Services team. This is a high-visibility, "dual-hat" role operating at the intersection of business strategy and rapid hands-on engineering. You will act as a strategic consultant to identify high-impact AI opportunities across various Lines of Business (LOBs), and as a technical builder to bring those opportunities to life on our enterprise AI Platform.
Responsibilities
Discovery & Assessment: Partner with LOBs to map existing business processes, capture requirements, and identify friction points where AI/Automation can significantly reduce manual effort.Solution Design: Translate vague business requirements into concrete technical solutions that leverage our Hub-and-Spoke AIDO Platform.Value Engineering: Develop "AI Value Scorecards" to estimate potential ROI and Level of Effort (LOE) reductions for proposed use cases.Center of Excellence: Drive enterprise-wide adoption of Generative AI principles, assisting teams with existing and planned platform capabilities.Platform Mastery: Maintain a current development environment against the AI Platform’s APIs and UI services.Informal POCs: Conduct rapid technical validation by building functional prototypes in a sandbox environment utilizing AWS OpenSearch, RAG patterns, and LLM orchestration.Technical Feasibility: Perform "smoke tests" on LOB data to ensure it is viable for the proposed AI application before full-scale development begins.Reference Implementation: Build and maintain a library of "Golden Path" code samples and templates to accelerate LOB developers.
Qualifications

Technical Proficiency: Proven hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript and interacting with RESTful APIs.Cloud Infrastructure: Strong familiarity with cloud-based data environments, specifically AWS OpenSearch and S3.Generative AI Concepts: Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to deconstruct complex business workflows into logical steps for automation.Communication: Exceptional ability to explain technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a persuasive, consultative manner.
Pay range and compensation package
Pay Rate: Around $70/Hr
Why Apply?
This role offers the absolute best of both worlds: the robust stability of an enterprise organization coupled with the fast-paced, high-impact culture of a central AI startup team. You will have direct exposure across multiple business units and play a fundamental role in shaping how the enterprise adopts AI.

From inventing viral hooks and building elite brand tribes to launching bold social commerce strategies on TikTok Shop, you will be the architect of our digital advocacy. Job Description:

The Operational Risk Manager role is responsible for supporting the delivery and management of Mars Inc Operational Risk Programs such as Risk Engineering, Business Resilience, and other loss prevention programs. This position will support the timely and effective delivery of all programs, across all Mars Segments globally, to ensure that Mars is identifying, quantifying and minimizing exposure to loss and business interruption.

Through close partnership and collaboration with internal stakeholders, external consultants, insurers, brokers, and risk engineering partners, this role supports the development and implementation of the Operational Risk Management strategy and long-term roadmap. The Operational Risk Manager will help drive governance, compliance, continuous improvement, and program effectiveness while fostering a culture of risk awareness and resilience throughout the organization.

What are we looking for?

What will your key responsibilities be?

Key responsibilities include managing global risk activities, monitoring program performance, managing third-party service providers, analyzing risk data and trends, coordinating audits and reviews, tracking remediation activities, and contributing to the development of standards, tools, and reporting that enhance Mars' operational resilience and risk maturity.

Support the ACM and BRM program deployment and administration. Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.

rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Summary

This leadership position will be responsible for overseeing Commercial advanced analytics and AI/GenAI strategy, acting as the primary bridge between Commercial business stakeholders and IT/technical delivery teams. This role identifies opportunities and connects with internal/external delivery partners to deliver solutions that drive growth and influence the commercial strategy and daily operations through the implementation of data science, advanced analytics, and AI/GenAI capabilities.

This role will collaborate closely with and report to the Director of Business Intelligence & Data Analytics of Commercial Intelligence Hub to drive the future of advanced analytics and AI/GenAI innovation within the Nestlé Center for Demand Generation. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical/data science background with proven experience as a business-savvy innovation leader — someone who understands the craft deeply enough to guide, challenge, and quality-check technical teams, and work closely with business stakeholders, shaping strategy, prioritizing use cases.

This role requires excellent communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization while acting as a trusted intermediary between business stakeholders and technical implementers. The role will lead, both directly & indirectly, a team of analysts and advisors responsible for generating advanced analytics and AI/GenAI solutions and driving business alignment for inflight and future innovation projects. The role will also be responsible for boosting solution adoption by different functions within Nestlé's Commercial organization.

Primary Responsibilities

Work closely with commercial business functions to assess needs and determine the most effective means of facilitating decision-making through accurate, relevant and timely insights.Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data science, AI, and GenAI projects that drive business value and align with Commercial strategic priorities.Lead the development and implementation of advanced AI and GenAI solutions (e.g., agentic workflows, LLM-powered assistants, machine learning models) in partnership with IT and technical delivery partners, ensuring solutions are both technically sound and grounded in business value.Serve as the primary liaison between Commercial business stakeholders and IT/technical implementation teams — framing ambiguous business problems into clear technical specifications and ensuring delivered solutions map back to measurable business outcomes.Identify, evaluate, and champion emerging AI, GenAI, and automation capabilities, translating them into scalable innovation initiatives aligned with Nestlé's commercial priorities.Drive the implementation, operationalization, and adoption of advanced analytics and AI/GenAI solutions within Commercial teams, recognizing that adoption — not just technical delivery — is the primary driver of ROI.Collaborate with commercial leaders by providing technical expertise to guide the prioritization and feasibility of analytics and AI initiatives.Represent Commercial team as part of Nestle’s cross functional Data Council to influence enterprise analytics strategic priorities and ensure alignment with other pillars in the organization (finance, supply chain, etc.).

Skills & Competencies

Self-starter with a history of applying advanced analytics and AI/GenAI expertise to identify insights that get results.Passionate about solving the most critical business problems through M/L, GenAI, and advanced analytics.Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable AI/data science solutions — equally comfortable engaging business executives and technical architects/engineers.A technical foundation (data science, ML/AI) that has evolved into strategic, business-facing leadership — able to guide, challenge, and quality-check technical teams.Strategic thinker with ability to see the big picture and draw connections outside the immediate organization.Knowledge of how to identify, scope and manage work to execute advanced analytics and AI/GenAI opportunities to meet business needs with an emphasis to deliver value with speed.Knowledge of process improvement and design methodologies.Project management and stakeholder management experience and expertise to deliver scalable solutions in a fast-paced and challenging environment, including leading through influence across matrixed business and IT teams.Strong executive presence and storytelling skills, with the ability to prepare and deliver clear, compelling presentations that communicate recommendations, findings, results, and status updates on advanced analytics and AI/GenAI initiatives — tailoring message and technical depth for audiences ranging from technical delivery teams to senior business and IT leadership.An Agile mindset with ability to shift priorities to meet rapidly evolving business needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a strong plus.Deep understanding of sales, marketing, or broader commercial functions, with 3-5 years of experience leading teams in a consumer products organization preferred.7+ years of experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive adoption.Demonstrated career progression from a hands-on technical/data science practitioner into a strategic, business-facing leadership role — with the credibility to guide technical teams.5+ years with a demonstrated track record of leading effective teams that deliver enterprise scale solutions with emerging technologies, advanced data and automation capabilities, or machine learning, AI, GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows that have strong adoption and proven business impact.Experience with advanced analytics and/or digital transformation projects preferred.Knowledge of various programming languages (R, Python, SQL) to develop and apply analytic solutions — sufficient to credibly review technical designs and evaluate trade-offs, even if not coding day-to-dayExperience implementing Agile development methodologies and principles.Experience working with business stakeholders and senior leaders in advising on and delivering data analytics information and technology solutions to drive business value.Experience and understanding of a variety of analytical processes, including but not limited to data governance, data integration, quality, and measurement.Experience building a data and analytics organizational strategy and managing multifunctional teams of advanced data modelers, data architects, data scientists, etc.Experience working with large data sets from multiple sources and implementing visualization capabilities leveraging mainstream commercial software platforms.Experience exploring, implementing, and deploying advanced capabilities, including cognitive technology, ML/AI, automation, and digital user engagement techniques.A proven track record of developing actionable and profitable strategies that also drive business growth.

Salary: $190,000.00 to $240,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Job Description:

The Senior National Account Manager plays a crucial role in driving profitable and sustainable sales growth for the Mars Food Business across Ben’s Original, Seeds of Change and Tasty Bite brands. This position is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with customers, broker partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring the execution of innovative customer plans that support key business objectives in revenue, profit, growth, distribution, shelving, merchandising, promotions, and pricing.

As the primary account lead for Walmart, this role is directly accountable for delivering the financial plan, driving key growth initiatives, managing trade funding, fostering category leadership, and overseeing Top-to-Top customer engagement and retail execution. A strong focus will be placed on accelerating organizational growth, increasing household penetration, and expanding category leadership through strategic partnerships with customers.

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven, and results-oriented leader with a deep understanding of Walmart, consumer trends, and the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will have strong enterprise leadership skills that embody Mars’ 5 Principles, fostering collaboration and leading crucial conversations with internal and external partners to drive focus, alignment, and business results.

What are we looking for?

5+ years of consumer-packaged goods (CPG) retail sales experience 3+ years of Walmart sales management experience (preferred) Proven retail analytic application & management capabilities, i.e. syndicated data (Nielsen and/or IRI), customer specific data (Luminate/Scintilla), and annual customer planning Category Management and Customer/Trade Marketing/SRM(RGM) experience Strong Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel & Word) capabilities Ability to travel a minimum of 10% of the time Valid driver’s license and clean driving record 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Deliver the operating plan - Achievement of customer growth and profit objectives.  Market share, NSV, operating profit, ROI on Trade Develop sales strategy - for Ben’s Original and Seeds of Change to drive long term growth objectives. Recommend and set priorities as part of segment review process. Sell Mars Food category vision (D,S,M,P) to customers, maximizing sales growth and profit. Manage joint business plan development and execution, including annual collaborative planning meetings Manage overall customer P&L, delivering financial commitments including GSV, NSV and Trade. Accomplished by levering tools and resources (technology and people) to negotiate effective customer programs along with effective tracking of all promotional contracts with our customers Responsible for sales forecast. Leveraging S&OP best practices and tools in partnership with the demand planning team Leverage internal resources to support business objectives (i.e, category management, customer support, shopper marketing, omni-commerce and consumer marketing) Leverage broker partner support (i.e. syndicated retail coverage, incremental analytic support, back office) Develop and execute breakthrough customer engagement plans, connecting leadership between customers and senior leadership at Mars Food. Maintain consistent stakeholder updates (internal and external stakeholders), including internal customer plans. 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As the UK’s most successful omni-channel retailer, e-commerce is a key part of our business - we run two of the busiest websites in the UK, driving a significant proportion of our sales. Our engineering practice includes 80+ teams, working on everything from Cloud platforms to mobile apps, from e-commerce functionality to machine learning. Take a quick look at our Engineering best practices, hear our engineers talk about their experience and opportunities to learn and grow, and check out our Tech stack. Reach out if you have any questions. Visit - https://www.jlpjobs.com/engineering-jobs/

At a glance:

Expected Salary: up to £100,000 (depending on experience)Contract type: PermanentFlexible Working: This is a hybrid working role; therefore, your time will primarily be split between working from home (in the UK) and our London Head Office. However, there will also be an expectation to visit other locations as the need arises.

Our Engineering team currently works from the office roughly twice a week to connect and, on a more ad-hoc basis, to attend key meetings, but again the frequency is dependent on the business needs. Our offices are open five days a week for those who prefer to work from the office more regularly.

Key Responsibilities

This is an opportunity to work as a Senior Platform Engineer within a cross-functional Agile development team building our Partnership Data Platform (PDP) on Google Cloud and Snowflake. You will be working collaboratively with other highly skilled Engineers creating and improving this cloud-based platform that is used by the Data teams building complex, mission-critical solutions. The vision for PDP is to embed data-driven decision-making and analytics at scale, across the Partnership. We recognise the importance of data and are backing a significant investment in developing the platform.The team takes a “paved road” approach to provide features that benefit the many Engineers that utilise the platform, by evolving its capabilities and tailoring them to both Our Business and Engineering needs.As a Senior Engineer, you will have responsibility for the development approach and will strongly influence how the platform evolves to meet business needs. You will also use your knowledge of Engineering to support the shaping of new projects and support the professional development of less experienced developers. You will work with a diverse range of technical and non-technical stakeholders, which will require strong communication skills.There are opportunities to become a people manager for your fellow engineers if that is something that appeals to you.Ideal candidates will have excellent Software Engineering skills with a track record of working in teams delivering flexible cloud-based infrastructure solutions that are scalable, secure and performant. Successful candidates will have a passion for using technology to deliver outstanding and innovative solutions.

Essential Skills

Experience working with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider. Managing infrastructure as code, with a Software Engineering mindset.Use of languages such as Python to automate configuration and extend platform services.A solid grounding in designing and building systems for reliability and security.Well-versed in the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery practice, and experience of using supporting tools to help it work effectively for many Engineers.Comfortable working within an Agile development team and open to pair programming.Extensive experience leading, coaching and mentoring individuals/teams.Experience with generative AI tools and techniques to enhance development and productivity.

Desirable Skills/experience You May Have

As this role will involve working specifically with our Data Platform, use of some of the following languages and tools would be very helpful:

GCP (e.g. IAM, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Storage, VPC networking)Snowflake Data PlatformTerraformGitlab CIFamiliarity with SQLDocker and KubernetesApache AirflowObservability tools - especially those relevant to Data PlatformsDBTInformatica.

Next Steps: 

The application form consists of a CV upload followed by application questions. Please ensure you refresh the page each time you complete a task to ensure you complete everything that you need to do before the closing date.If you are successful following your initial application, the next stages are: a screening telephone call with a recruiter, a technical coding test and virtual interviews.

We’re the largest employee owned business in the UK and home of our cherished brands, John Lewis and Waitrose. We’re not just employees, we’re Partners, driven by our purpose to build a happier world. As we look to our future, there’s never been a more exciting time to join us.

We’re ruthlessly focused on being brilliant at retail. We continue to innovate, adapt and diversify. Never Knowingly Undersold on price, quality and service in John Lewis and passionately serving food-lovers in Waitrose.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer III
rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Central Technology is the force multiplier, accelerating creative opportunity and progress at EA. We’re a world-class community of technologists, innovators, strategists, and orchestrators transforming interactive entertainment. Together, we power the platforms, AI-driven tools, live services, and infrastructure that ensure global scale, secure player experiences, and unlock bold new possibilities.

EA Security protects our players, employees, products, and platforms. We set security standards, support game and enterprise teams, assess risk across partners and systems, and ensure compliance with global requirements. Our work strengthens system integrity, supports fair play, and enables teams to build and operate securely at scale.

The Senior Machine Learning Engineer will report to the Senior Manager, EA Player Security Data Labs. You will follow a hybrid work model with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration. This role focuses on building and operating production-grade data and machine learning infrastructure that enables data scientists and analysts to deliver fraud detection, anti-cheat, and account security solutions across EA games.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines that support machine learning workflows for fraud and anti-cheat systems.Own and operate production data and machine learning infrastructure, including batch and near-real-time data processing, feature generation, training workflows, and inference pipelines.Partner with data scientists to productionize machine learning models, with a strong focus on data consistency, data quality, and reliable offline and online feature computation.Ensure data and machine learning pipelines are reliable, repeatable, observable, and cloud agnostic across environments.Contribute to architectural standards, platform design decisions, and engineering best practices as a senior individual contributor within EA Player Security Data Labs.

Qualifications

Five or more years of professional experience in data engineering, machine learning engineering, or a closely related role with production ownership.Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience building and maintaining large-scale, production-grade data pipelines. Rust Experience a Plus.Experience designing and operating data-intensive systems using modern programming languages, including Rust.Hands-on experience supporting end-to-end machine learning workflows, with an emphasis on data preparation, feature pipelines, and model deployment infrastructure.Experience working in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, including large-scale data processing systems.Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.Experience with CI/CD systems and production deployment workflows, including GitLab.Experience with Terraform and Spark

Why You Will Enjoy This Role

You will work on data and machine learning systems that protect millions of players from fraud and cheating.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor with strong technical ownership and autonomy.

You will design and build core data infrastructure that powers machine learning across EA Player Security.

Why We Are Excited About This Role

We build systems that directly protect player trust and fair play across EA games.

We value strong data engineering fundamentals and production-focused machine learning.

We support senior engineers with autonomy and opportunities to shape long-term technical direction.

 Define, commit to, and deliver market Procurement goals aligned with the NAM CFO, global Procurement performance expectations, savings targets, innovation priorities, and business stakeholder needs. Implement best-in-class Procurement and Travel Management methods, processes, policies, governance standards, and digital tools across the market, ensuring compliance, transparency, and speed of execution. Leading the market's Travel Management strategy to deliver cost-effective, efficient, compliant, and safe travel programs that support business objectives and employee experience. Future-proof the Procurement function by embedding AI, automation, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making into source-to-pay activities, enabling teams to move beyond transactional execution toward strategic value creation for adidas. Key Responsibilities Translate the global Procurement strategy into clear North America priorities, actionable roadmaps, and measurable outcomes that support adidas business performance. Deliver annually agreed savings, value creation, risk mitigation, and productivity targets for the market. Regularly report and communicate market targets in alignment with global Procurement targets. Shape a long-term Procurement agenda and Global Procurement leadership, ensuring North America market requirements, future capability needs, and adidas strategic priorities are represented. Lead, drive, and develop market teams; develop and manage top specialized talent and capabilities within the market. Drive capability development in the market regarding new capabilities, process and technology standardization, leading practice sharing, and talent development. Champion responsible AI adoption across Procurement by building data literacy, strengthening governance, improving supplier intelligence, and enabling faster, better-informed decisions across spend, risk, demand, and supplier performance. Prioritize, initiate, and manage continuous improvement initiatives. Facilitate impact assessments of changing requirements within the market, including legislation and policies. Work together with Senior Global Category Directors to position market-specific procurement requirements at a global level. Develop and oversee market travel category strategies and travel supplier portfolios, ensuring alignment with global Procurement and Travel objectives. Drive optimization of travel and meetings programs to improve operational efficiency, employee experience, compliance, and financial performance. Ensure market travel requirements and priorities are represented within global category strategies and travel program governance.Manage the Procurement organization on a market level Lead the Procurement organization in accordance with adidas management principles, supporting the organization's focus on performance, talent management, values, leadership, and self-management practices. Drive implementation of Procurement Leadership Team decisions at market and country levels. Manage the quality of the end-to-end source-to-pay process, including compliance with policies, strategies, and processes within the market. Manage the Procurement budget within the market, overseeing financial performance through cost-effectiveness analysis and cost control activities. Monitor and support successful execution and implementation of sourcing strategies, including stakeholder alignment and customer satisfaction. Prioritize support requests and communicate priorities transparently to stakeholders. Agree and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs) between Procurement, GBS service delivery, and the business. Develop, align, and execute an annual action plan to advance the Procurement function. Develop and implement a market Procurement succession plan. Provide strategic leadership and governance for the North America Travel Management function. Lead and develop the Travel team through direct management of the Sr. Manager, Travel, ensuring strong talent development, succession planning, performance management, and organizational capability. Oversee travel policy implementation, compliance management, traveler communications, and continuous improvement initiatives across the market. Ensure effective governance and oversight of travel booking, meetings and events, traveler communications, and travel risk management programs. Monitor and evaluate travel program performance through KPIs, supplier scorecards, compliance metrics, spend analytics, and stakeholder feedback. Partner with Finance, HR, Security, Legal, and IT to ensure effective management of travel-related processes, systems, controls, and duty-of-care requirements.Act as Point of Contact for market stakeholders and the market/country management team Manage stakeholder relationships and satisfaction, acting as a trusted business partner and representing Procurement within the market organization. Strive for alignment between Procurement category strategies, sourcing implementation, and market P&L delivery. Build and strengthen key customer relationships to drive stakeholder satisfaction across the business and countries. Serve as the senior market representative for Travel Management, advising executive stakeholders on travel strategy, policy, supplier performance, traveler experience, and spend optimization opportunities. Partner with business leaders to ensure travel programs effectively support commercial objectives while balancing cost, risk, compliance, and employee experience.Support key sourcing initiatives and management of core suppliers Review and advise category strategies for major market spend categories. Develop and lead partnerships with selected strategic suppliers. Provide executive oversight of strategic sourcing, contract negotiations, and supplier relationship management for travel-related categories, including airlines, hotels, car rental providers, travel management companies, meetings and events providers, and other travel-related suppliers. Partner with Global Procurement and Global Travel stakeholders to leverage enterprise agreements, drive supplier performance, and identify innovation opportunities. Ensure effective management of key travel suppliers through performance reviews, risk assessments, savings initiatives, and continuous improvement activities. rows.title: Manager, Digital Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
DUTIES: As Manager, Data Solutions, responsible for delivering cutting-edge analytics services to stakeholders, enabling them to make fact-based decisions. Based on multiple data sources, you manage the generation of insights that help adidas understand consumer behavior and related business performance to ultimately help drive sales. In collaboration with your team, you in form the adidas digital market strategy and provide the factual basis for future consumer experiences and related demand and site development. Contribute to continuous development of the analytics practice in scope, including service portfolio evolution and aligned to global frameworks for focus areas assigned to you. Potential focus areas are: Digital Business Performance analytics; Digital Operational Analytics (Forecasting, SLAs, Returns, Trading & Data Governance); Digital Experience Analytics (.com and app); and Digital Analytics Projects. Manage demand for insights and analytics. Conduct collection, tracking, mining and analysis of data and the generation of fact-based insights using multiple data sources. Provide analytics services to stakeholders within the eCom market. Ensure analytics results drive consumer experience and business impact and help achieve market sales plans. Execute assigned projects in areas such as analytics implementation, database integration, tag management, qualitative data, etc. Support stakeholders in your area of responsibility in the use of digital analytics to define goals, select appropriate KPIs, monitor performance and derive trends and opportunities. Provide stakeholders with actionable recommendations and calls for action based on your gathered insights. Translate gathered insights into engaging, actionable and easy to digest insights presentations. Maintain a strong stakeholder network with high level of trust that facilitates action-ability of insights. Implement and use data driven decision processes, in line with a fact-based decision culture. Co-initiate and help implement new reporting structures or refine existing structures within your area of responsibility in alignment with Global Digital Analytics Frameworks and Data Governance. Help distill best practice guidance to other markets and other adidas stakeholders to maximize the use of analytics capabilities. Build a strong internal and external network, informing the adidas Digital Analytics community on the latest trends and technological advances.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business or a related field of study, and Five (5) years of experience in Digital Analytics. Work experience must have included: Experience in App Analytics; Experience of digital marketing in a brand environment; Experience in eCommerce environment; Experience with python; Experience with model development; Experience with Power BI; Experience with Digital analytics KPIs; Experience with MS Office, Alteryx and Adobe Analytics; Experience with developing analytical tools for web, eCom and digital disciplines; and Experience with BitBucket.

rows.title: Account Manager - Media Platforms, Client Sales & Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Account Manager - Media, Client Sales Insights 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Our team is composed of media and analytics professionals who are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and measurable value to our clients. You will find success on this team by leveraging your analytical problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills to deliver actionable insights, drive client adoption of Circana's solutions, and support long-term client success.

We're hiring an Account Manager to support client relationships with Media Platform clients. The Account Manager will work closely with client operators and key stakeholders, translating business objectives into measurement and media solutions that drive action. In addition to delivering high-quality analytical outputs, the Account Manager serves as a trusted day-to-day partner, helping clients maximize value from Circana's capabilities while representing the voice of the client internally to support product innovation and continuous improvement.

Job Responsibilities

Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for Media Platform partner stakeholders, building strong working relationships and supporting overall client success. Translate analyses into actionable insights and recommendations that help clients optimize media strategies and achieve business objectives. Lead client discussions with junior and mid-level stakeholders regarding targeting, optimization, measurement strategies, and performance outcomes, escalating and partnering with senior team members as needed. Manage and coordinate execution across targeting, optimization, measurement, and clean room workflows while ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely delivery. Monitor solution adoption and usage, identify client challenges and emerging needs, and proactively recommend actions that maximize client value and satisfaction. Support account planning activities by providing client feedback, business context, and insights that contribute to retention, renewals, and future growth opportunities. Coordinate effectively across analytics, product, operations, sales, and client-facing teams to align resources, resolve issues, and deliver seamless client experiences. Act as the voice of the client internally, helping influence product enhancements, process improvements, and service innovation based on client needs and market trends. Support client needs in a timely and efficient manner, demonstrating critical thinking, problem solving, operational excellence, and a commitment to exceptional client service. 

Requirements

Required Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics or a related quantitative or marketing field. Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in task-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communications skills, with ability to tailor messages to a variety of internal and external stakeholders. Ability to thrive in a constantly evolving, agile environment. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets and Microsoft PowerPoint and/or Google Slides. Preferred 1-2 years’ experience in an insights and analytics or account management role. Preferred 1-2 years’ experience in the media advertising ecosystem. Experience in executing multiple work streams across various stakeholders at once with the ability to prioritize assignments and deliver complex, high-quality projects on time. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote - New York City Metro Area. Chicago preferred but not limited to – occasional requested in city office time

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $65k to $72k.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

Overview

Company Description

Epsilon’s Data Science & AI (DSAI) practice within the Analytics Services team is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics and data science solutions that drive measurable business impact for our clients.

In this role, you will focus on solving complex business problems such as customer segmentation, campaign optimization, churn reduction through a combination of statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimentation. You will work closely with analytics consulting, cross-functional partners, and global delivery teams to translate business questions into analytical solutions, ensuring high-quality and efficient execution across a distributed team model.

As a senior team member, you will guide analytical approaches, ensure rigor and quality, and help evolve procedures while operating within a modern, platform-enabled data science ecosystem.

rows.title: Director, Decision Sciences
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Company Description

As a Director of our Intelligent Interfaces team, you will create innovative analytics systems that reveal, explore and explain complex patterns and phenomena from Epsilon’s peta-scale and massively dimensional digital marketing ecosystem. You will reduce this complexity into sophisticated, intuitive interfaces that demonstrate the business value of Epsilon’s platform directly to our collaborators and global customers, which include some of the world’s largest brands. Our challenges span hundreds of millions of highly detailed individual profiles across hundreds of millions of websites and apps, tied together by powerful real-time analytics that make near-instantaneous decisions on messaging to those profiles trillions of times a day. This provides an incredibly rich environment of business questions and answers that are hidden within petabytes of data. This position reports to the VP of the Decision Sciences Visual Analytics (DSVA) team.

You will be leading an R&D team focused on using the latest in artificial intelligence, combined with visual analytics, to provide deep insights on complex data sets for user communities ranging from clients to analysts. Our focus is on understanding complex marketing activities, customer profiles, personas, marketing touch points, path to purchase, and more within the context of the Epsilon digital marketing platform. Thousands of attributes over time must all be condensed into meaningful, actionable insights. You will also work closely with our systems team that provides the backbone of large-scale compute to bring petabytes of data into our platform, where we can query and manipulate it interactively. Our tech stack is evolving to keep pace with the times; however, you can expect to be working with TypeScript, React, Node.js, Databricks, LLMs, LangChain, and more.

Candidates should have extensive experience leading a team in applied R&D settings. You need to have a good eye for detail in interface work, whether visualizations and charts or AI workflows. A key need for this position is to tame complexity and nurture simplicity, in order to make our insights accessible to clients. This is not a pure people manager role. Ideal candidates will be hands-on with technology—designing sketches, creating prototypes, and iterating on outputs. Candidates must have a desire to move beyond applied research alone to building production systems in the real world.

Responsibilities

Lead a team of 5–7 applied scientists performing R&D on advanced visual and intelligent interfaces for understanding complex data.Understand collaborator requirements and design implementations for the user experience of DiME (Digital Marketing Explorer), Epsilon’s marketing analytics tool for both internal and client use.Develop agentic AI capabilities that allow DiME to be embedded in Epsilon and Publicis platforms.Develop new analytical storytelling and visualization-oriented interfaces for conveying complex marketing insights.Work as an SME advisor to client teams, clients, and agencies to understand DiME capabilities and how they can be used to drive business outcomes.

Qualifications

6+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years leading a team.Ph.D. in Computer Science, Math, Physics, or equivalent education/professional experience is required or an M.S. with 10+ years of experience.Extensive experience with building advanced analytics systems with visual and AI interfaces.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.Strong experience in building modern web applications.Strong passion for understanding key business problems, bringing together a team to understand data and instrumentation needs, and mining data to unearth deep insights into customer experiences.Strong experience in at least one database technology (e.g., Hive, DuckDB).Understanding and experience working with cloud infrastructure services like Databricks.Experience working with code repositories and continuous integration (e.g., Git, Jenkins).

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. 5-10+ years of relevant experience in client leadership, category management, consumer/shopper insights, analytics, sales strategy, or consultative account management within CPG, retail, syndicated data, or adjacent industries. Experience working in a large, cross-functional matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders and cross-functional partners. Experience working with a global organization preferred.
